pku-grad.text: 2027 Application Information for International Students (Master's Degree and Ph.D. Degree) 请输入关键字 确定 En 首页 关于我们 学校介绍 留学寄语 如何到达 联系我们 留学申请 本科生 研究生 交换生 进修生 预科生 国际暑期学院 国际短期课程 奖学金 奖学金公告 奖学金项目 校园文化 多彩活动 认识中国 认识世界 生活服务 学业指导 生活服务 住宿与设施 签证手续 毕业手续 规章制度 学籍学历 就业实习 政策手续 就业信息 实习信息 留学生校友 常用下载 招生简章类 申请类 奖学金类 手册类 院系相关类 2027 Application Information for International Students (Master's Degree and Ph.D. Degree) 时间：2026-10-23 Peking University (PKU) is a comprehensive research university with disciplines ranging from philosophy, literature, history, law, economics, and education to science, engineering, medicine, management, art, and interdisciplinary studies. Peking University enrolls international students to pursue master’s and Ph.D. degrees through the “Application + Examination” method, and is dedicated to educating innovation-minded scholars with a global perspective and an understanding of China. This admissions prospectus is intended for applicants to the Yanyuan campus (Haidian District, Beijing); the new Yanyuan campus (Changping District, Beijing); the School of Software and Microelectronics (Daxing District, Beijing); and the Shenzhen Graduate School (Shenzhen, Guangdong). The specific provisions are as follows: 1. Disciplines and Majors For detailed information on majors and subjects, including the language of instruction, please consult the “ Peking University 2027 Master/Doctoral Admissions Major Catalogue (International Students) ” . 2. Method and Length of Study 1) Study methods for master’s or Ph.D. degree programs at Peking University are divided into full-time and part-time. For details on the learning methods for each major and focus, please refer to the “ Peking University 2027 Master/Doctoral Admissions Major Catalogue (International Students) ” . 2) Unless otherwise specified by the enrollment department (or program), the basic study period is 2 or 3 years for master’s degree students; 4 or 5 years for doctoral students; and generally 5 years for doctoral students admitted with only a bachelor’s degree. 3. Application Prerequisites Applicants must meet all of the following requirements: 1) Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens holding a valid passport. Residents of the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macau, or Taiwan who have emigrated to another country and are applying to Peking University as international students must present a valid passport or citizenship documents issued before April 30, 2021, and provide proof of the cancellation of Chinese nationality. Note: The exit and entry administration authority of the public security organ of China reserves the right to determine whether an applicant still holds Chinese nationality. If, during the application period or even after admission or registration, the applicant is found to still hold Chinese nationality, the applicant’s application, admission, registration, or enrollment will be nullified. 2) Applicants should be both physically and psychologically healthy, have no criminal record, and must comply with the laws and decrees of China and the regulations of Peking University. 3) Applicants to master’s degree programs must hold a bachelor’s degree or higher from a university or college accredited by the Ministry of Education of China. For certain professional degrees, such as Public Administration, Business Administration, Executive Business Administration, Law, and others, special application requirements apply and will be implemented in accordance with the Ministry of Education of China’s “2027 National Regulations for the Administration of Postgraduate Admissions.” Applicants to doctoral programs must hold a master’s degree or higher from an institution accredited by the Ministry of Education of China. Applicants with bachelor’s degrees may apply to doctoral programs in the sciences and engineering. 4) The applicant’s academic performance, academic level, and language ability should meet the admission requirements for the major they are applying to. 4. Application Period (Beijing time) October 26, 2026 – December 25, 2026 Note: For details on English-taught master’s programs, please consult the application guidelines for each program. 5. Application Materials Visit the International Student Service System ( https://www.studyatpku.com ) , complete the application, and upload the following documents: 1) Graduation and degree certificates, along with degree authentication in Chinese or English. For degree certificates in other languages, applicants must upload both the original copy and a notarized copy in Chinese or English. Degree diplomas awarded by overseas universities must be authenticated by the Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange, Ministry of Education, P. R. China (CSCSE) . Degree diplomas awarded by universities on the Chinese mainland must be authenticated by the Center for Student Services and Development, Ministry of Education, P. R. China (CSSD) . Note: Applicants who graduated before 2027 must upload their degree authentication report during the application period. Applicants expected to graduate in 2027 must provide an official letter from their current university confirming their expected graduation date and submit their graduation certificate upon pre-admission. 2) Official transc ripts of the applicant’s academic achievement, including courses taken and standards achieved. These must be original documents or notarized copies, in either Chinese or English. 3) A personal statement (including a research plan: 1500 words for the master’s degree program or 3000 words for the doctoral program). Please use the link to download the template: https://isd.pku.edu.cn/en/downloads.php?cate=13 4) Résumé and a copy of the Application Commitment letter. Please click the link to download the Commitment letter template: https://isd.pku.edu.cn/en/downloads.php?cate=13 5) Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors in the applicant’s major (or equivalent professionals with a relevant academic title), in Chinese or English. Once applicants submit a request, the application system will send a link to the recommenders. Recommenders should click the link and complete the recommendation either by filling out the form online or by uploading a scanned copy of the signed letter. To download the template, click the link: https://isd.pku.edu.cn/en/downloads.php?cate=13 6) Original Chinese or English language test scores: ● For Chinese-taught programs, language test scores that meet the following standards are eligible for submission. Discipline HSK Writing section (composition) Science Subjects HSK 6, score above 200 Not lower than a score of 65 Humanities Subjects HSK 6, score above 210 Not lower than a score of 65 Note: Applicants who have taken the new HSK Levels 7–9 exam may submit corresponding qualifying score reports. ● Applicants to English-taught programs (projects) whose native language is not English must submit a TOEFL (iBT, 5 points or above; TOEFL scores of 100 or above obtained between September 1, 2025 and January 21, 2026, are also accepted), GRE (above 315), or other evidence of English proficiency. The specific requirements for English and Chinese language proficiency are subject to the admissions guidelines of each English-taught program. 7) Passport front page. Applicants must upload the front page of all ordinary passport(s) used continuously since April 30, 2021. The current passport must remain valid for at least three months beyond the date of enrollment. 8) Table of contents and abstracts of the applicant’s academic publications and any other original achievements in the applicant’s field (if applicable). 9) Some departments or schools may require additional application documents. Note: Applicants should scan the original or notarized application documents in color using a scanner. Images taken with a mobile phone or camera are not acceptable. Once confirmed, the applicant's passport details (including name, nationality, gender, date of birth, and the uploaded photo) submitted during the application phase cannot be modified before enrollment. Applicants must thoroughly review and ensure that all required documents (including two letters of recommendation) are complete and meet the specified standards before submitting them. Consequences of incomplete or non-compliant materials will be borne solely by the applicant. 6. Application Fee The application fee for each program or major is 800 RMB. Note: Each applicant may apply to up to two programs or majors. Applicants must pay the application fee online before the application deadline. Payments in other currencies or by traveler’s checks will not be accepted. Applications with incomplete documents or an unpaid application fee will not be processed. The application fee is nonrefundable. 7. Examination by the School/Department The International Student Division will review the applicant’s basic qualifications. After passing the review, the application materials will be forwarded to the admissions office of the relevant school or department for academic evaluation. The school’s (department, institute, center) admissions team will convene panels of experts to review applicants’ academic dossiers. All submitted application materials will be reviewed to assess each applicant’s overall ability. A shortlist of applicants will be prepared for the next stage of the examination. The second examination round will be held between January and March 2027. The exact date and time will be set by the respective school or department and posted on its website. Applicants should check the website regularly for updates. The school’s (department, institute, center) admissions expert committee will conduct a comprehensive assessment of the candidates’ research capacity, language proficiency, innovation capacity, and overall quality during the second examination round and rank the candidates. 8. Admission 1) Based on the school’s or department’s examination results, the Admission Office will review and prepare the preliminary admission list. 2) The preliminary admission list will be posted by the school or department before the end of May. Applicants should monitor the latest notices from the school or department. 3) The pre-admitted candidates should download and print the application form and, together with the other required original application documents (except the degree diploma and recommendation letters), deliver or mail the materials to the International Student Division of Peking University. Deadline: May 31, 2027 Address: Room 330, International Student Division, New Sun Student Center, Peking University. Please write on the envelope: “Graduate Student Application Materials.” 4) In late June 2027, the International Student Division will issue an admission notice, a “Confirmation Form for Study in China” (JW201/JW202), and other documents to admitted students in batches. 9. Enrollment Admitted students will complete registration and enroll at Peking University in early September 2027. The exact time will be announced in the admission notice. Admitted students must register at Peking University at the designated time with a valid passport, a valid visa, and an admission letter. All students should present their original degree diplomas for admission qualification review at the designated time. Students with degrees from overseas universities should, in addition, submit the authentication report issued by the Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange. If the relevant certificates have not been obtained before enrollment in the year of admission, the admission qualification shall be invalid. 10. Tuition Fees (per year per person) and Scholarships 1) Tuition Fees: Tuition Fees of Graduate Programs for International Students . 2) Scholarships: New international students may apply for the following scholarships: (1) Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B): includes a full or partial tuition waiver, free accommodation, monthly living expenses, and medical insurance provided in accordance with regulations. (2) Beijing Government Scholarship for International Students: Type A includes a tuition waiver, free accommodation, medical insurance, and monthly living expenses in accordance with the regulations; Type B includes a tuition waiver, free accommodation, and medical insurance; Type C includes a tuition waiver and medical insurance. (3) Peking University Scholarship for New International Students: includes a full or partial tuition waiver, monthly living expenses, and medical insurance. Note: Scholarship applicant evaluations will be conducted in accordance with applicable government and university regulations. For more information, please visit the International Student Division’s website at http://www.isd.pku.edu.cn. 11. Visa, Medical Insurance and Accommodation 1) Visa: Students admitted to PKU should apply for a student visa at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate in their home country using the admission letter and the JW201/202 form. International students who will study in China for more than 6 months must obtain an “X1” visa, which is valid for only 30 days upon arrival in China. Upon arrival, they must visit the International Student Division and apply for a Residence Permit within 30 days to obtain legal status in China. 2) Medical Insurance: The Ministry of Education of China requires all international students to maintain medical insurance throughout their planned period of study. Students must purchase the ‘Comprehensive Insurance Plan for Foreign Students’ on the day of registration. Students without valid medical insurance will not be permitted to register. 3) Accommodations: Students with scholarships that cover housing will receive housing. Self-funded students should arrange their own housing on or off campus. Please note that students who live off campus must register with the local police station within 24 hours of arrival. 12. Graduation and Degree Awarding Students who have completed all the requirements stipulated in the academic plan and passed their thesis defense upon completion of their studies are permitted to graduate. After being examined and approved by the university’s Academic Degree Assessment Committee, the corresponding academic degree will be conferred. To provide opportunities for those who are not proficient in Chinese to pursue a PKU degree, Peking University has developed several English-taught programs, listed below. Degree School/College Program Major Contact Information Master’s School of Government International Master of Public Administration (IMPA) Program Public Administration in Comparative Public Policy and International Cooperation Tel: 86-10-62755478 Email: gzgys@pku.edu.cn Master’s School of Government Master in Public Policy (MPP) Program Public Policy Tel: 86-10-62755478 Email: gzgys@pku.edu.cn Master’s School of International Studies Master’s Degree Program in International Affairs (MIA Program) International Affairs Email: sisoip@pku.edu.cn Master’s School of International Studies PKU-LSE Double Master’s Degree Program in International Affairs International Affairs Email: lsepku@pku.edu.cn Master’s School of International Studies PKU-Sciences Po Master’s Degree Program in Sustainable Development and International Relations International Affairs Email: sis@pku.edu.cn Master’s Law School Master of Law (LLM) Program in Chinese Law Juris (Chinese Law and Comparative Law) Tel: 86-10-62751699 Email: llmpku@pku.edu.cn Master’s Guanghua School of Management MBA Program Master of Business Administration Tel: 86-10-62747266 86-10-62747265 Email: MBAintl@gsm.pku.edu.cn Master’s Guanghua School of Management Global Master in Management (MiM) Finance (Global Master in Management) Tel: 86-10-62747699 Email: MiM@gsm.pku.edu.cn Master’s Yenching Academy Master’s Degree in China Studies China Studies Tel: 86-10-62766358 Email: yca-admissions@pku.edu.cn Master’s College of Environmental Sciences and Engineering PKU-LSE Double Master’s Degree in Environmental Policy, Technology and Health Resources and Environmental Engineering Tel: 86-10-62758525 Email: pku-lse.dual.degree@pku.edu.cn Master’s/Ph.D. School of Computer Science Master’s Degree/Ph.D. in Computer Science Computer Science and Technology Email: gradadmissions.cs@pku.edu.cn Master’s/Ph.D. School of New Media Master’s/Ph.D. Program in New Media Journalism and Communication; New Media Email: snm@pku.edu.cn Master’s/Ph.D. Guanghua School of Management Research Master’s/Ph.D. National Economics; Industrial Economics: Statistics; Finance; Accounting; Enterprise Management Tel: 86-10-62747018 Email: admission@gsm.pku.edu.cn Master’s/Ph.D. School of Materials Science and Engineering Master’s/Doctoral Programs Materials Science and Engineering Tel: 86-10-62756697 Email: gmsezb@pku.edu.cn Ph.D. School of Arts Ph.D. Program in the History and Theory of Art History and Theory of Art Email: pkuart@pku.edu.cn Ph.D. Department of Information Management Ph.D. Program in Information Science Information Science Email: gxgyjsyw@pku.edu.cn Additional Notes: 1. For further information about the school or department to which the applicant is applying, including basic facilities, research, supervisors and faculty, subjects, research focus, training, and grants, please refer to the website of the relevant school or department. 2. Graduate students are NOT allowed to be enrolled in more than one program or at more than one university at the same time. 3. Applicants should closely monitor the latest relevant information posted on the website or sent by the school or department to which they are applying. Applicants must read and follow the posted instructions and deadlines in a timely manner; all consequences resulting from the applicant’s personal negligence or other reasons shall be borne solely by the applicant. 4. For admission to Peking University’s Health Science Center, as well as for related scholarships, financial aid, accommodations, and other matters specific to medical graduate students, please consult the Center’s application guidelines at https://e.bjmu.edu.cn/. 5. Issues that may arise which are not mentioned here will be handled in accordance with the relevant regulations of the university and higher authorities. 6. If new admission policies for graduate students are issued in 2027, Peking University will make the necessary adjustments and promptly announce the changes. This scholarship program is provided to China's high-level universities for recruiting the outstanding young students from the Belt and Road partner countries to pursue degrees in China. I. When and Where to Apply Applicants should complete an Online Application on the website （ tju.at0086.cn/student ） according to the application schedule. Applicants should fill in the application information online, upload the application documents listed below to the Online Application System. Students who are admitted and nominated for the Chinese Government Scholarship-Silk Road Program need to log into the system of China Scholarship Council at http://www.csc.edu.cn/laihua/ within the specified time to submit the scholarship application (The Agency Number for Tianjin University is 10056; Choose Program Category Type B). Deadline for Application May 18 , 202 6 II. Supporting Categories and Scholarship Duration Program Specialty Duration Chinese Learning Duration Scholarship Duration Bachelor (taught in Chinese) 5 years 1 year 5 years Master (taught in Chinese) 2.5-3 years 1 year 2.5-4 years Master (taught in English) 2-3 years - 2-3 years PhD 3-4 years 1 year 3-5 years III. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be a citizen from Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Cambodia, Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh, Russia, Nigeria, Morocco. 2. Requirements for applicants’ degree and age: Applicant applying for a Bachelor degree should hold a High School diploma and be under the age of 25 ; Applicant applying for a Master degree should hold a Bachelor diploma and be under the age of 35 ; Applicant applying for a PhD degree should hold a Master diploma and be under the age of 40. Applicants shall be of good moral character, physically and mentally healthy, and willing to comply with Chinese laws and the regulations of Tianjin University. 3. Language Proficiency requirements: ① Chinese-taught programs applicants need to submit HSK5 certificates (Score 180 or above). (Native Chinese speakers or applicants taught in Chinese during master study may be exempted from the HSK test after certified by Tianjin University) ②English-taught programs applicants need to submit English proficiency certificate (Native English speakers are exempted). TOEFL: no less than 80, IELTS: no less than 6.0. （ Native English speakers are exempted. Applicants who obtained their highest diploma taught in English may provide a certificate of English instruction instead of IELTS or TOEFL certificate ） 4. Undergraduate applicants are required to take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) . IV. Scholarship Coverage 1. Tuition waiver and accommodation on campus; 2. Monthly Living Allowance: 2,500 RMB/month for Bachelor students; 3,000 RMB/month for Master students; 3,500 RMB/month for PhD students; 3. Comprehensive Medical Insurance. V. Program Catalogue （ Note: The listed majors for admission are for reference only. The specific majors to be officially approved are pending final confirmation . ） VI. Application Materials Please upload all listed documents below to the application system: 1. Scan Copy of High School ， Bachelor and Master Diploma. Scan of pre-graduation certificate is required if the applicants have not gained degree certificate before the application deadline, please resubmit the notarized copy of highest diploma before registration. 2. Scan of notarized copy of the High School ， Bachelor and Master academic transcripts (Applicants who will not graduate before the application deadline must provide their current academic transcript. In this case, the completed academic transcripts must be submitted before registration). 3. Scan of China Scholastic Competency Assessment （ CSCA ） transcript. (Only for Undergraduate Applicants) 4. Photocopy of passport within the validity period after September , 2026 . 5. Chinese or English Proficiency Certificate (for more requirements, please refer to Qualifications ) 6. Study Experience Resume (The start and end time of each education experience must be uninterrupted, and education level should start from senior middle school). 7. Form of Provisional Acceptance of International Student by TJU Professor (Required for Master and Ph.D applicants only, not compulsory, remember to upload it to the application system, if you get the Acceptance letter) . Please click here to get contacts of professors （ Master Program; PhD Program ） . 8. Study or research plan : for the Bachelor program ， no less than 600 words in English or Chinese ； for the Master program and Phd program ， no less than 1000 words in English or Chinese . 9. Two recommendation letters in English or Chinese from two professors or associate professors (Compulsory for Master&PhD applicants). 10. Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form (The medical examinations must cover all the items listed and should be conducted after October, 202 5 ). 11. Applicants who are now in China must submit scan of Photocopy of Visa . 12. Applicants must submit scan of Certificate of Non-Criminal Records . It should be valid within six months prior to the application date. 13. Applicants who are still under the age of 18 as of September, 202 6 must submit the original guardian certificate （ submit the original guardian certificate issued by the Tianjin District Notary Office, and the Guardian must be a permanent resident of Tianjin ） . 14. Applicants who have immigrated to other countries or whose parent is a Chinese national should provide proof of time for naturalization, proof of renunciation of Chinese nationality and a visa record of recent four years for entry and exit to China . 15. Applicants for Bachelor degree can submit award certificates; Applicants for Master and Ph D degree can submit published papers or formal acceptance notification and relevant certificates for participating in the research project （ Compulsory for PhD applicants ） . 16. Other attachments: (Scholarship applicants should submit CSC application form with signature, applicants of School of Architecture are requested to submit E-work Collection and Video Presentation etc. ） Template download link (please download the corresponding template according to your application program): https://sie.tju.edu.cn/en/DOWNLOAD/ADMISSIONSRELATED/ Application Remarks 1. All uploaded documents should be in Chinese or in English; otherwise notarial translations in Chinese or English are required. Once translated, the original documents and certified translations are to be submitted together to the application system. 2. Please scan the original or notarized application documents in color using a scanner. Images captured by mobile phone or camera are not acceptable. Copies are also not acceptable. 3. Applications with incomplete documents will not be processed. 4. TJU has the right to request the applicants to provide the original or notarized hard copies of application documents for further qualification checks if the uploaded documents are not sufficient. Applicants shall guarantee all the information and application documents submitted in this application are authentic and accurate, otherwise they will be disqualified from admission. VII. Admission Procedures ( All schedules and procedures are subject to change based on actual implementation requirements ) 1. Application: From now until May 18 , 202 6 2. TJU Review, interview and written examination: May to July , 202 6 ; ( Date and form of interview will be notified through the email of TJU online system. Please check your application system day by day. Applicants who fail to attend the interview are deemed to be giving up the application. ) 3. China Scholarship Council Review: Tianjin University will deliver materials of applicants who pass the TJU review to CSC and wait for the final admission results (the exact date is decided by CSC each year); 4. Result Release: Tianjin University will announce the admissio n result officially on website, and send Admission Notice and Visa Application Form for Study in China (JW201) to scholarship winners from July 1 to 31 , 2026 ; 5. Registration: from the end of August to the early September, 202 6 . VIII. nwpu-cup.text: ﻿ CSC-University Program-国际教育学院英文版 中文 Apply Now Home ABOUT US About Xi'an About NPU International College Offices Campus Maps Privacy Policy ADMISSIONS Undergraduate Program Master Program PhD Program Branch Campus of NPU in Kazakhstan Exchange Program Summer School(NPUGSS) Foundation Program Chinese Language Program Joint Training Program Winter Program Tuition Prospectus List of Academic School List of Majors Live Streaming Schedule Admission Documents Download Online Application SCHOLARSHIPS Chinese Government Scholarships NPU President Scholarship Xi’an City “The Belt and Road” International Students Scholarship PREARRIVAL GUIDE Guide for New Students Freguently Asked Questions Transportation Accomodation Registration CAMPUS LIFE Visa Services Accommodation Telecommunication Shuttle Bus Insurance Services Living Guide Regulations Counseling Center Recruitment Opportuinities Student Activities ACADEMICS Undergraduate Study Graduate Study Academic Calendar Download ALUMNI CSC-University Program Date of issue：2026-06-30 09:19:52 Hits： Chinese Government Scholarships -University Program In order to strengthen mutual understanding and friendship between the Chinese and people around the world and promote China’s exchange and cooperation with other countries in various fields, the Chinese government sets up scholarships for talented students and scholars to pursue higher education or conduct research in Chinese universities. The China Scholarship Council (hereinafter referred to as “CSC”), entrusted by China’s Ministry of Education, is responsible for the admission, enrollment and administration of Chinese Government Scholarship recipients. I. Scholarship Categories and Application The University P rogram (Type B) is designed to finance the study of talented international students in China that are directly and recommended by designated Chinese universities. l A pplication receiving agency for University Program : Applicants shall file the application with Northwestern Polytechnical University for this program. l NPU is offering the University Program to Master and PhD international students. l NPU agency number: 10699 l Program Category selection: Type B l Application deadline s : The first batch: November 1, 2026 - December 31, 2026, 17:00 (GMT+8). The second batch: January 1, 2027 - February 28, 2027, 17:00 (GMT+8). Note: The application deadlines refer to the closing date for submissions via the Online Application System of NPU. In accordance with the requirements of CSC, NPU will submit the list of recommended candidates for this project in batches. II. Supporting Categories, Duration, Institutions, and Majors 1. Supporting Categories The University Program sponsors Master and PhD in NPU . 2. Duration The University Program covers major study period . The duration of the scholarship for major study conforms to that as required. 3. Institutions and Majors The majors that NPU offers to University Program have limitation. Please visit the NPU Official Website for the details (Majors ends with * star marks): https://npuinternationalcollege.nwpu.edu.cn/zsxx/zszylb.htm . III. Scholarship and Coverage 1. Type of the scholarship Full scholarship covers the tuition fee, dormitory fee, stipend and medical insurance. Partial scholarship covers one or some items of the full scholarship. 2. Details of the coverage (1) Tuition fees; (2) University dormitory or accommodation subsidy; (3) Stipend: Master’s students/general scholars: CNY 3,000 per month; Doctoral students/senior scholars: CNY 3,500 per month. Within the scholarship duration, registered scholarship students will receive a stipend from their host university each month. Students registering on or before the 15th of the month will receive a full stipend of that month. Those who register after the 15th of the month will receive a half stipend of that month. If registered student stays out of China for more than 15 days due to a personal reason (school holidays excluded), his stipend will be suspended during the period of absence. (4) Comprehensive medical insurance: CNY 800 per person per year; Please visit http://www.csc.edu.cn/studyinchina or http://www.campuschina.org and refer to Comprehensive Insurance & Protection Scheme for Foreigners Staying in China for insurance policy. IV. Eligibility Applicants for University Program are required to fulfill the admission requirements of NPU in academic competence, English proficiency, supervisor ’ s acceptance and other relevant criteria . For details, please refer to: NPU Master program: https://studyat.nwpu.edu.cn/info/1303/8791.htm NPU PhD program: https://studyat.nwpu.edu.cn/info/1313/8831.htm V. Application Process Applicants must submit their applications for Chinese Government Scholarships University Program through NPU . 1. An applicant shall learn about the programs and majors NPU offer s by visiting websites : https://studyat.nwpu.edu.cn/; 2. Applicants shall prepare application documents in accordance with the application requirements and complete the online application via NPU Portal ( https://admission.nwpu.edu.cn/ ) no later than the deadline s . Incomplete or unqualified applications will be dismissed or rejected. The University Program applications not submitted through the NPU ’s official application portal will not be accepted ; 3. Applicants must undergo two rounds of material-review evaluation s , interviews and comprehensive assessment. NPU International Student Admissions Office will provide P re-admission Notice for candidates qualified for recommendation of this Program ; 4. An applicant shall fill in and submit the Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship online via the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System ( http://www.campuschina.org ). Please provide the CSC serial NO. to NPU International Students Admissions Office ( admission-pg@nwpu.edu.cn ) when finishing the CSC application. 5. NPU will review the CSC applications that are submitted by candidates of this program ; 6. NPU shall submit the recommended candidates list and their application documents to CSC in batches as required ; 7. CSC will organize designated universities and experts concerned to examine applicants’ eligibility and academic performance before finalizing the short-list candidates; 8. The CSC will notify NPU of the admission results, and NPU will then inform the applicants accordingly. Contact information: Postgraduate program: admission-pg@nwpu.edu.cn Please refer to the CSC official website for more detailed information: Chinese Government Scholarship: https://www.campuschina.org/zh/content/details1003_122933.html Should there be any change in the above content, the final interpretation from the International College of NPU shall prevail. Please pay attention to the website of the International College in time. Last： CSC-Type A Next： CSC Youth of Excellence Scheme of China Program 【 Close 】 Contact： Address: Room 718, Yizi Building, International College, Northwestern Polytechnical University, 127 Youyi Xilu, Beilin District, Xi’an, Shaanxi, China, 710072 Tel: Admission: +86-(29) 88494381 Academic: +86-(29) 88492721 International student office: +86-(29) 88495735 Fax: +86(0)29 88491544

Ⅰ . Introduction ● Enrollment Quotas , Categories and deadline 1.Dalian University of Technology (DUT) is recruiting Master's and PhD students for the Chinese Government Scholarship -High Level Postgraduate Program and Chinese Government Scholarship - Silk-Road Program for the year 2027. The duration of the scholarships study is three years for master's students and four years for doctoral students. 2 The language of instruction is generally Chinese, with some programs are available in English. 3. Scholarships are granted for the duration of the study period determined at the time of admission, including specialized studies, and will not be extended in principle. 4. Scholarship recipients shall be managed in accordance with the relevant regulations of the Chinese Government Scholarship. Scholarship recipients are not allowed to change their institutions of admission; in principle, they are not allowed to change their majors and duration of study after coming to China. ● Qualifications 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 2. Education background and age limit: - Applicants for master degree programs must received bachelor's degree and be under the age of 35. - Applicants for doctor degree programs must received master's degree and be under the age of 40. 3. Satisfy the appropriate language requirements for the speciality you are applying for. ● Scholarship C ontent 1. Exempt from tuition, free on-campus accommodation provided; 2. Monthly allowance is offered as followings: * Master Degree Students: 3,000 CNY/month * Doctor Degree Students: 3,500 CNY/month 3. Chinese Government Scholarship Comprehensive Medical Insurance provided. 4. International travel: self-sustained. Ⅱ . Application Time From November 1, 2026 to February 15, 2027. Ⅲ . Application Materials 1. Chinese Government Scholarship Application Form: The applicants for Chinese Government Scholarship should fill in the online application and print the application form and sign it after submitting it online. The CSC Online Application System for Study in China is available at http://www.campuschina.org Note ： When you fill in the online application, Agency No. of DUT is 10141. IF WE CANNOT CHECK YOUR INFORMATION IN ONLINE APPLICATION SYSTEM, YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE CANCELED. 2. DUT Application Form: Application website: http://iso.dlut.edu.cn IF WE CANNOT CHECK YOUR INFORMATION IN DUT ONLINE APPLICATION SYSTEM, YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE CANCELED. 3. Notarized highest diploma: If applicants are university students, they shall also provide studying certificates. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English. Applicants for PhD should provide undergraduate and master certificates. 4. Academic transcripts (From the undergraduate program onwards): Academic records from first to the last semester during the undergraduate, graduate (if any), and the doctoral programs (if any) shall be provided. The transcript shall be issued and sealed by the graduate university’s academic affairs office or student management department. Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English. 5. A study plan proposal (no less than 1000 words): The study plan proposal should write in Chinese or English. Please expatiate on the major or research field you would like to study at DUT, and sign by DUT supervisors. Pls refer to the attachment 1. 6. Two letters of recommendation by professors or associate professors from the university which applicants graduated: The letter should write in Chinese or English. These letters shall describe the applicant’s objectives of learning in China, comprehensive abilities, and evaluation of future growth. Pls refer to the attachment2. 7. Foreigner Physical Examination Form : The applicant should strictly follow the items required in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form , which must be completed in English. The Foreigner Physical Examination Form will be invalid if the following items are missing: pages, self-photo, a cross-page stamp over the photo and the form or a signature and a stamp of physician and hospital. The medical examination results are valid for 6 month. Pls refer to the attachment3. 8. Blood Test Report : The Blood Test Report should include results of HIV 、 Syphilis/V.D.R.L 、 HbsAg and HCV. 9. Photocopy of passport photo page and one blank visa page ： Ordinary passport expires after September 2027. 10. Language Proficiency certificates ： Chinese-Taught Program ， requirement of HSK Level and Score （ 2 years validity ） as following ： （ 1 ） Majors related to science, engineering, economics and management, the requirement is the new HSK test Level 4 and a minimum score of 180 ； （ 2 ） Majors related to humanities and foreign languages, the requirement is the new HSK test Level 5 and a minimum score of 180. English-Taught Program ， requirement of English proficiency certificate as following ： （ 1 ） To submit a TOEFL or IELTS or Duolingo transcript, in principle, the TOEFL score must be 80 or higher, and the IELTS score must be 5.5 or higher, and the Duolingo score must be 100 or higher ; （ 2 ） Certificate that the language of instruction in the previous stage is English; （ 3 ） Applicants from countries where English is the official language are exempt from certificate of English language proficiency; If the applicant cannot provide the above certificate, the supervisors and department could evaluate your language level according to the interview or written test. 11. Certificate of No-Criminal Conviction: The validity period is six months. If it is not possible to provide it at the application stage, the No Criminal Record Commitment in attachment 4 can be signed as a temporary substitute document. 12. Other Materials: （ 1 ） Acceptance Letter from DUT Supervisor (It is not obligatory): Applicants can first contact the Supervisor for assessment and receive a letter of acceptance. Please refer to the homepage of Dalian University of Technology for the contact information of the supervisor https://faculty.dlut.edu.cn/ (Chinese version), http://faculty-en.dlut.edu.cn/ (English version), please refer to attachment 5 for the template of the acceptance letter ; （ 2 ） If applicants are already employed, please provide employment certificate issued by the employer; （ 3 ） Applicants who are now in China should submit scan of Photocopy of Visa; （ 4 ） 1 photo （ 3cm * 4cm ） . Ⅳ . Application Procedures Chinese Government Scholarship applicants must submit the application on DUT website (http://iso.dlut.edu.cn/) and select the project "Scholarship". After successfully submitting your application, an application number will be generated on application page. If no application number is generated, please check the status of your submission. Note: If applicant applies for two or more scholarships at the same time, application forms for all types of scholarship programs must be uploaded in Scholarship Application Form section on the Scholarship system. Ⅴ . Application Guidance 1.Enrollment specialty directory Master: The directory of 2027 DUT International Student Master Programs (Chinese-Taught Master Majors) is listed in attachment 6. The directory of 2027 DUT International Student Master Programs (English-Taught Master Majors) is listed in attachment 7. P.hD: The directory of 2027 DUT International Student Ph.D Programs (Chinese-Taught Ph.D Majors) is listed in attachment 8. The directory of 2027 DUT International Student Ph.D Programs (English-Taught Ph.D Majors) is listed in attachment 9. 2. Materials List For the master's application materials list, pls refer to attachment 10; for the Ph.D application materials list, pls refer to attachment 11. Ⅵ . Admission Notice and Enrollment Time The admission notice will be issued to the applicants around July and August, 2027, and enrollment time will be September, 2027. Ⅶ . MOFCOM Scholarship Youth of Excellence Scheme... 2027 Application Guide for Chinese Government Scholarship - Chinese University Program in HUST Supporting Categories Master & Doctor Instruction Language Scholarship students can register for either Chinese-taught program or English-taught program if applicable , with good Chinese or English language proficiency. Scholarship Coverage This is a full scholarship which covers -tuition waiver; -accommodation; -stipend; -medical insurance When & How to Apply Please apply ONLINE between November 1st, 2026 and February 25th, 2027. Eligibility Outstanding academic performance and potential. Applicants for Master’s programs should have been conferred the Bachelor’s Degree, be under the age of 35; Applicants for Doctoral programs should have been conferred the Master’s Degree, be under the age of 40; Both should be equivalent to those of the Chinese related degrees. Language Proficiency English-medium Programs: Good command of English. TOEFL (≥80), IELTS (≥6.0), or Duolingo (≥120); other certificates of the same proficiency level which are accepted by HUST; Chinese-medium Programs: HSK 4 (Score ≥180) for programs of Science and Engineering, programs in the School of Stomatology, and the School of Pharmacy; HSK 5 (Score ≥180) for programs of Economics, Management, Literature, Law, Education, Interdisciplinary Studies, programs in the Second Clinical College (Tongji Hospital), and School of Medicine and Health Management HSK 5 (Score ≥200) for programs in the First Clinical College (Union Hospital). Applicants whose previous education was conducted in Chinese/English are exempt from submitting language certificate. Grade Point Average – 3.0 or above on a 4.0 scale; – 3.75 or above on a 5.0 scale; – 75 or above on a 100-point scale. Given the differences in grading systems across countries, HUST also accepts grades reported through other equivalent systems. The above are the minimum requirements for applicants, not equal to the selection/admission criteria decided by the school/department. Application Procedure Step 1. Apply at HUST Online Applicant System (Visit http://admission.hust.edu.cn ), submit the Academic Documents before February 25th, 2027 . Step 2. Pay the application fee after passing the online language test. Step 3. The application will be forwarded to the relevant school/department concerned for academic review. Step 4. Qualified applicants will be notified of the nomination by email and will receive guidance on the next steps in the Chinese Government Scholarship application process. Step 5. Upload the Non-Academic Documents and wait for the scholarship result. Application Documents Part 1. Academic Documents 1. Academic Certificate Highest degree certificate. Current students must submit a certificate of expected graduation or an enrollment certificate issued by the current institution. 2. Transcripts 3. Personal Statement Introduce yourself in details, including your understanding of China, your motivation for studying in China and your study plan at HUST. 4. Personal Introduction Video Please record and submit a video in English or Chinese within 60 seconds. 5. CV Including educational background, work experience, and publication list if available. 6. Study Plan/Research Proposal More than 1,000 words, written in Chinese or English. Structure: Title, Abstract, Introduction, Literature Review, Methodology, Research Significance, Reference. Details: Introductory background, Research questions, Aims/Objectives, Expected Outcomes, etc, and Future academic/career goals (Preferred). 7. Writing sample A written work submitted for either a grade or publication. Samples closely related to the intended field of study would be preferred in the review. 8. Language Proficiency Certificate 9. 2 Recommendation Letters Signed by your former professors/associate professors. 10. The Acceptance Letter issued by the prospective supervisor of HUST(optional) Required by certain schools, please refer to the Program List. Part 2. Non-Academic Documents 1. Passport 2. Physical Examination Form . 3. Certificate of Non-criminal Record A certificate issued by the police station or law enforcement agency certifying that you have no previous criminal record. 4. <Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship> Application Fee 800 CNY Please pay online after submitting your application, before February 25th, 2027. Chinese bank card (China UnionPay), Alipay, WeChat Pay, International bank card (VISA/Master) are accepted for online payment. Application without payment will be regarded as incomplete and will not be processed. The application fee is non-refundable once paid. tsinghua-guide.text: ﻿ Admission to Graduate Programs of Tsinghua University 2027（For International Students）-THU Graduate Admissions for International Students  中 Why THU Overview Beautiful Campus A Global University A Diverse Student Body Global Acclaim & Recognition Global Competence Programs Doctoral Degrees Master’s Degrees Joint Graduate Programs Graduate Programs in English Schools & Departments Short-term Research & Study Summer School Admissions How to Apply Evaluation and Admission Application Portal Frequently Asked Questions Download Costs Application Fee Tuition Fees Miscellaneous Expenses Financial Aid Financial Aid System Scholarship Application Frequently Asked Questions Contact Campus Life Accommodation Visa Application and Registration International Students & Scholars Center 中 News & Notice Home → News & Notice → Content 05 2026.09 Share   Admission to Graduate Programs of Tsinghua University 2027（For International Students） Tsinghua University (THU) offers Master's and Doctoral degree programs to international students across its 54 schools and departments ( 2027 program catalogs ) .Among these, 40 Master's and Doctoral degree programs are offered in English, while the rest are offered in Chinese or bilingually in Chinese and English. Required Qualifications of Applicants 1.Applicants must be foreign nationals who do not hold Chinese nationality under the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China. At the time of application, they must hold a valid foreign passport or other valid proof of foreign nationality. l Applicants who were formerly Chinese citizens and subsequently acquired foreign nationality must no longer hold Chinese nationality. As of April 30 of the year of enrollment, at least six (6) years must have elapsed since they became foreign nationals or acquired foreign nationality. l For applicants whose parent or parents are Chinese citizens and have settled abroad, who were born abroad, acquired foreign nationality at birth, and have never held Chinese nationality, the Chinese-citizen parent or parents must have obtained permanent residence in a foreign country by the time of the applicant’s birth. Applicants are required to submit application materials proving the above-mentioned circumstances in accordance with the requirements set out in Submission Instructions for International Graduate Applicants Regarding Nationality Status Documentation 2027 . If an applicant is found ineligible to apply, or if, before graduation or completion of studies, the applicant is determined not to qualify as an international student as defined in the Administrative Measures for the Enrollment and Cultivation of International Students by Schools (Order No. 42 jointly issued by the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Ministry of Public Security), the University will take action according to the stage at which the issue is discovered. If discovered at the application stage, the applicant’s application eligibility will be revoked; if discovered before enrollment, the applicant’s eligibility to enroll will be revoked; if discovered after enrollment, the applicant’s admission qualification or student status will be revoked; and if discovered after graduation or completion of studies, any academic credential or degree certificate already issued will be revoked in accordance with the law. 2.Master's degree program applicants should have a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent degree to a Bachelor's degree (or above) in China. Doctoral degree program applicants should have a Master's degree or an equivalent degree to a Master's degree (or above) in China. *39 schools/departments can accept bachelor degree holders to pursue their doctoral degrees directly. Please see the application requirements on ‘ Application Instructions for Bachelor's Degree Holders to Pursue Doctoral Degrees ' and the ‘ Catalog of Doctoral Programs for International Students 2027 '. The students who will enroll in 2027 must obtain the nationally recognized bachelor's or master's degree（for the universities of Chinese mainland）or the degree authentication report issued by Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange,Ministry of Education,P.R.China(CSCSE) (for overseas universities) before THU graduate student registration date of 2027, otherwise the admission qualification is invalid. 3.Applicants should be in good health and of good character(meet the physical examination requirements stipulated by the country and THU), be well-behaved and be willing to abide by China's laws and regulations, as well as Tsinghua's rules. 4.Language competence requirements: The applicant's Chinese or English proficiency should meet the language proficiency requirements announced by relevant schools/departments in the ‘Remarks of Application 'of Catalog of Graduate Programs 2027 '. 5.Some programs have specific requirements for applicants' working years, etc. For relevant information, please refer to the remarks in the Catalog and the Admissions Guide of the programs. Note: The applicant shall carefully check whether he / she meets the application qualification and application requirements (including the application requirements declared by the target school/department/major/program) before applying. The relevant consequences arising from his / her failure to meet the application qualification and application requirements shall be borne by the applicant himself / herself. How to Apply Applicants should complete an Online Application (Apply Now) during the designated THU application period. (Exceptions: applicants for Schwarzman Scholars programs, please apply on the specified websites). Applicants should fill in the application information online, upload the application documents listed below to the Online Application System, and pay the application fee online at the time of submission. Application Schedule The application period is generally from September to February of the following year , but the deadline and application batches vary among different departments and schools. Please refer to the "Remarks of Application" in the Catalog for the specified deadline and application arrangements of each department or school or program. ☆The winter break of THU will be from Jan 21,2027 to Feb 17,2027. The application system will still be available during the winter break, but online verification might be delayed due to the vacation. Applicants are therefore recommended to complete their application at least two or three weeks in advance. ☆Documents pertaining to nationality and identity status must be submitted by the specified deadline, and no supplementary materials will be accepted after the application period concludes. Application Documents Please submit all the documents listed below to the application system: 1.Personal statement The personal statement should be completed directly in the application system. PhD applicants are also required to upload a brief research experience or research plan. 2.Degree certificate and degree authentication Master's degree program applicants should submit their Bachelor's degree certificate. Doctoral degree program applicants should submit both their Master's and Bachelor's degree certificates.The degree diploma awarded by overseas universities should be authenticated by Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange,Ministry of Education,P.R.China（CSCSE). The degree diploma awarded by universities of Chinese mainland should be authenticated by Center for Student Services and Development,Ministry of Education,P.R.China（CSSD） . Applicants who will not graduate before the application deadline shall provide the expected graduation certificate first, and the degree diploma and degree authentication must be submitted before registration. (Applicants who have graduated are required to provide the degree authentication at the same time.) 3.Academic transcript Master's degree program applicants should submit the academic transcript of their undergraduate study. Doctoral degree program applicants should submit academic transcripts of both graduate and undergraduate studies.Applicants who will not graduate before the application deadline shall provide their current academic transcript.In this case,the completed academic transcript must be submitted before registration.If the uploaded transcript cannot directly show the total GPA score, the GPA certification document issued by the university is also required. 4.Language Proficiency Test score report For related requirements of HSK score report or English score report,please check the‘Remarks of Application 'of Catalog.Applicants who complete their undergraduate or master's studies in Chinese must provide a certificate issued by the university they graduated from. After obtaining the permission of the applied school/department, they can be exempted from submitting the HSK score certificate. Those who intend to apply for scholarships (such as the Chinese Government Scholarship) must provide corresponding HSK score reports according to the requirements of the scholarship application. 5.Two academic recommendation letters Academic Recommendation Letters from scholars who hold the title of associate professor or higher, or senior professionals in a related academic field. Please follow the instructions on the online system for submission of online recommendation letters or upload the recommendation letters signed by references. 6.Passport (personal ordinary-type passport):Passport bio page Applicants should present bio page of personal ordinary-type passport. Applicant who holds personal ordinary-type passport and diplomatic visa in China should also provide the scanned copy of diplomatic visa page. 7. Nationality Status Documentation Applicants must submit the required nationality status documentation by the specified deadline in accordance with the requirements set out in Submission Instructions for International Graduate Applicants Regarding Nationality Status Documentation 2027 . 8.Some programs may require additional application documents; please check the 'Remarks of Application 'of the catalog or the program admission brochures. 9.For information on the required documents for Bachelor degree holders who wish to pursue Doctoral degrees, please see the ‘ Application Instructions for Bachelor's Degree Holders to Pursue Doctoral Degrees '. Note：Use the online application to apply. The online application system offers tools for collecting and submitting some, but not all of ,the documents and information required for application. Application Remarks 1.Applicants are required to submit scanned images of all required documents at the time of application. All uploaded documents should be in Chinese or in English; otherwise notarial translations in Chinese or English are required. Once translated, the original documents and certified translations should be submitted together to the application system. 2.Please scan the original or notarized application documents in color using a scanner. Images captured by mobile phone or camera are not acceptable. Scans of copies are also not acceptable. 3.For inquiries regarding program details, application for supervisors and the'Remarks of Application'in the catalog, please contact the applying department or program office directly. For personal information of supervisors, please check on the departments'/ schools'websites. 4.The application fee must be paid at the time the application is submitted. (It cannot be covered by the Chinese Government Scholarship). Please apply online and pay the application fee in a safe place. THU is not responsible for any losses caused by your own operation errors or the leakage of your online payment account and password. Please consider carefully before paying the application fee online. If you cannot finish the application due to various reasons, the paid application fee will not be refunded. Regardless of whether the application is successful or not, the application fee is not refundable. 5.Applications with incomplete documents or without application fee payment will not be processed.Applicants should take the initiative to understand the application procedures and application requirements before applying. The applicant will be responsible for any consequences arising from failure to complete the application process as required. 6.THU has the right to require applicants to provide original application materials or authentication documents issued by a designated institution for further inspection. 7.As some countries' higher education systems are very different from the Chinese system, applicants from different education systems should refer to THU’s online application website for reference.Click here 8.None of the above application documents will be returned. 9.If the higher-level department issues a new policy, THU will make corresponding adjustments. 10.Applicants must ensure that the application information,application materials,degree certificate and degree authentication provided are true and accurate. If the admissions unit or certification department verifies that anything in the application is not true, the application, admission or study qualification will be cancelled. 11.Applicants who are found to be in breach of academic ethics, professional ethics, honesty and trustworthiness, discipline and law-abiding，etc., will not be admitted or admission/study qualification will be cancelled after this breach has been verified. 12.The relevant information, documents and messages that the THU Graduate Admissions Office and relevant departments / schools publish or send to applicants through websites, phone calls, emails, text messages, etc. are deemed to have been delivered. All consequences caused by the applicant’s personal negligence and other reasons shall be borne by the applicant himself/herself. Evaluation and Admission THU admits students based on evaluation of their application documents together with a comprehensive assessment. The application materials are reviewed by an expert group of the relevant departments / schools, and the candidates for the comprehensive assessment will be selected based on the review results. The comprehensive assessment is generally based on interviews. The specific content, format, requirements and time arrangements are determined by each department / school and will be notified to applicants who enter the comprehensive assessment. Tsinghua University comprehensively considers the results of material review,comprehensive assessment and other factors, selects the best candidates, and determines the admission list . A Certificate of Admission and the appendix will be issued by THU after the final admission result is released. Prior to this, applicants may check their admission status via the Application System .(For Schwarzman Scholars programs' applicants, please check the respective programs' websites). Scholarships At present, Tsinghua University mainly provides the following scholarships for outstanding prospective full-time international graduate students. Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS): The Full CGS usually covers tuition fees, free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy, stipend, and comprehensive medical insurance. The Partial CGS includes one or a few items covered by the Full CGS. Beijing Government Scholarship： The BGS usually covers tuition fees and comprehensive medical insurance with a duration of one academic year. For further information about scholarships, please click on‘ Financial Aid ’on the Graduate Admission Website. Accommodation Due to limited accommodation on campus, dormitory application must be made online on a first come first served basis. On-campus dormitories can only be reserved for full-time international students who successfully apply for rooms online. Those who fail to make it need to find off-campus accommodation by themselves. Detailed information regarding THU life, accommodation, student activities, visas and other useful information, is available on the International Students & Scholars Center website： http://is.tsinghua.edu.cn Visa Application and Registration Admitted students should apply for a student visa (X1 visa) at the Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China in their home country. To apply, students should provide their personal ordinary-type passport, Admission Notice and its Appendix, Confirmation Form for Study in China (JW201/JW202), and Physical Examination Record for Foreigners (applicants should confirm with the Chinese embassy/consulate for specific requirements). Students must enter China with an ordinary-type passport (nationality and personal information must be consistent with the passport information as applying) and X1 visa, and must apply for a Residence Permit within 30 days after arrival in China. Students are required to arrive at Tsinghua University and complete their university registration during the dates indicated in the admission package. Normally, registration is held in late August or early September. All students should present the required original degree certificates, and submit the degree authentication issued by THU designated institutions upon registration at Tsinghua University for enrollment qualification review. Students who fail the enrollment qualification review will be disqualified from enrollment and study at Tsinghua University. Costs (Unit: RMB Yuan) (1) Application Fee: RMB 800 (2) Tuition Fees of Graduate Program s : list of Tuition Fees 2027 (3) Accidental Injury and Hospitalization Insurance: RMB 800/year (4) Accommodation fee of student dormitories on Tsinghua campus, Beijing: RMB 40/bed/day per person for double rooms, RMB 30/bed/day per person for triple rooms. For accommodation on Tsinghua Shenzhen campus, please consult the Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School. Complaint Applicant who has any objection to the admissions process of the school/department, may file a complaint to the school/department in written form. The school/department should accept the complaint and respond. If the complainant disagrees with the reply, the complainant may appeal to the Graduate Admissions Office. Application Chinese-Taught English-Taught 2027 International Graduate Admissions Guide Please click here to download the International Graduate Admissions Guide in English Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) is one of China’s oldest and most prestigious institutions of higher education, renowned both in China and internationally. It is a national key university directly administered by the Ministry of Education of China and jointly supported by the Ministry and the Shanghai Municipal Government. With a history spanning more than 130 years, SJTU has developed into a comprehensive, innovative and internationally oriented university that ranks among China’s leading institutions and enjoys a global reputation. Its campuses, including Xuhui, Minhang, Huangpu, Changning, Pudong and Chongming, cover a total area of more than three million square meters. SJTU is authorized to award doctoral degrees in 57 first-level disciplines across 11 disciplinary categories: Economics, Law, Education, Literature, History, Science, Engineering, Agriculture, Medicine, Management and Interdisciplinary Studies. It is also authorized to award master’s degrees in 61 first-level disciplines across 12 disciplinary categories, as well as professional doctoral degrees in 16 categories and professional master’s degrees in 35 categories. SJTU offers graduate programs taught in Chinese or entirely in English to international applicants from around the world. Details of participating schools and programs are available in the SJTU 2027 International Graduate Program Catalog. Master’s programs normally take two to three years, and doctoral programs normally take four years. The specific duration is subject to the requirements of the program concerned. Students who complete the prescribed study plan, pass the thesis or dissertation review and defense, and fulfill all other graduation and degree requirements of their program will be awarded the corresponding graduation certificate and degree certificate. Note: The above figures are current as of October 2026. 1. Eligibility (1) Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens holding a foreign ordinary passport for private purposes. Note: Whether an applicant holds Chinese nationality is determined by the exit and entry administration authorities of China’s public security organs. If, during the application or admission process or after enrollment, an applicant is determined by the competent authorities to hold Chinese nationality, or is found not to meet the University’s eligibility requirements, the University will revoke the applicant’s eligibility to apply, admission offer, eligibility to enroll, or student status, as applicable to the stage concerned. (2) Applicants must be of good character and in good physical and mental health, and must meet the medical examination requirements prescribed by the Chinese authorities and the University. They should have an understanding of and a friendly attitude toward China, be willing to abide by Chinese laws and regulations and the University’s rules, and have no criminal record or record of other violations of laws, regulations or disciplinary rules. (3) Applicants for master’s programs must hold a degree equivalent to a Chinese bachelor’s degree. Applicants for doctoral programs must hold a degree equivalent to a Chinese master’s degree. Applicants in their final year of study who have not yet obtained the required degree may apply with a certificate of expected graduation issued by their university. They must obtain the degree required for their chosen program before registration and enrollment. (4) Some schools and programs accept applicants with a bachelor’s degree for direct entry to doctoral study. Specific eligibility requirements are set out in the admissions announcements and program catalogs issued by the relevant schools and programs. (5) Applicants must meet the applicable Chinese or English proficiency requirements specified in the Language Requirements for SJTU International Graduate Programs. 2. Online Application (1) Application Timeline Beijing Time November 5, 2026: Applications open. December 15, 2026: First-round application deadline for the Chinese Government Scholarship through the University. February 15, 2027: Final application deadline for the Chinese Government Scholarship through the University. March 31, 2027: Application deadline for the Shanghai Government Scholarship and SJTU Scholarships. May 31, 2027: Application deadline for self-funded applicants. (2) How to Apply Applicants must log in the University’s online application system for international students ( http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn ), complete the application form fully and accurately, upload all required documents, and submit their application. 3. Application Documents (1) Degree certificates and degree verification reports: Applicants for master’s programs must submit their original bachelor’s degree certificate. Applicants for doctoral programs must submit their original master’s and bachelor’s degree certificates. Applicants who obtained their degrees from universities outside the Chinese mainland are, in principle, required to submit a degree verification report issued by the Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange (CSCSE) , Ministry of Education of China. Applicants who obtained their degrees from universities in the Chinese mainland are, in principle, required to submit a degree verification report issued through CHSI (China Higher Education Student Information) , the official platform of the Center for Student Services and Development, Ministry of Education, China (CSSD). Note: Applicants in their final year of study may initially submit an official certificate of expected graduation issued by their university. The degree certificate and degree verification report must be submitted before enrollment and registration. Applicants who have already graduated should submit their degree verification reports at the time of application. (2) Academic transcripts: Applicants for master’s programs must submit authentic and complete undergraduate transcripts. Applicants for doctoral programs must submit authentic and complete transcripts for both their undergraduate and master’s studies. Applicants in their final year of study may initially submit their current transcripts and must provide their final transcripts before enrollment. If the uploaded transcripts do not directly show the overall grade point average (GPA), an official GPA statement issued by the university must also be provided. (3) Proof of language proficiency: Applicants must submit the documents specified in the Language Requirements for SJTU International Graduate Programs. (4) Passport: Applicants must submit a scanned copy of the biographical information page of their foreign ordinary passport for private purposes. The passport must remain valid for at least 12 months from the expected date of enrollment. Applicants whose passports do not meet this requirement should obtain a new passport promptly and use the new passport to complete their application. (5) Identification photo: The photo must be in JPG format, with a file size of less than 200 KB, a width of at least 295 pixels and a height of at least 413 pixels. (6) Personal statement and research plan: Applicants for doctoral programs must additionally upload a brief account of their research experience. (7) Two letters of recommendation: Referees should be academics holding the rank of associate professor or an equivalent or higher position, or senior professionals in a relevant industry. (8) Letter of Intent for Supervision from an SJTU Supervisor: Applicants to the following schools and institutes must submit this letter in accordance with the requirements for the relevant degree level and school or institute. Doctoral programs: School of Mechanical Engineering; School of Computer Science; School of Integrated Circuits (School of Information Science and Electronic Engineering); School of Materials Science and Engineering; School of Mathematical Sciences; School of Physics and Astronomy; School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology; School of Biomedical Engineering; School of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering; School of Humanities; KoGuan School of Law; School of Foreign Languages; School of Agriculture and Biology; School of Pharmaceutical Sciences; Tsung-Dao Lee Institute; School of Design; College of Smart Energy; Antai College of Economics and Management; SJTU Paris Elite Institute of Technology; School of Oceanography; School of Psychology; Global Institute of Future Technology; School of Ocean and Civil Engineering; School of International and Public Affairs; School of Medicine. Master’s programs: School of Mechanical Engineering; School of Computer Science; School of Integrated Circuits (School of Information Science and Electronic Engineering); School of Materials Science and Engineering; School of Mathematical Sciences; School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology; School of Biomedical Engineering; School of Agriculture and Biology; School of Pharmaceutical Sciences; Tsung-Dao Lee Institute; SJTU Paris Elite Institute of Technology; College of Smart Energy; School of Oceanography; School of Psychology; School of Ocean and Civil Engineering; School of Medicine. Applicants to the relevant programs in the schools and institutes listed above must obtain a Letter of Intent for Supervision before submitting their application, in accordance with the requirements of the school or institute concerned. Contact details are available in the Contact Information for Schools and Institutes Offering International Graduate Programs in 2027. Note: All certificates, verification reports and supporting documents uploaded must be originals in Chinese or English. Documents issued in other languages must be uploaded together with notarized translations into English or Chinese. Documents must be scanned in color using a scanner. Photographs taken with a mobile phone or camera, and photocopies, are not accepted. 4. Fees (1) Application fee: RMB 800. Applicants should ensure that their application documents are complete and accurate before paying the application fee. The application fee is non-refundable. (2) Tuition: Tuition fees for individual programs are listed in the SJTU 2027 International Graduate Program Catalog. 5. Enrollment Enrollment is scheduled for September 2027. Admitted students must report to the University in person and complete registration and enrollment procedures in accordance with their Admission Notice and the guide for new students. 6. Scholarship Applications Scholarships for international doctoral students comprise Honorary Scholarships, Government Scholarships and SJTU Scholarships. Scholarships for international master’s students comprise Government Scholarships, SJTU Scholarships, SJTU Tuition Waiver Scholarships and School Scholarships. Details of scholarship amounts and funding periods are available in the application system ( http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn ). (1)Eligibility (a) Applicants must meet the eligibility requirements for SJTU international graduate programs. (b) Applicants must not be receiving any other form of scholarship funding. (c) Applicants for doctoral study must be no older than 40. (d) Applicants for master’s study must be no older than 35. (2) Application Timeline Beijing Time November 5, 2026: Applications open. December 15, 2026: First-round application deadline for the Chinese Government Scholarship through the University. February 15, 2027: Final application deadline for the Chinese Government Scholarship through the University. March 31, 2027: Application deadline for the Shanghai Government Scholarship and SJTU Scholarships. (3) How to Apply Applicants may apply for scholarships either through the University or through a Chinese embassy or consulate abroad. Applicants may choose only one of these two channels. (a) Applying through the University Eligible applicants must select the “Apply for scholarships through the University” option in the application system ( http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn ). After the application deadline, the University will assess applicants’ documents and determine scholarship award levels in accordance with the applicable regulations and requirements. Applicants must complete the relevant scholarship application procedures by the deadlines specified in the University’s notifications. Please note the following: Applicants for the Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B) must enter SJTU’s Agency Number, 10248, in the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System. Applicants who are not nominated by the University for the Chinese Government Scholarship will automatically be considered for the Shanghai Government Scholarship and SJTU Scholarships. (b) Applying through a Chinese Embassy or Consulate Abroad Eligible applicants are encouraged to give priority to applying for the Chinese Government Scholarship (Type A) through a Chinese embassy or consulate abroad. Please contact the relevant embassy or consulate directly for information on eligibility, application procedures, required documents, the Agency Number, scholarship subcategories and any other requirements. Contact details are available on the website of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China ( https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/web/ ). Note: Applicants applying for scholarships through this channel must also complete their application in the University’s online application system for international students (http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn ) by the applicable deadline and in accordance with this guide. (4) Scholarship Results Applicants may check their scholarship results in the application system ( http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn ). The University will not issue separate written notifications of scholarship results. (5) Additional Information (a) Scholarship funding periods will not normally be extended. All scholarship recipients must undergo an annual review as required. (b) Annual review requirements and disbursement policies for the Chinese Government Scholarship are subject to the notices and regulations issued by the authorities responsible for administering the scholarship. (c) SJTU Scholarships, SJTU Tuition Waiver Scholarships and School Scholarships may cover all or part of the tuition fees. The specific coverage is subject to the funding package confirmed by the University or the relevant school. (d) Students may reserve on-campus accommodation as needed or arrange their own accommodation off campus. The University provides accommodation allowances according to the scholarship award level. 7.
