Application Qualification 1. Non-Chinese citizens in good health; 2. Age: The maximum age for applicants for master's degrees is 35; the maximum age for applicants for doctoral degree is 40; 3. Students participating in joint development programs are not eligible; 4. No other kinds of Chinese government scholarships have been obtained at the same time. II. Scholarships and Standards Full coverage on tuition fee, free on Comprehensive Medical Insurance and living allowance (postgraduate student: 3000 RMB/month, Doctoral student: 3500 RMB/month) ； Free on-campus accommodation, if the on-campus accommodation is full and you need to arrange off-campus accommodation by yourself, you can apply for off-campus accommodation subsidy (postgraduate student: RMB 700/month students, Doctoral student: RMB 1000/month) 。 III. Application Period Fall 2026 (August/September) admission, application period October 25, 2026 - December 20, 2026 IV. Application Procedure 1. The applicant must submit an application to the online application system of Tongji University (http://study-info.tongji.edu.cn/) before 23:59 (Beijing time) on December 20, 2026 for the Chinese Government Scholarship and pay the application fee. The online application system will not accept modifications or supplementary materials after the deadline. Simultaneously, the applicant must log in to the online application system for studying in China of China Scholarship Council (https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login) to complete the online application, and download the Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (overseas study program type: B, Tongji University's organization code: 10247) ( Please refer to the annex for the operation process and material list of the Chinese government scholarship application system .). Application fee: RMB600 (non-refundable) Payment method: ① Online payment in the online application system; ② For offline bank or online bank remittance, the remittance voucher needs to be uploaded to the application system. Bank Account: [Chinese account] For payment accounts in China: Beneficiary: Tongji University ( 同济大学 ) Beneficiary Bank Account No.: 033267-00812000848 Beneficiary Bank: Shanghai Wujiaochang Sub-branch of Agricultural Bank of China Bank Number: 103290035039 Address: No.1128 Xiangyin Road, Yangpu District, Shanghai [Foreign account] For overseas payment accounts: Beneficiary: TongJi University Beneficiary Bank: Bank of China, Shanghai Branch Yangpu Sub-branch Address: No.83 Chifeng Road, Shanghai, 200092, China Beneficiary Bank Account No.: 433859245525 SWIFT Code: BKCHCNBJ300 2. After our review, the applicant's application status in the online application system of Tongji University becomes "Waiting for Admission"; 3. The school will issue the electronic admission notification to the applicants who are "Waiting for Admission" in the application system; 4. After receiving the notification, the applicant should log in to the online application system for studying in China of China Scholarship Council (https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login) within the time frame notified by the school to upload the pre-admission notice. V. Application Materials For university application materials, please refer to the enrollment brochure of each program. For scholarship application materials and the scholarship system application guide, please see the attachments. MA: /system/go.jsp?treeid=1077&apptype=content&urltype=news.NewsContentUrl&param=wbnewsid%3D1235 PhD: https://study.tongji.edu.cn/en/ADMISSION/Doctoral_Programs/Enrollment_Guide.htm Note: Only electronic application materials need to be uploaded in the application system at the application stage. Failure to submit the application materials that meet the above requirements within the specified time limit will be regarded as a failure of the application. If accepted, please make sure to bring the original paper version of the application materials for verification when reporting to the university. If you are unable to submit, or the materials do not match, you will be disqualified from enrollment. VI. Review and Admission Process 1. Tongji University adopts a material review system for admission and organizes written examinations or interviews for each college. We perform evaluations according to the overall capabilities of the students and select the best candidates for admission. 2. After submitting the application, the applicant must regularly check the information and application status in the application system and complete each step strictly as prompted. If the follow-up process is delayed due to failure to check a notification in time, the applicant is responsible for the delay. 3. After the school submits the recommended list to the China of China Scholarship Council (CSC), the CSC will organize experts in relevant disciplines to review the applicants' academic performance, comprehensive capabilities, development potential, and other aspects, and select the best candidates for admission. Applicants who have not been admitted will be transferred to other scholarship programs and self-funded programs at the University based on the individual's intention to fill out the application. 4. The International Student Office of Tongji University will inform applicants of the admission results. The university will not provide explanations for applications that do not pass the review. VII. Other Information Scholarship winners: 1. Accepted candidates must go to a Chinese embassy (consulate) abroad to apply for a study visa, with their ordinary passport, Tongji University Admission Notice , and the Visa Application Form for Foreign Students Studying in China (JW202). The candidates must take the above-mentioned materials and go to Tongji University to apply for admission at the time specified in the notice, and apply for a residence certificate in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Exit-Entry Administration Bureau of Shanghai Public Security Bureau. Those who fail to report within the time limit without approval will automatically lose their student status as well as their scholarship qualification. You can visit the “Orientation” column of the school website for the admission instructions. 2. You need to participate in the annual review of scholarships as required. Those who fail in the evaluation will be suspended or disqualified from the scholarship. 3. In principle, the major and the study period cannot be changed. 4. Applicants who have applied to other universities in the Chinese Government Scholarship Management Information System should not apply to Tongji University. VIII. Contact Information Tongji University International Student Office Address: Room 705, Zhong He Building, No.1239 Siping Road, Yangpu District, Shanghai, P.R. Working hours: Monday through Friday 8:00-11:30, 13:30-17:00 (Beijing time) WeChat group for admission consultation: Please visit： https://study.tongji.edu.cn/info/1105/2030.htm to view the group's QR code. Application Period 2027 Application Opens: November 1 st , 2026 The Deadline for Application: February 20 th , 2027 II. Supporting Categories HIT Chinese Government Scholarship Programs sponsor master's and doctoral degree students. III. Scholarship Coverage 1. Tuition fee & on-campus dormitory fee . 2. Comprehensive medical insurance: CNY 8 00/year . 3. Monthly living allowance: No stipend is issued before arrival at the university. Master's degree students: CNY 3,000/month Doctoral degree students: CNY 3,500/month IV. Scholarship Duration 1. The standard study duration for Master’s programs is 3 years, with exceptions for certain faculties as listed below: • 2 years: School of Management , Business School, School of Instrumentation Science and Engineering • 2.5 years: Faculty of Computing 2. The duration of doctoral degree programs typically takes 4 years. V. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be in good physical and mental health . 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens and comply with requirements specified in Ministry of Education Notice Document No.12 (2020) of P.R.China.（ http://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A20/moe_850/202006/t20200609_464159.html ） Note: If an applicant is confirmed to hold Chinese nationality by Chinese public security authorities at any stage (application, admission or after registration), their application, admission or enrollment qualification will be revoked, and the College of International Education (CIE) reserves the right to dismiss the applicant from the university. 3. Academic & Age Requirement: Master's Programs: Applicants must hold a bachelor' s diploma. Applicants shall be under 35 years old. Doctoral Programs: Applicants must hold a master' s diploma. Applicants shall be under 40 years old. 4. Consciously abide by the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China and the rules and regulations of the university. 5 . No Double Benefits Allowed - Students cannot receive multiple scholarships. VI. Application Documents 1. Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (in Chinese or English) is available at http://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/ . 2. Scanned bio-page of valid passport (passport expiry date shall be later than September 2027). 3. Scanned copy of original or notarized degree certificates from undergraduate level onwards (expected graduation certificate is acceptable for prospective graduates; the scanned original or notarized highest degree certificate must be submitted after admission) 4. Scanned original or notarized full academic transcripts covering all studies since undergraduate enrolment; partial transcripts are acceptable for prospective graduates, with full transcripts to be submitted upon admission. 5. Language proficiency certificate (must match the instruction language of your target program): Chinese-taught Programs: Valid HSK Level-4 score ≥ 210 (valid for 2 years). Applicants with a Chinese-medium instruction background may provide an official medium-of-instruction certificate issued by their previous university instead of an HSK score report; English-taught Programs: IELTS ≥ 6.0 (no individual band below 5.5), TOEFL iBT ≥ 80, or other equivalent English proficiency credentials. Applicants with an English-medium instruction background may provide an official medium-of-instruction certificate issued by their previous university. Native-English-speaking applicants are exempted from submitting English test scores. 6. Study Plan ( the template is below ； minimum 1,500 words, to be written in Chinese or English). 7. Two recommendation letters (referees to be professors or associate professors, including a comprehensive evaluation of the applicant ' s study objectives, overall competence and future development potential). 8. Physical Examination Record for Foreigners ( the template is below ) . Valid within six months. Incomplete forms, forms without hospital stamp, physician signature or sealed photo will be deemed invalid. 9. Non-criminal record report, issued within six months before submission. 10. Supervisor Acceptance Letter (optional, the template is below; applicants are encouraged to contact supervisors beforehand.) 11. For applicants currently studying in China: scan of passport visa page + official school performance certificate issued by your present institution. 12. Optional: Supporting materials including award certificates and research achievements. Important Note: 1. All application materials must be in Chinese or English . For materials in other languages, notarized translations must be provided. 2. All materials must be uploaded to the HIT online application portal. Hard-copy documents will NOT be accepted. 3. Applications will not be processed unless the application fee has been paid online. 4. If an applicant is found to have submitted false information or fraudulent materials, the admission offer will be revoked, and the applicant shall bear all resulting consequences. 5. Applicants are NOT permitted to apply for more than one scholarship program simultaneously. Any duplicate applications will result in the cancellation of admission. VII. Application Procedures S tep 1: Login Chinese Government Scholarship Application System : http://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/ and complete the application, download the CSC Application Form. Program Category Type: B HIT's University Code: 10213 S tep 2: Complete online application via HIT International Student Application Portal: https://apply.hit.edu.cn/ . Upload the CSC Application Form and other required documents, and pay the application fee. Step 3: Short-listed applicants will proceed to the interview assessment. The exact schedule will be notified via email. Note: Please use your own valid email address for system registration. All application-related notifications will be sent to this mailbox by the Admission Office. VIII. Admission and Notification 1. HIT can adjust the selected majors and study duration according to the applicant's educational background and study plan. If the applicant's conditions or application documents do not meet the provisions or requirements, the application shall be considered invalid and not accepted. 2. Scholarship recipients shall read carefully the information in the admission letter. Upon arrival in China, the university will not entertain any applications for inter-university transfer, transfer between schools or majors, or changes to study duration, medium of instruction or supervisor. IX. Program is designed to finance the study of talented international students in China that are directly recommended by designated Chinese universities. I. Supporting Categories, Duration and Instruction Language (1) Supporting Category: The University Program supports undergraduate students and graduate students. (2) Duration: The duration of scholarship funding corresponds to the length of the major study as determined at the time of admission. (3) Instruction Language: Chinese or English. II. Where and When to Apply (1) Agency Name: Beijing Normal University (2) Agency Number: 10027 (3) When to apply: Applicants need to apply between November and March. III. Scholarship Coverage and Standard (1) Tuition (2) Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy (3) Stipend (4) Comprehensive medical insurance Please refer to Application Guide for Chinese Government Scholarship (https://www.campuschina.org/scholarships) for details of each item. IV. Applicants Qualification (1) The applicant should meet the requirements of BNU Admission Brochure for International Students. (2) The University does not provide preparatory Chinese language courses for the applicants of Chinese-taught degree programs. Please submit the HSK certificate according to the admission requirements of your program. (3) Applicants should not be holding any other scholarships. (4) The requirements for applicants' degree and age are that applicants must: Be a high school graduate and no more than 25 when applying for the undergraduate programs. Be a bachelor's degree holder and no more than 35 when applying for the master's programs. Be a master's degree holder and no more than 40 when applying for the doctoral programs. V. Application Procedure (1) Please follow the instruction of BNU admission information for international students and prepare the application documents. Please log on to the "BNU International Student Application System" (https://international.bnu.edu.cn/) to complete an online application. (2) Read carefully the Instructions for Chinese Government Scholarship Information System ; Register on the website of CSC (http://www.csc.edu.cn/studyinchina or http://www.campuschina.org) ; complete, print and sign the Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship. To apply through the Chinese University Program as a new student, please choose Type B; the Agency number for Beijing Normal University is 10027. * Please note: re-submission of the form is required if you have made any modification. (3) Submit the required paper application documents to Beijing Normal University before the deadline. VI. Application Documents (1) Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (filled in online). (2) Applicants are required to submit a clear scanned copy of the information page of their ordinary passports. If the validity period of the currently held passport is less than 12 months (calculated from the expected start date of study), please renew the passport and use it to complete the scholarship application. An applicant who fails to apply for a passport due to objective reasons may submit valid documentation or documentary evidence that carries information about the full English name, gender, nationality and date of birth of the applicant upon the approval of the application receiving agency. (3) Diploma and certificate of highest education (notarized photocopy). An applicant who is a current university student shall submit the certificate of expected graduation or student status issued by his/her university. (4) Academic records. Academic records in languages other than Chinese or English shall be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English. (5) Certificate of language proficiency. When applying for a Chinese-taught program, an applicant shall provide a valid HSK score report that meets the program's language ability requirements. When applying for a program taught in a language other than Chinese, an applicant shall provide a certificate of proficiency in the language as required by the designated university, such as the IELTS or TOEFL test report. (6) CSCA Score Report. Applicants seeking to pursue a bachelor's degree must register for and take the CSCA before the application deadline, and submit a valid CSCA Report. (7) Language qualification certificates. Applicants for master's, doctoral, general scholar, and senior scholar programs taught in Chinese must submit a valid HSK score report that meets the corresponding Chinese language proficiency requirements. Applicants for programs taught in other languages are required to provide relevant language proficiency certificates, such as IELTS or TOEFL score reports, in accordance with the requirements of each university. (8) A study or research plan written in Chinese or in English (no less than 200 words/characters for undergraduates; no less than 500 words/characters for scholars; no less than 1000 words/characters for postgraduates). (9) Recommendation letters. An applicant for a postgraduate program or for academic education as a senior scholar shall submit two recommendation letters in Chinese or in English from professors or associate professors. An applicant for a undergraduate program shall submit a recommendation letter from a teacher, head teacher, or school leader of the high school. Signature of the referee is required. (10) An applicant for the arts or design program shall provide his/her own works (such as videos and paintings). (11) An applicant under the age of 18 shall submit the legal documents of his/her legal guardian(s) in China. (12) An applicant to study in China for more than six months shall submit a photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form (the original document, printed by Chinese quarantine authorities, shall be filled in in English and kept by the applicant). The medical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form . Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicant are invalid. Medical examination results are valid for only six months. (13) An applicant shall submit a valid Certificate of Non-Criminal Record (or Police Clearance Certificate) issued by the local public security (such as the police station), usually issued within six months prior to the submission date of the application. Attention: (1) Applicants must submit application documents that meet the requirements of both the Beijing Normal University admissions brochure and the Chinese Government Scholarship Application Documents List . (2) If the applicant has not obtained the Pre-admission Letter issued by BNU when filling in the Chinese Government Scholarship Application System, he/she can temporarily complete the application without submitting this document. However, after the applicant has obtained the Pre-admission Letter issued by BNU, he/she must submit it to the Chinese Government Scholarship Application System as soon as possible. VII. Admission and Scholarship Results (1) BNU will review the application documents and decide the nominated candidates. Nominated candidates will get Chinese Government Scholarships to study in China with approval of the CSC. (2) CSC reserves the rights to decide the host university for scholarship recipients with multiple offers. Each scholarship recipient—even when admitted by multiple universities—will be granted no more than one scholarship. (3) Scholarship recipients shall not be allowed to change their host university, field of study, or duration of study stipulated on the Admission Letter after their coming to China. (4) Scholarship will not be reserved if scholarship recipient cannot register before the registration deadline. (5) If scholarship recipients fail to pass the Physical Examination after registration, the admission and scholarship qualification will be withdrawn. (6) According to the regulations of CSC, annual evaluation will be required for all CSC scholarship recipients. Students who pass the evaluation will be qualified for scholarship next year. VIII. Well performed both academically and behaviorally. Degree Requirement Applicants who apply for doctoral program should have master's degree and be under 40 years old. Language Requirement Chinese-taught programs applicants should have HSK Level 5 over 180 or HSK Level 6 over 180 (details refer to the application guide ). Applicants of Chinese-taught programs without the adequate Chinese proficiency, should take Chinese language courses for one to two academic years to reach the language requirements of their host universities. These period of Chinese language study can be sponsored by China Scholarship Council (CSC). Failure to reach the required language proficiency will lead to the automatic termination of scholarship. English-taught programs applicants should have effective English Proficiency Test Certificate or official proof of taking English-taught programs (details refer to the application guide ). Native English speakers do not need to submit the English Certificate. 3 Scholarship Coverage Exempt from tuition fee and school accommodation fee. Stipend: PH.D 3500 RMB/month Within the scholarship duration, registered scholarship students will receive a stipend from their host university each month. Students registering on or before the 15th of the month will receive a full stipend of that month. Those who register after the 15th of the month will receive a half stipend of that month. Graduating students will receive stipend until half month after the graduation date. If registered student stays out of China for more than 15 days in one month due to personal reasons (school holidays excluded), monthly stipend will be stopped during the leaving month(s). Provide comprehensive medical insurance. 4 Application Deadline First Batch: March 1st, 2025 Second Batch: May 15th, 2025 5 Application Procedures Step 1: Apply Online 1. Submit ECNU online application and pay application fee Applicant should register and apply online through http://lxsapply.ecnu.edu.cn/ . Submit online application and pay application fee. 2. Submit CSC online application Applicant should register and apply online through https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login (the institutional code of ECNU is 10269, and the scholarship type is Type B). Submit online application and download the application form. Application Documents For Ph.D. Programs please refer to: Graduate Programs Note 1) Application documents sent by email or fax are not accepted. 2) Incomplete applications with missing documents or failing to pay the application fee are not accepted. 3) Application documents and application fee will not be returned or refunded regardless of admission status. 4) Applicants DO NOT need to send the hard copy of the application documents by post. ECNU has the right to require applicants to provide original application materials or authentication documents issued by a designated institution for further inspection. Step 2: Track Application Status Online Check your email or log in to your ECNU online application account to track your application status. * Make sure your email address is correct and check your email regularly to avoid missing IMPORTANT INFORMATION such as interview arrangements. Step 3: Admission and University Enrollment Adminssion results will be announced through the ECNU application account. Admitted students must register on time with the original graduation certificate and degree certificate. Registration will be canceled if failure to provide the original certificate. 6 Disclaimer Applicants will be disqualified from application in case of fraudulent application materials. Scholarship winners who cannot register with the host institutions on time should inform the host institution about the reasons in written form within 15 days before the registration date. For those who do not register as requested without valid reason, the scholarship will be canceled. Scholarship will be canceled for those who do not pass the admission physical examination, drop out, or take schooling suspension during the study. 7 Contact Us Global Education Center (GEC) of ECNU Address: GEC Reception Hall, 2nd Floor of Gezhi Building (Physics Building), 3663 Zhongshan North Road, 200062 Contact Phone Number: +86-21-62232013 E-mail: lxs@ecnu.edu.cn 8 Download FOREIGNER PHYSICAL EXAMINATION FORM.pdf Connect with East China Normal University newsletter_email Email cannot be empty Email format error Office of International Education Internation Students Office Add: Room 253, Gezhi Building, 3663 North Zhongshan Road, Shanghai, China, 200062 Tel: +86-21-62232013 +86-21-62238353 Fax: 86-21-62238352 E-mail: lxs@ecnu.edu.cn Useful Links ECNU Homepage ECNU Integrated Information Service Platform ECNU Calendar Library Shuttle Bus International Services Shanghai China Scholarship Council Exit-Entry Administration Bureau of Shanghai Security Bureau Shanghai International Travel Healthcare Center Center For Language Education and Cooperation Study in Shanghai Copyright © East China Normal University Office of International Education All Rights Reserved Back to Top

Applicant Qualifications 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens. 2. In good physical and mental health, with excellent academic performance and conduct, and in compliance with Chinese laws, regulations, and university rules. 3. Not concurrently funded by any other Chinese government or institutional scholarship. 4. Educational and age requirements: — Master’s program: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) with excellent academic record; under 35 years old. — Doctoral program: Master’s degree (or equivalent) with excellent academic record; under 40 years old. 5. Language requirements: — Chinese-taught programs (meet one of the following): 1) HSK Level 5 ≥ 180; or 2) Degree obtained from a Chinese university with Chinese as the language of instruction (HSK exempt). — English-taught programs (meet one of the following): 1) TOEFL ≥ 80 or IELTS ≥ 6.0; 2) English is the native/official language; 3) Degree obtained with English as the medium of instruction. II. Majors NENU Master’s and Doctoral Programs for International Students 2026 ( Click to view ) III. Scholarship Coverage 1. Tuition and on-campus accommodation fees are waived. 2. Monthly living allowance in China: RMB 3,500/month for Ph.D. students and RMB 3,000/month for Master’s students. 3. Comprehensive medical insurance during the study period in China. IV. Application Deadline From now until February 22, 2026 (Beijing Time) V. Application Procedures Step 1 : Apply via the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System Visit http://www.campuschina.org to register an account. Select Program Category Type B and enter Agency Number 10200 (Northeast Normal University). Complete the required information, submit the application online, and download the Chinese Government Scholarship Application Form. Please refer to the Application Guide for details. Step 2 : Apply via the NENU International Student Service System Log in to http://studyatnenu.nenu.edu.cn or https://nenu.17gz.org to complete and submit the online application. Please refer to the Application Guide for details. Once submitted, the application cannot be modified. Step 3 : Review and Interview NENU will review each applicant’s academic background, language proficiency, and professional competence, and organize online interviews for qualified candidates. Interview notifications will be sent via email. Step 4 : Preliminary Review and Nomination By mid-March 2026, NENU will complete the preliminary review, confirm the list of nominated candidates, and send Pre-admission Notices via email. Step 5 : Upload Pre-admission Notice and Supplementary Materials Nominated candidates must log back into the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System ( http://www.campuschina.org ) within the specified time to upload the Pre-admission Notice and supplementary materials as instructed by NENU’s email. Failure to complete this step on time will result in disqualification. Step 6 : Final Evaluation and Admission Based on the principle of “individual application–institutional recommendation–expert review–merit-based admission,” the China Scholarship Council will conduct a comprehensive evaluation of each candidate’s academic performance, overall competence, and development potential, and admit the best-qualified applicants. VI. Application Documents 1. Chinese Government Scholarship Application Form . To be completed online in Chinese or English. 2. Passport information page and all Chinese visa pages (if any). The passport must be valid beyond September 2026. 3. Notarized degree certificates (from the undergraduate level onward) . Current students must submit a Certificate of Expected Graduation issued by their university. Applicants must obtain the required degree before September 2026. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be accompanied by notarized translations into Chinese or English. 4. Academic transcripts (from the undergraduate level onwa rd) . Scanned copies must include all study records (bachelor’s, master’s, and doctoral, if any) up to the latest semester, issued and stamped by the academic affairs office, graduate school, or student management department. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be accompanied by notarized translations into Chinese or English. 5. Language proficiency certificate . Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must provide a valid HSK Level 5 certificate (≧180 points) or proof of a degree obtained in Chinese-medium instruction at a Chinese university. Applicants for English-taught programs must provide a TOEFL score of 80 or above, or IELTS score of 6.0 or above, or proof of an English-medium degree. 6. Research proposal . A research proposal in Chinese or English (minimum 1000 words) is required. For doctoral applicants, it must be signed by the intended NENU supervisor. Template available at the Download section of the Studyatnenu website ( https://iso.nenu.edu.cn/Download.htm ) 7. Two recommendation letters. Written only in Chinese or English by professors or associate professors shall be submitted. The letters should be signed by the recommenders and indicate their identity and contact information. These letters shall describe the applicant's objective of learning in China, comprehensive abilities, and evaluation of future growth, as well as the cooperation between the supervisors or the exchange between universities both in China and abroad. 8. Portfolio (if applicable). Applicants for arts or design majors should submit samples of personal work (such as videos or artwork). 9. The Physical Examination Form for Foreigners. The Form is issued by the Chinese quarantine authority and must be completed in English. Template available at the Download section of the StudyatNENU website( https://iso.nenu.edu.cn/Download.htm ). The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Form. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Please select the appropriate time to take a physical examination, as the result is valid for only 6 months. 10. Non-criminal record. The applicant shall submit a valid certificate of Non-criminal record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months before the submission date of the application. 11. Academic achievements (if any). Such as published papers or patent certificates. 12. Conditional acceptance letter (if any). Applicants may contact supervisors for the conditional acceptance letter(optional). Template available at the Download section of the StudyatNENU website( https://iso.nenu.edu.cn/Download.htm ). For teachers’ information, please visit the Faculty Profile section of the StudyatNENU website ( https://iso.nenu.edu.cn/Faculty_Profiles.htm ). 13. Other supporting documents required by the International Students Office. Note: All uploaded documents must be clear, authentic, and valid. Applicants should use professional scanning devices and bear responsibility for unclear materials. VII. Admission and Registration 1. NENU will inform applicants of the final admission results by email before July 2026 and send the Admission Notice and the Confirmation Form for Study in China (JW201). 2. Scholarship recipients must register at NENU in late August or early September 2026 as specified in the Admission Notice. Those who fail to register on time without prior approval will be considered to have given up the admission, and the scholarship will not be retained. VIII. Notes 1. Applicants must apply directly to Northeast Normal University and should not submit applications through any agency. If found, the scholarship application will be disqualified. 2. If necessary, NENU will contact applicants via admission@nenu.edu.cn to request supplementary materials or inform them of admission results. Please ensure that the email address provided is accurate. 3. Scholarship recipients are not allowed to receive financial support from CSC and other scholarships (excluding all kinds of one-time scholarships) provided by the Chinese government at all levels and the host university at the same time; once discovered, their eligibility for the CSC Scholarships shall be canceled, and they shall be required to return the scholarship they have already received. For those who deliberately conceal their financial support situation, in addition to disqualification, they will not be allowed to apply for CSC Scholarships within three years. 4. Scholarship recipients who fail to register within the specified time will lose their eligibility. Bringing family members without university approval is not permitted. 5. Upon registration, scholarship recipients must submit all original application documents. Applicants are responsible for the authenticity of their information. Any false or misleading materials will result in the cancellation of admission or student status. 6. Scholarship recipients must participate in the annual review as required. Those who fail the evaluation will have their scholarships suspended or canceled. 7. In principle, scholarship recipients are not allowed to change their major or duration of study. IX. Contact Information International Students Office, Division of International Cooperation & Exchange, Northeast Normal University Address: Room 624, Administration Building, No. 5268 Renmin Street, Changchun, Jilin Province, China, 130024 E-mail: admission@nenu.edu.cn Tel: +86-431-85099754 初审：崔艳 复审：杨健 终审：汪晓波 上一篇： Admission Guidelines for the Chinese Government Scholarship – Bilateral Program (Type-A) of Northeast Normal University 2026–2027 下一篇： NENU Admission Guide for CSC Scholarship "Silk Road" Program(Type-B) 2025 Follow Us： StudyatNENU Wechat Scan for Inquiries Copyright： International Students Office, Division of International Cooperation & Exchange Add：Room 624, Administration Building, Northeast Normal University, No. 5268, Renmin Street, Changchun, Jilin, P.R.China Tel：0431-85099754/85685722 Email：iso@nenu.edu.cn, admission@nenu.edu.cn Web：http://iso.nenu.edu.cn Registration Web：http://studyatnenu.nenu.edu.cn Useful Links： NENU Homepage China Scholarship Council Center for Language Education and Cooperation HSK Test Service

Fordetailed information, please read carefully2026-2027SWU Chinese Government ScholarshipHigh Level Postgraduate Program. The following are major steps of application and selection: Step 1 Before Feb. 15，Log in to https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn to complete the online registration. The institution code of SWU is 10635, and the type of study abroad program is B. Andpleasealsolog in to https://swu.17gz.org/ “Southwest University International Student Service System to complete the online registration. Note: please use the same emailbox. Step 2 Before Feb. 27，Qualification assessment will be made by International Students Admission Office for applications. Step3 Before March6，Academic evaluation will be provided by the college or faculty you apply for. Note: Ifyoupass the academic evaluation, you will go in for university-level internal evaluation. You are strongly recommended toregularly check the email box that you have used to apply in order not to miss the interview notification and admission result notification email. Step4 BeforeMarch 13 Pre-admitted studentswill be selected based on the university-level internal evaluation. Step 5 Before Match 20，Pre-admitted students will be guided by supervisor tocompletestudy-in-Chinaproposal. International Students Admission Office will return theCSC applicationof the pre-admitted student and issue the SWU Pre-Admission Letter which should beuploaded on to studyinchina.csc.edu.cn. Note: Pre-Admission Letter does not mean you are officially admitted. Step 6 Before March31 Southwest University will send the roster of pre-admitted students to CSC Council. Step 7 FromMayto June,CSC organizes subject experts to review the pre-admitted students of each university by subject, decide the final admission roster and notify the scholarship recipients. Step 8 From July to August，Studyinchina.csc.edu.cn.will sendJW201 form and notification letter to your application email address.Meanwhile, thepaper acceptance letter willsent through Student Admissionofficeof Southwest University, please make sure the mailing address is accurate. Note:Personal information such as name, gender, nationality, date of birth, passport number, and academic system is linked to the JW201form. If any personal details are incorrect, which is not able to be modified. The situation will directly case visa rejection, then you will lose the chance to study in SWU. Once any situation such as untrue information in the application materials is discovered, the applicant will have their admission qualification revoked and be placed on our blacklist, with permanent ineligibility for future admission. For current students found in such circumstances, disciplinary actions will be taken, including but not limited to the cancellation of scholarships, expulsion from school, and dismissal. Relevant information will also be reported to Chinese Scholarship Council and Exit-Entry Administration Bureau. Eligibility 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens holding valid foreign passports and must comply with the Nationality Law of the PRC and other relevant regulations, including Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC . 2.Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, of good moral character, and friendly to China. As a general rule, applicants should be between 18 and 22 years old and hold a high school diploma or above. 3.Applicants must provide proof of language proficiency, as follows: (a) Chinese-taught programs: applicants must submit a valid HSK Level 5 or above score report issued within the past two years, with a score of no less than 180. (b) English-taught programs: applicants whose native language is not English must submit an IELTS score of 6.0 or above, or a TOEFL score of 90 or above, valid within two years. Applicants whose entire high school curriculum was taught in English may submit a certificate of English-medium instruction issued by their school. Once approved by the University, this certificate may replace the scores above. (c) Applicants for French-taught programs or programs taught primarily in French must meet the language requirements of their intended major. The specific requirements are set out in the admissions information published by the relevant school. 2. Application Timeline Application Opening Date: November 1, 2026 Deadline for Online Application and Materials Submission: May 30, 2027 Note ： Before the deadline, applicants must complete the online submission of application information and application materials, and resubmit any materials that do not meet the requirements. For the scholarship application deadline, please refer to the detailed information provided in the scholarship guidelines. Official Admission: July 2027 Enrollment: September 2027 (the exact date is subject to the Admission Notice) 3. Application Steps Step 1: Take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) Applicants must take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment for undergraduate admission (hereinafter “the CSCA”), organized by the China Scholarship Council, and obtain a score. For the test dates and content, please visit the official CSCA website (www.csca.cn). For the test subjects, please refer to the Beihang University CSCA Subject Requirements for International Undergraduate Applicants . Step 2: Register on the Beihang Online Application System for International Students Log in to the Beihang Online Application System for International Students ( http://admission.buaa.edu.cn/ ), register an account with the applicant’s frequently used personal email address, and complete the registration form as required. (Note: The personal email address is the main channel for application and admission information. It cannot be changed from the submission of the application until enrollment.) Step 3: Submit Application Materials Online Please upload scanned copies of the originals of the following materials online, as required: 1.Passport information page. The passport must be valid until after March 1, 2028. Applicants currently in mainland China must also provide a valid visa page or residence permit page. (Note: Applicants should continue to use the passport submitted with their application until enrollment. If it is renewed or replaced due to expiry, loss or damage, they must promptly notify the University and upload the new and previous passport information pages. If the previous passport is unavailable, they must provide evidence of its renewal, replacement or loss. ) 2.High school graduation certificate. Applicants in their final year of high school may submit a certificate of expected graduation issued by their school and must submit the formal graduation certificate before formal admission. The University will check the original certificate at registration. 3.Transcripts for all high school courses. 4.CSCA score report. 5.Proof of language proficiency that meets the instruction language requirement of the intended major. 6.Foreigner Physical Examination Form and blood test report, valid for 6 months from the date of examination. Applicants must download the Foreigner Physical Examination Form and complete every item listed in it at a qualified local medical institution. Results must be filled in Chinese or English, signed by the physician, and stamped with the seal of the examining institution. 7.Financial guarantor’s letter. Click here to download the template 8.Evidence of the guarantor’s financial resources. The guarantor must provide a bank deposit certificate of no less than the total tuition for 4 years. 9.Applicant’s birth certificate. 10.Documents proving the nationalities of both parents at the time of the applicant’s birth, including passports, identity cards, and any foreign permanent residency certificates obtained. 11.Certificate of no criminal record, issued within six months before submission. Applicants residing outside China must provide a certificate issued by the competent authority in their country or region of residence. Applicants who have resided in mainland China for a cumulative total of at least 180 days and meet the requirements for a criminal record check must provide a certificate issued by the exit-entry administration of the public security authority at their place of residence. Those who have resided in mainland China for less than 180 days must provide a certificate issued by the competent authority in their previous country or region of residence and explain their period of residence in China. 12.Integrity Commitment Letter, which guarantees that the materials provided by the applicant are authentic and valid. If any material is found to be false, the University will cancel the applicant’s eligibility immediately. Click here to download the template 13.Notarized Guardian’s Guarantee. Required for applicants who will be under 18 years old on September 1, 2027. The guardian must be an adult with a source of income who resides in the city where the campus is located (Beijing or Hangzhou). Click here to download the template 14.Other supplementary materials, such as award certificates, a personal statement, and a portfolio. Notes: * If the original of any application material is not in Chinese or English, a notarized translation must also be provided. * Only scanned copies of the originals of the above materials need to be uploaded. Paper materials are not required. * Applicants for art majors must submit a portfolio of paintings as required. Step 4: Pay the application fee and formally submit the application Please pay the application fee as instructed by the system and upload the payment receipt. After the application fee payment is approved, applicants must log in to the system to formally submit the application. Note: Please indicate the applicant’s full name as shown on the passport and passport number on the application fee transfer voucher. Once the application fee is approved, the applicant must log into the application system to formally submit the application. After the online application is successfully submitted, please check the status of the online application system and your personal email regularly. 4. Duration and Fees Program duration: 4 years Application fee: RMB 400, paid by bank transfer. Once paid, the application fee is non-refundable. Tuition: • Chinese-taught programs: • Science and Engineering majors (except those of the School of Biological Science and Medical Engineering), Economics and Management majors, and Humanities and Law majors: RMB 25,000 per academic year • Majors of the School of Biological Science and Medical Engineering and art majors: RMB 30,000 per academic year • English-taught programs: • RMB 30,000 per academic year （ except those of Beihang Valencia Polytechnic Institute ） • Majors of Beihang Valencia Polytechnic Institute: RMB 80,000 per academic year • French-taught programs: Tuition fees will be announced separately. Insurance fee: RMB 3,200 (for four academic years in total). All students must purchase comprehensive medical insurance for four academic years in one payment at registration. Accommodation fee * : Beijing campus: double room, RMB 30 per bed per day Hangzhou International Campus: double room, RMB 2,000 per bed per academic year * Accommodation in the international student apartments must be reserved in advance. The reservation method will be announced after formal admission. * The accommodation fee is based on the dormitory actually occupied and does not include water and electricity charges. 5. Scholarships Scholarship Eligibility What to offer Chinese Government Scholarship-Bilateral Program (Type A) (Chinese-taught majors only) • Applicants should consult the dispatching authority in their home country for the application period, agency number, and other information. • When applying in the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System (https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/), applicants must select “Type A” as the scholarship category and select Beihang University as the first-choice institution. • To request a pre-admission letter, please contact gbjadmission@buaa.edu.cn. Full or partial scholarship Outstanding Talents Scholarship of Beihang University (Freshman) • Current-year high school graduates who meet the eligibility requirements of the 2027 Beihang International Undergraduate Program • Excellent academic performance and conduct during high school • Excellent overall result in the admission assessment • Recommended by the applicant’s school • Priority may be given to applicants with strengths, honors, or patents in fields related to the intended major • Priority may be given to applicants with cultural or sports talents who have won third prize or above in provincial (municipal) competitions • Application deadline: April 30, 2027 100% tuition waiver Living allowance Accommodation on campus Program and Cooperation Foreign Students deadline: April 30, 2027 100% / 80% / 50% / 20% tuition waiver Beijing Government Scholarship (Beijing campus majors only) • Current-year high school graduates who meet the eligibility requirements of the 2027 Beihang International Undergraduate Program • Excellent academic performance and conduct during high school • Excellent overall result in the admission assessment • Application deadline: 2027 Beihang International Undergraduate Program • Excellent academic performance and conduct during high school • Excellent overall result in the admission assessment • Application deadline: April 30, 2027 100% / 80% / 50% / 20% tuition waiver Note: Except for the Chinese Government Scholarship (Category A), please submit the corresponding scholarship application materials together with the Otherwise, the applicant will be regarded as not applying for a scholarship. 6. 中国政府奖学金 >> 中国政府奖学金 >> 正文 大连理工大学2027年度中国政府奖学金高水平研究生和丝绸之路项目申请办法（TYPE B） 2026-09-23 点击：[ ] 中国政府奖学金 — 高水平研究生项目和 中国政府奖学金 — 丝绸之路项目系中国教育部向部分中国高水平大学提供的全额奖学金，用于高校直接遴选和招收优秀的外国青年学生来华攻读学位。 一、奖学金基本情况 （一）招生名额、类别及期限 1 、 20 27 年度大连理工大学中国政府奖学金高水平研究 生项目和 丝绸之路项目 招收硕士研究生和博士研究生。硕士研究生奖学金期限为 3 年、博士研究生奖学金期限为 4 年。 2 、授课语言一般为汉语，部分专业可提供英文授课。 3 、奖学金资助期限为录取时确定的学习年限，包括专业学习，原则上不予延长。 4 、奖学金获得者来华后须按照中国政府奖学金有关规定进行管理。该项目奖学金获得者来华后不得变更录取院校；原则上不得变更学习专业及学习期限。 （二）申请人资格 1 、申请人须为非中国籍公民，身体健康； 2 、申请人的学历和年龄要求： 来华攻读硕士学位者，须具有学士学位，年龄不超过 35 周岁； 来华攻读博士学位者，须具有硕士学位，年龄不超过 40 周岁。 （三）奖学金内容（人民币） 1 、免交学费和提供免费校内住宿。 2 、提供奖学金生活费，具体标准如下： 硕士研究生： 3,000 元人民币 / 月 / 人 博士研究生： 3,500 元人民币 / 月 / 人 3 、中国政府 奖学金来华留学生综合医疗保险。 4 、国际旅费：自理。 二、申请时间 2026 年 11 月 1 日 -2027 年 2 月 15 日 。 三、申请材料 1、中国政府奖学金申请表： 申请中国政府奖学金的申请人，须在留学基金委“来华留学网上报名系统”填写和提交报名信息，并提交申请表电子版。 留学基金委来华留学网上报名系统的网址为 http://www.campuschina.org 。 注：填写留学基金委 “ 来华留学网上报名系统 ” 在线申请表时： 受理机构编号为 10141 （大连理工大学） 。 没有填写网上申请的申请者，我校将不接收其申请。 2、大连理工大学入学申请表： 网上申请网址为： http://iso.dlut.edu.cn/ 。 没有填写 我校 网上申请的申请者，我校将不接收其申请。 3、 经过公证的最高学历证明： 如申请人为在校学生，需另外提交本人就读学校出具的在学证明。中英文以外文本需附经公证的中文或英文的译文。 4 、 学习 成绩单（自本科阶段起）： 成绩单扫描件应包括本科、硕士（如有）、博士（如有）学习阶段，直至最近一学期的成绩。成绩单应由就读学校教务处、研究生院或有关学生管理本门开具并盖章。可提供中 / 英文成绩单，如为英文以外语种，需另提供英文翻译件并公证。 5、 来华学习计划（不少于 10 00 字）： 请用中文或英文书写。请详细阐述拟在我校就读的专业或研究方向，研究计划需导师签字。学习计划模板详见附件1。 6、 申请人毕业学校 两名教授或副教授的推荐信： 请用中文或英文书写。内容重点应包括了申请人来华学习目标要求，以及对学生综合能力，未来发展的评价等。推荐信模板详见附件2。 7、 外国人体格检查记录： 申请人应严格按照《外国人体格检查记录》中要求的项目进行检查，须用英文填写。缺项、未贴有本人照片或照片上未盖骑缝章、无医师和医院签字盖章的《外国人体格检查记录》无效。 体格检查记录 有效期6个月，模板详见附件3。 8、 血液检查报告： 血液检测报告应包括HIV、V.D.R.L、HbsAg和HCV检测结果。 9、 申请人护照首页扫描件及签证空白页： 护照有效期应晚于 2027 年 9 月。 10、 语言能力证明： 申请汉语授课，需提供 HSK 成绩（ 两年有效 ），要求如下： （1） 申请理工、经管类专业，需 HSK 四级 180 分及以上； （2） 申请人文社科、哲学类专业，需要 HSK 五级 180 分及以上。 申请英语授课，需提供以下英语能力证明： （1） 雅思（5.5分或以上）或托福（80分或以上）或多邻国（100分或以上）成绩单； （2） 上一阶段授课语言为英语的授课语言证明； （3） 以英语作为官方语言国家的申请者，免交英语语言水平证明。 如无法提供以上证明的硕博申请者，其语言水平可由导师和院系根据面试和笔试的具体情况决定。 11、 无犯罪证明： 有效期6个月。如果无法在申请阶段提供，可签署附件4中的《无犯罪记录承诺书》作为临时代替文件。 12、其他材料： （1） 接收函（非必须）：申请人可先行联系导师进行考核，获得接收函。导师联系方式请查阅大连理工大学教师主页https://faculty.dlut.edu.cn/（中文版本），http://faculty-en.dlut.edu.cn/（英文版本），接收函模板详见 附件5 。 （2） 如申请人已就业，须提供就业单位出具的在职证明。 （3）已在华学习的申请者需提交护照签证页； （4） 1 张照片（ 3cm*4cm ）。 四、申请指南 1 、招生专业目录 硕士：2027年度硕士招生专业目录（中文授课）详见附件6，2027年度硕士招生专业目录（英文授课）详见附件7。 博士：2027年度博士招生专业目录（中文授课）详见附件8，2027年度博士招生专业目录（英文授课）详见附件9。 2、材料清单 硕士申请材料清单详见附件10，博士申请材料清单详见附件11。 五、录取通知及入学时间 录取结果将于 2027 年 7 月- 8 月通知申请者，入学时间为 2027 年 9 月。 六、联系方式 联系人：梁老师、石老师 联系电话： +86-411-84706048 电子邮箱： dutsice@dlut.edu.cn 附件【 附件1 Study+Proposal+Sample.docx Why Choose HUST? As a national key university directly under the Ministry of Education, P. R. China, HUST has been selected for the Double First-Class Initiative, Project 985, and Project 211. The University consistently ranks among the top 10 universities in China and within the global top 200 in prestigious international rankings, including the Times Higher Education World University Rankings and the U.S. News & World Report Best Global Universities Rankings. Set on a lush, 460-hectare campus known as the "University in the Forest", with greenery covering 72% of its area, HUST offers an inspiring learning environment featuring first-class facilities, extensive library resources, and comprehensive student services. Since the 1960s, HUST has educated more than 17,000 international students and professionals from over 170 countries and regions, fostering a vibrant and globally connected alumni network. Academic Excellence Across Disciplines HUST is a comprehensive research university offering a broad range of programs across 11 disciplines: Engineering | Medicine | Science | Economics | Law | Management | Literature | Philosophy | Education | Arts | Interdisciplinary Studies With over 85% of its international students enrolled in English-taught programs, HUST fosters a dynamic, diverse, and globally minded learning environment. “中国政府奖学金—高水平研究生项目”系中国教育部设立的来华留学生全额奖学金项目。受中国教育部委托，南开大学面向全球招收全日制研究生。 一、奖学金资助内容 1. 免除学费； 2. 提供免费校内住宿或发放住宿补贴； 3. 提供奖学金生活费（按照相关标准发放）； 4. 提供来华留学综合医疗保险（费用参照招生简章）； *详细的奖学金内容请查看中国国家留学基金委员会： https://www.csc.edu.cn/laihua/ 二、申请要求 1. 申请人须登录南开大学国际学生在线服务系统，完成线上申请。网址为： https://nankai.at0086.cn/StuApplication/Login.aspx 。 具体申报要求详见南开大学国际学生招生简章（硕士/博士）： https://sie.nankai.edu.cn/info/1094/1901.htm （硕士） https://sie.nankai.edu.cn/info/1169/1902.htm （博士） 2. 申请人需要登录中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统（https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login）完成网上申请，并下载《中国政府奖学金申请表》； *南开大学的受理机构编号为10055，本奖学金在CSC系统内的类型为B类。 3. 中国政府奖学金生不得同时享受中国各级政府和录取院校设立的其他奖学金（不含各类一次性奖励金）的资助，一经发现，其中国政府奖学金资格将予以取消，并须退还已领取的中国政府奖学金。对于刻意隐瞒资助情况的，除取消资格外，三年内不允许申请中国政府奖学金。 4. 申请时间：2026年10月20日至2027年3月20日。 *奖学金名额有限，请尽早向南开大学提交申请，为评审留出足够时间。 三、申请材料 1. 《中国政府奖学金申请表》（中文或英文填写）。 2. 护照首页。如现持有护照有效期不符合要求（护照有效期应晚于 2027年9月），请及时换发新护照。 3. 经公证的最高学历证明。如申请人为在校学生，须提交本人就读学校出具的预计毕业证明或在学证明。 4. 学习成绩单（自本科阶段起）。成绩单扫描件应包括本科、硕士（如有）、博士（如有）学习阶段，直至最近一学期的成绩。成绩单应由就读学校教务处、研究生院或有关学生管理部门开具并盖章。可提供中/英文成绩单，如为英语以外语种，需另提供英文翻译件并公证。 5. 语言能力证明。申请以中文为专业教学语言的申请人须提供有效期内的HSK四级成绩报告；曾使用中文为教学语言获得中国高校学位的，无须提供《汉语水平考试》（HSK）证明。申请以英语为专业教学语言的申请人，须提供雅思、托福等有效语言成绩。 6. 预录取材料。申请人须提交南开大学国际教育学院出具的预录取通知书。 7. 来华学习计划。应提交中/英文学习计划（1000字以上），博士研究生须由中方导师签字，学习计划只可以用中文或者英文书写。 8. 推荐信。提交两名教授或副教授的推荐信，内容应重点包含对申请人来华学习目标的评价、中外导师合作或校际交流情况，以及对学生综合能力、未来发展的评价，只可用中文或英文书写。 9. 《外国人体格检查表》复印件（原件自行保存，此表格由中国卫生检疫部门统一印制，须英文填写）。申请人应严格按照《外国人体格检查表》中要求的项目进行检查。缺项、未贴有本人照片或照片上未盖骑缝章、无医师和医院签字盖章的《外国人体格检查表》无效，检查结果有效期为 6 个月。 10. 无犯罪证明。申请人须提交由所在地公安机关出具的有效期内的无犯罪记录证明，通常应为提交申请之日前 6 个月以内的证明文件。 注意：通过系统上传的材料须清晰、真实、有效。除汉语、英语以外其他语种的申请材料，须提供英文翻译件。建议使用专业设备扫描文件，因材料不清晰或无法识别造成的后果由申请人承担。 四、费用 申请阶段无需交纳申请费。 南开大学对中国政府奖学金申请人免收申请费；若最终未获资助，申请费（600元）须于报到注册时交纳。 五、评审与录取 1. 申请人通过材料审核后，需参加报考学院组织的面试。 2. 申请人被录取后，学校将对申请人信息和材料等进行复核，如有违规或弄虚作假等情形，一经查实，立即取消奖学金资格。 3. 奖学金资格由中国国家留学基金委员会（CSC）最终审定。 六、其他 1. 奖学金获得者来华后须按照中国政府奖学金有关规定进行管理。 2. 该项目奖学金获得者来华后不得变更录取院校，不得变更学习专业及学习期限。 3. 本奖学金申请办法由南开大学国际教育学院和汉语言文化学院负责解释。 七、联系方式 联系人：孙老师/王老师 电话：0086-22-23508825 地址：中国天津市南开区卫津路94号南开大学国际教育学院和汉语言文化学院400室 邮箱： nkadmission01@nankai.edu.cn 微信公众号：NKUISO 网址： https://sie.nankai.edu.cn 友情链接： 南开大学 南开大学汉语言文化学院 国家留学基金委 中外语言合作交流中心 中华人民共和国教育部 天津市公安局出入境管理局 联系我们 天津市南开区卫津路94号/津南区同砚路38号 南开大学国际教育学院 +86 (22)23508825/+86 (22)23503615/+86 (22)23509646/+86 (22)23508686 版权所有 Copyright © School of International Education. 南开大学国际教育学院 版权所有

当前位置： 首页 >> 新闻公告 >> 通知公告 对外经济贸易大学2027/2028年中国政府奖学金 “高水平研究生”项目申请指南 一、项目介绍 中国政府奖学金“高水平研究生”项目采取“个人申请、院校推荐、专家评审、择优录取”的原则，选拔具有优秀学科背景、突出专业能力及未来发展潜力的国际学生。 二、申请条件 项目申请人应符合以下基本条件： 1) 非中华人民共和国国籍，身心健康； 2) 申请攻读硕士学位者，须具有学士学位，成绩优异，年龄不超过35周岁；申请攻读博士学位者，须具有硕士学位，成绩优异，年龄不超过40周岁； 3) 申请中文授课项目，汉语水平须达到五级（HSK 5）及以上；申请英文授课项目，英文水平须达到英语水平良好（雅思6.0或托福86分及以上的英语水平），能熟练使用英语从事专业课程学习。 三、招生专业 项目名称 专业名称 授课语言 中文 英文 硕士项目 国际关系 √ √ 国际发展 国际法学 国际贸易学 金融学（国际金融与投资方向） 金融学（精算与风险管理方向） 行政管理 √ 国际中文教育 民商法学 经济法学 语言学及应用语言学 外国语言学及应用语言学 翻译 国际商务 √ 公共管理 海关管理 工商管理 （须具有三年及以上工作经验） 数字经济 世贸组织法与经济学 国际商务与跨境电商 运输经济与物流学 博士项目 国际关系 √ √ 国际发展 国际法学 金融学（精算与风险管理、保险、资产配置方向） 劳动经济学 国际贸易学 民商法学 √ 经济法学 公共政策与管理 √ 企业管理 产业经济学 * 更多申请专业信息请登录 sie.uibe.edu.cn 查询。 四、资助类别与内容 资助类别：硕士研究生&博士研究生 奖学金内容：含学费、住宿费、生活费和综合医疗保险 生活费：硕士研究生3000元人民币/月 博士研究生3500元人民币/月 五、申请流程 1)申请人登录“中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统”（ https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login ） 完成在线报名。报名时，奖学金类型应选择“ Type B ”，受理机构代码为“ 10036 ”。请使用中文或英文填写申请内容，手写视为无效； 2）申请人须将 CSC 申请表及全部申请材料发送至 uibescholarship@163.com ，邮件主题请写明 “ UIBE+Type B ”。材料须与中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统中所传材料一致； 3）学校将对申请材料进行初审并组织专业面试，为符合要求且通过面试的申请人开具 预录取通知书（通过邮件发送）。获得预录取通知书的申请人须在规定时间内将预录取通知书上传至CSC系统 ； 注意：申请人须按以下“申请材料”的要求准备相应材料扫描件，并在规定时间内上传至报名网站并发送至规定邮箱。提交材料须为清晰的彩色扫描PDF文件，不清晰或不符合要求的文件不予受理。学校暂不接受纸质版申请材料。 上述申请流程须在北京时间 2027 年 2 月 28 日 23:59 前完成，逾期申请视为无效。 六、申请材料 申请人需提供以下材料的清晰扫描件： 1) 《中国政府奖学金申请表》 。此申请表可在提交CSC申请后下载； 2) 申请人护照首页 （护照必须为个人普通护照，护照有效期应在 2027年9月30日 后）。如现持有护照有效期不符合要求，请及时换发新护照； 3) 经公证的最高学历证明（中文或英文） 。 如申请人为在校学生，须提交本人就读学校出具的预计毕业证明或在学证明； 4) 学习成绩单（自本科阶段起） 。成绩单扫描件应包括本科、硕士（如有）、博士（如有）学习阶段，直至最近一学期的成绩。成绩单应由就读学校教务处、研究生院或有关学生管理部门开具并盖章。可提供中/英文成绩单，如为英语以外语种，需另提供英文翻译件并公证； 5) 语言能力证明 。申请中文授课项目，须提供汉语水平考试五级（HSK 5）及以上有效、合格成绩证书。前置学历使用中文为教学语言获得中国高校学位的，可提供授课语言证明；申请英文授课项目，须具备相当于雅思6.0或托福86及以上的英语水平，并提供相关英文成绩证明或官方英文水平证明函。雅思或托福成绩单须为两年有效期以内文件； 6) 来华学习与研究计划。 内容包含但不限于 专业背景、计划研究内容、学业规划 等，请用中文或者英文书写，1000 字以上； 7) 推荐信 。提交两名教授或副教授的推荐信（需写明推荐人电话及电子邮件地址），内容应重点包含对申请人来华学习目标要求，中方院校或者中方导师与国外导师的合作情况或者校际交流情况，以及对学生综合能力，未来发展的评价，只可用中文或英文书写； 8） 其他支撑材料 。如个人学术发表、研究成果及相关获奖证书，可一并提交； 9)《 外国人体格检查表》。 申请人可在附件中下载（原件自行保存，此表格由中国卫生检疫部门统一印制，须英文填写）。申请人应严格按照《外国人体格检查表》中要求的项目进行检查。缺项、未贴有本人照片或照片上未盖骑缝章、无医师和医院签字盖章的《外国人体格检查表》无效，检查结果有效期为6个月。请申请人据此确定本人进行体检的时间； 10) 无犯罪记录证明 。申请人须提交由所在地公安机关出具的有效期内的无犯罪记录证明，通常应为提交申请之日前 6 个月以内的证明文件。 提示： 申请阶段只需提供上述文件的扫描件，入学注册时需提交原件或公证件，原件或公证件将由学校作为学生档案保存，不予退还。各种证明、证书须是中文或英文的原件或公证件。申请材料恕不退还。 七、注意事项 1.通过系统上传的材料须清晰、真实、有效。建议申请人使用专业设备扫描需提交的有关文件，因材料不清晰或无法可识别造成的后果由申请人承担； 2.为确保申请进展顺利，申请人须提供有效联系电话与联系邮箱； 3.申请截止日期为 2027年2月28日 ； 4.预录取通知书仅代表我校推荐人选，不代表最终录取结果。最终录取结果以收到对外经济贸易大学出具的正式录取通知为准； 5.每位申请人一次性仅可以申请一个中国政府奖学金项目，申请人不得同时申请多个中国政府奖学金项目，否则奖学金申请将视为无效； 6.中国政府奖学金生不得同时享受中国各级政府和录取院校设立的其他奖学金（不含各类一次性奖励金）的资助，一经发现，中国政府奖学金资格将予以取消，并须退还已领取的中国政府奖学金。对于刻意隐瞒资助情况的，除取消资格外，三年内不允许申请中国政府奖学金； 7.相关操作指南及材料可于附件下载。 八、联系方式 国际学院招生办公室地址： 中国·北京市朝阳区惠新东街10号国际交流大厦B座101办公室 uni-central-china-normal-university.text: ﻿ 华中师范大学2027年中国政府奖学金“高水平研究生”项目招生简章 Central China Normal University 2027 Chinese Government Scholarship “High Level Postgraduate Program” Admission Guide-国际合作部-港澳台事务办公室 来华留学 出国留学 华师首页 服务门户 联系我们 English 关于我们 部门介绍 部门领导 教师风采 行政人员 党群工作 学习园地 党群动态 国际合作与交流 海外合作伙伴 国际会议 外专引智 港澳台事务 留学生工作 留学生招生与管理 留学生培养 来华短期班 出国留学项目 国际中文教育 规章制度 关于我们 部门介绍 部门领导 教师风采 行政人员 党群工作 学习园地 党群动态 国际合作与交流 海外合作伙伴 国际会议 外专引智 港澳台事务 留学生工作 留学生招生与管理 留学生培养 来华短期班 出国留学项目 国际中文教育 规章制度 通知公告 通知公告 > 通知公告 Notice 通知公告 通知公告 当前位置： 首页 - 通知公告 - 正文 华中师范大学2027年中国政府奖学金“高水平研究生”项目招生简章 Central China Normal University 2027 Chinese Government Scholarship “High Level Postgraduate Program” Admission Guide 作者： 发布时间：2026-10-27 点击数： 华中师范大学创立于 1903年 ， 位于九省通衢的湖北省武汉市 ,坐落在武昌南湖之滨的桂子山上 ， 占地面积 160余万平方米，紧邻武汉市轨道交通地铁2号线、8号线、11号线。是首批列入国家“双一流”建设高校，教育部直属重点综合性师范大学,国家“211 工程” 重点建设大学 ， 国家教师教育 “985优势学科创新平台”建设高校。 学校人才培养体系完备。学校下设 29个教学科研单位，有81个本科专业，32个硕士学位授权一级学科，24个博士学位授权一级学科 ， 20个博士后科研流动站和1个博士后科研工作站。 学校师资队伍力量雄厚，现有教职工 3800余人，专任教师2000余人，其中具有高级专业技术职务1400余人。双聘两院院士2人，入选各类国家级重大人才工程120余人次、省市级人才工程260余人次，入选国务院学科评议组成员3人、教育部高等学校教学指导委员会委员42人次。 学校以 “博学、博爱、博雅”为主题建设“三博”校园文化，90余个学生社团活跃其中 ， “创新杯科学文化节”、“树人杯艺术文化节”、“博雅大讲堂”、“桂苑之歌”、“桂子山国际文化节”等品牌活动 ， 为学生的成长提供了广阔舞台。校园无线网络及学生宿舍空调实现全覆盖；图书馆馆藏面积近 5万平方米 ， 藏书 300余万册 ， 具有先进的 “校园文献网络化管理与服务系统” ， 为学生学习生活提供了有力保障。 学校积极开展对外学术、科技和文化交流 ， 先后与美国、俄罗斯、加拿大、法国、 英国、澳大利亚、日本、韩国等 70 多个国家和地区的150多所高校及科研机构建立了密切的合作交流关系。 华中师范大学是中国最早接收国际学生的院校之一 ， 是国家留学基金管理委员会来华留学预科生培养基地之一 ， 是中央统战部批准的国家级 “华文教育基地单位” 之一。至今，华中师范大学共接收培养了来自170余个国家和地区的3万余名国际学生。 Central China Normal University (CCNU) was founded in 1903 in Wuhan, the capital city of Hubei Province. Situated on Guizi Hill beside South Lake in Wuchang, the university covers an area of over 1.6 million square meters and is conveniently accessible via Wuhan’s metro lines No.2, No.8 and No.11. CCNU is a key comprehensive university under the direct administration of the Ministry of Education of China. CCNU is among the first batch of universities which have entered the “Double First-Class” initiative to build world-class universities and first-class disciplines and on the list of “211 National Education Priority Project”. It is highly recognized as an important base for cultivating exceptional talent for the country and a superior training center for excellent teachers in institutions of higher learning. It is also a distinguished participant in the “985 Project”, aiming at establishing a top-tier training center for outstanding educators in higher education. CCNU has a well-developed system for nurturing talents. It encompasses 29 teaching and research units, offering 81 bachelor’s programs, 32 master’s and 24 doctoral degree-granting disciplines, 20 postdoctoral research stations and one postdoctoral research workstation. The university boasts a strong and well-qualified faculty. It has over 3,800 staff members in total, including more than 2,000 full-time teachers, among whom over 1,400 hold senior professional titles. Additionally, it has 2 dual-appointed academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and Chinese Academy of Engineering, over 120 person-times selected into various national-level major talent programs, over 260 person-times into provincial and municipal talent programs, 3 members on the Academic Degrees Committee of the State Council, and 42 person-times serving as members of the Teaching Steering Committee of Institutions of Higher Education under the Ministry of Education. Over the years, CCNU has developed a profound campus culture characterized by “erudition, love, and elegance”. With more than 90 active student clubs on campus, events such as the “Innovation Cup Science and Culture Festival”, the “Shuren Cup Art Festival”, the “Boya Lecture Hall”, the “Song of Gui Yuan” and the “Guizi Hill International Cultural Festival” have become signature cultural activities with significant impact nationwide, providing students with a wide range of opportunities. Besides, CCNU offers a full campus-wide wireless connectivity and air-conditioning in student dormitories. The library, one of the top libraries in Hubei Province, covers an area of nearly 50,000 square meters and houses a collection of over 3 million books. The advanced “campus literature network management and service system” provides strong support for students’ academic life. CCNU has established close relationships with renowned universities and research institutes worldwide. It has conducted school-to-school exchanges and extensive academic cooperations with more than 150 universities in over 70 countries, including the U.S., Russia, Canada, France, the U.K., Germany, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea,Vietnam, etc. As a training base for international students under the China Scholarship Council, CCNU is one of the first universities nationwide to recruit international students . It is also one of the nationally recognized “Chinese Language Education Base Units”. To date, CCNU has hosted and trained over 30,000 international students from more than 170 countries and regions. 招生专业、类别及奖学金期限 Major in Admission , Admission Category , Term of the Scholarship 1. 招生专业 请参阅华中师范大学 202 7 年度国际学生招生专业目录 (https://dge.ccnu.edu.cn/info/1381/32381.htm) 2. 招生类别 硕士研究生，博士研究生 3. 奖学金期限 包括汉语补习和专业学习时间。汉语补习资助期限一般为一年，硕士专业学习资助期限 2-3 年，博士专业学习资助期限 4 年。 1. Major in Admission: Please refer to CCNU 202 7 Admission Programs for International Students (https://dge.ccnu.edu.cn/info/1381/32381.htm) 2. Admission category: Master’s degree and Doctoral degree. 3. Term of the scholarship: Including Chinese Language year and Major Study. The term of Chinese Language year is generally 1 year; the term of Master Major Study is 2 -3 years ; and the term of PhD Major Study is 4 years. 奖学金内容 Subsidy Content 1. 包括学费、住宿费、生活费和综合医疗保险费。 2. 生活费：硕士 3,000 元人民币 / 月，博士 3,500 元人民币 / 月。 3. 综合医疗保险费： 800 元人民币 / 人 / 年。 1. Including tuition fees, accommodation expens e , living expense and comprehensive medical insurance fee. 2. Living expense: 3000RMB/month for Master’s degree and 3500RMB/month for PhD. 3. Comprehensive medical insurance fee: 800RMB/person/year. 申请条件 Eligibility 1. 非中国籍公民，身心健康； 2. 申请攻读硕士学位者，应当具有学士学位或同等学历，学习成绩优秀，年龄一般不超过 35 周岁；申请攻读博士学位者，应当具有硕士学位或同等学历，学习成绩优秀，年龄一般不超过 40 周岁； 3. 语言要求 中文授课申请者，中文水平至少达到汉语水平考试 HSK 五级（含）以上才可以申请。 英文授课项目申请者，需提供英语水平证明，托福（ TOEFL ）需达到 85 分，雅思（ IELTS ）需达到 6.0 分。不能提供标准化英语测试证明的，上一阶段学位学习使用英语教学的申请者，需提供相关证明。母语为英语的申请者，可以免除提供上述英语水平证明。 1. Non-Chinese citizens, and be in good health both mentally and physically. 2. Applicants for a Master's degree should have a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, have excellent academic performance, and be generally no older than 35 years old; applicants for Doctoral degrees should have Master's degree or excellent academic performance, and be generally no older than 40 years old. 3. Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must have at least HSK5 or above. Applicants who are unable to provide proof of standardized English language testing are required to provide proof of English language instruction for their previous degree studies. Applicants whose mother language is English are exempt from providing proof of English language proficiency as described above. 申请流程 Procedures for Application 1. 申请人登 录 “ 中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统 ” （ http://www.campuschina.org ），在线填写《中国政府奖学金申请表》并提交所需申请材料； - 华中师范大学招生代码为： 10511 ， - “ 高水平研究生 ” 中国政府奖学金项目类别为： B 类 2. 登录华中师范大学国际 学生申请系统 (https://international.ccnu.edu.cn/#/login) ，进行网上注册与申请 。 1. Visit “CSC Study in China” website and click “Scholarship Application for Students” at http://www.campuschina.org. Fill in the Chinese Government Scholarship Application Form online and submit the required application documents; - The code of Central China Normal University is :10511 . - Category of Chinese Government Scholarship Program for “High level postgraduate program” is : Category B . 2. Applicants log in to the “Central China Normal University International Student Online Application System (https://international.ccnu.edu.cn/#/login) . Fill in the Application Form online and submit the required application documents. 申请材料 Application Documents 1. 《中国政府奖学金申请表》（在线填写）。 2. 护照首页。申请人须提交有效期晚于 202 8 年 2 月本人普通护照的首页清晰扫描件，如现持有护照有效期不符合要求，请及时换发新护照。 3. 经公证的最高学历证明。如申请人为在校学生，须提交本人就读学校出具的预计毕业证明。 4. 学习成绩单（自本科阶段起）。成绩单扫描件应包括本科、硕士（如有）、博士（如有）学习阶段，直至最近一学期的成绩。成绩单应由就读学校教务处、研究生院或有关学生管理部门开具并盖章。可提供中 / 英文成绩单，如为 中 英 文 以外语种，需另提供 中 英文翻译件并公证。 5. 语言能力证明。申请以中文为专业教学语言的申请人须提供有效期内且与相应中文水平要求相符的 HSK 成绩报告。申请以外语为专业教学语言的申请人根据学校要求提供相应的语言能力证明，如雅思或托福成绩单。 6. 来华学习计划。应提交中 / 英文学习计划（ 1000 字以上），学习计划只可以用中文或者英文书写。 可参考模板（ https://dge.ccnu.edu.cn/info/2021/32361.htm ）。 7. 推荐信。提交两 封 推荐信 （来自 教授或副教授 ） ，内容应重点包含对申请人来华学习目标要求，中方院校或者中方导师与国外导师的合作情况或者校际交流情况，以及对学生综合能力，未来发展的评价，只可用中文或英文书写。 可参考模板（ https://dge.ccnu.edu.cn/info/2021/32351.htm ）。 8. 个人作品。申请攻读艺术、设计类等专业者，可通过 “ 作品 / 其他支撑材料 ” 上传个人作品类材料（如影像、绘画作品等），亦可按照申请院校要求以其他方式提供。 9. 年龄 未 满 18 周岁的申请人，须提交在华法定监护人的相关法律文件。 10. 《外国人体格检查表》复印件（原件自行保存，此表格由中国卫生检疫部门统一印制，须英文填写）。申请人应严格按照《外国人体格检查表》中要求的项目进行检查。缺项、未贴有本人照片或照片上未盖骑缝章、无医师和医院签字盖章的《外国人体格检查表》无效，检查结果有效期为 6 个月。 11. 无犯罪记录证明。申请人须提交由所在地公安机关出具的有效期内的无犯罪记录证明，通常应为提交申请之日前 6 个月以内的证明文件。 12. 导师接收函（如有）。发表论文、获奖证明等其他材料（如有）。 注意：通过系统上传的材料须清晰、真实、有效。建议申请人使用专业设备扫描需提交的有关文件，因材料不清晰或无法可识别造成的后果由申请人承担。 1. Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (in Chinese or English); 2. Copy of Passport Home Page. If the validity of the applicant’s current passport does not meet the requirement (meaning the passport expires before February 202 8 ), please apply for a new passport before submitting the application; 3. Notarized highest diploma. Prospective diploma winners must submit official Pre-Graduation certificate issued by their current institution . Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations; 4. Academic transcripts (from the undergraduate program onwards). Copies of academic records from first to last semester during the undergraduate, graduate (if any), and doctoral programs (if any) shall be provided. These transcripts shall be issued and sealed by the attending university’s academic affairs office, graduate school, or student management department. They can be in Chinese or English, but must be attached with notarized English translations if they are in foreign languages other than English; 5. Language qualification certificates. Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must submit valid HSK reports in accordance with the corresponding Chinese proficiency requirements. Applicants for other language-taught programs shall provide relevant language proficiency certificates according to the universities’ requirements, like IELTS or TOFEL report; 6. A study plan proposal. A study plan written in Chinese or English shall contain more than 1,000 characters or words; the proposal of a doctoral student shall be signed by the applicant’s Chinese supervisor; please refer to Study Plan for International Student Applicants https://dge.ccnu.edu.cn/info/2021/32361.htm ） ; 7. Recommendation letters. Two letters of recommendation (written only in Chinese or English) from professors or associate professors shall be submitted. These letters shall describe the applicant’s objectives of learning in China, comprehensive abilities, and evaluation of future growth, as well as the cooperation between the supervisors or the exchange between universities both in China and abroad; please refer to Recommendation Letter for Master's/PhD Application (https://dge.ccnu.edu.cn/info/2021/32351.htm ） ; 8. Example of art. To apply for majors related to art or design, applicants could submit their own works through “Example of Art/Other Supporting Documents” in the system. Applicants could also provide such materials to the applied universities directly in other ways; 9. Applicants under the age of 18 should submit the valid documents of their legal guardians in China; 10. A photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form completed in English (the original copy shall be kept by the applicant). The form is designed by the Chinese quarantine authority and can be obtained from the dispatching authority. The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Please select the appropriate time to take a physical examination as the result is valid for only 6 months. 11. Non-criminal record report. The applicant shall submit a valid certificate of Non-Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months prior to the submission date of the application. 12. Supervisor's acceptance letter (if any). Other materials such as published papers and award certificates (if any). Reminder: Uploaded supporting documents must be clear, authentic and valid. Applicants are recommended to use a professional device to scan the relevant documents. Applicants shall bear the consequences caused by unclear or unidentifiable uploaded materials. 申请时间 Application Time 202 6 /11/1 - 202 7 /02/ 20 1 st November, 202 6 to 20th February, 202 7 联系方式 Contact Information 电话： 0086-27-67865209 电子邮箱： cice@ccnu.edu.cn 网址 ： https://dge.ccnu.edu.cn/ Tel: 0086-27-67865209 Email: cice@ccnu.edu.cn Website ： https://dge.ccnu.edu.cn/ 【 推荐信参考模板 Recommendation Letter for Master's or PhD Application.doc 】已下载 次 【 推荐信参考模板 Recommendation Letter for Master.doc 】已下载 次 【 华中师范大学系统申请指南 Instructions for CCNU System.pdf 】已下载 次 【 华中师范大学2027年度国际学生招生专业目录 CCNU 2027 Admission Programs for International Students.pdf 】已下载 次 【 学习计划参考模板 ReferenceTemplate of Study Plan.docx 】已下载 次 【 中国政府奖学金系统操作说明 Instructions for CGS Information System(CGSIS).docx 】已下载 次 联系我们 / Contact Us 地址：武汉珞喻路152号华中师范大学国际文化交流园区一号楼 邮编：430079 国际部暨港澳台办 官方公众号 Copyright (C) 2025. 华中师范大学国际合作部、港澳台事务办公室 版权所有 中国 · 武汉 · 武昌 · 桂子山

资助类别：博士研究生和硕士研究生 申请专业及授课语言： 2026年中南大学高水平研究生招生专业目录.xlsx 三、奖学金内容 含学费、校内住宿费、综合医疗保险费和生活费 （标准为硕士研究生：3000元人民币/月；博士研究生：3500元人民币/月） 。 四、申请条件 1、非中国籍公民，无犯罪记录，身体健康，成绩优异； 2、学位和年龄要求 来华攻读硕士学位者，须具有学士学位，年龄不超过35周岁； 来华攻读博士学位者，须具有硕士学位，年龄不超过40周岁； 3、未获得其他奖学金资助； 4、语言要求：英文授课，要求 雅思6分及以上或托福85分及以上 。具备以下情况之一者，可免上述语言成绩： 英语作为母语或官方语言；学历教育中有英文授课的。 中文授课，理工科专业须达新HSK四级260分及以上，文科及医学专业须达新HSK五级200分及以上或者学历教育中有中文授课经历。 5、申请者须有较强的学术背景、科研和创新能力。 五、申请流程 1、在中南大学网站上申请 （必须完成此步骤，未完成的不予考虑，申请审核在本网站进行）。登录中南大学国际学生在线服务系统 https://csu.17gz.org/member/login.do 网上注册，选择中国政府奖学金项目Chinese Government Scholarship，填写信息、提交申请。 经评审，中南大学择优发放预录取函，但预录取函不代表最终录取结果。 2、 登录“ 中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统 ” （ http://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login ）。选择留学生项目种类（Program Category）B类（Type B），输入受理机构编号（Agency No.)： 10533 （中南大学），填写信息、在线提交并下载《中国政府奖学金申请表》。系统操作流程： 信息系统申请人用户操作说明.pdf 请在以上两个系统中提交以下材料， 材料不全者不予受理： 1）护照首页。 护照有效期应晚于202 6 年9月 ，如现持有护照有效期不符合要求，请及时换发新护照； 2） 学历证书（自本科阶段起）。 博士项目申请人须提供本科及硕士阶段的学历证书。 如申请人为应届毕业生，须提交本人就读学校出具的预毕业证明 或在学证明 。中英文以外文本须附经公证的中文或英文的译文； 3）学习成绩单（自本科阶段起）。成绩单扫描件应包括本科、硕士（如有）、博士（如有）学习阶段，直至最近一学期的成绩。成绩单应由就读学校教务处、研究生院或有关学生管理部门开具并盖章。可提供中/英文成绩单，如为英语以外语种，需另提供英文翻译件并公证； 4）语言能力证明。申请以中文为专业教学语言的 申请人须提供有效期内 且 与相应中文水平要求相符的HSK成绩报告 。申请以英语为专业教学语言的申请人应提供 有效期内 托福、雅思成绩报告或免语言能力证明； 5） 来华学习计划 。应提交中/英文学习计划（1000字以上，请见模板 CSU国际学生研究生来华学习计划模板.docx ），写明研究生阶段计划研究选题、研究目标、研究方法、预期成果等内容， 博士研究生须由中方导师签字 ，学习计划只可以用中文或者英文书写（该项内容非常重要，请认真完成）； 6） 导师预 接收函（ 此项为必交材料 ，请见模板 中南大学国际学生导师预接收函.docx ，导师信息详见 中南大学二级学院导师联系表.pdf ）； 7）外国人体格检查表扫描件，须附有血液检查报告。申请人应严格按照 外国人体格检查表.pdf 中要求的项目进行检查，中文或英文填写。 缺项、未贴本人照片或照片上未盖章、无医师和医院签字盖章的《外国人体格检查表》无效 。检查日期应为 20 25 年 10 月1日后。如被录取，请携带原件到校报到； 8）无犯罪记录证明。申请人须提交由所在地公安机关出具的无犯罪记录证明，开具日期须在 202 5 年 10 月1日后； 9）推荐信。提交两名教授或副教授的推荐信，内容应重点包含对申请人来华学习目标要求，以及对学生综合能力，未来发展的评价，只可用中文或英文书写，含推荐人的详细联系方式，开具日期在 20 25 年 10月1日后； 10）个人介绍视频（请介绍自己的教育和专业背景，充分展现科研能力和潜力，时长不超过一分钟。要求视频为mp4格式，容量在40MB以内。可通过视频格式转换软件通过调整分辨率、码率、比特率等方式调整文件大小）； 11）未获得其他形式奖学金的声明（请见模板 未获得其他奖学金的声明.docx ）。 12） 中南大学预录取函（仅须在 中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统 上提交）。申请人须先在 中南大学国际学生在线服务系统 https://csu.17gz.org/member/login.do 提交申请，中南大学审核后择优发放预录取函。 13 ）个人简历 、 获奖证书、资格证书 、 论文发表情况 等 其他支撑材料； 注意：通过系统上传的材料须清晰、真实、有效。建议申请人使用专业设备扫描需提交的有关文件，因材料不清晰或无法识别造成的后果由申请人承担。 3、支付费用 材料初审合格后，根据邮件提示在中南大学统一支付平台支付材料审核费人民币500元（支持微信、支付宝和银联）。 请于一周内完成材料审核费缴纳，否则无法进行下一轮审核。未通过材料初审者，不需要缴纳材料审核费。 4、院系审核 由各二级培养单位进行院系审核，全面考察申请人学术背景、科研能力或创新能力。 5、预录取 根据初审意见和各二级培养单位意见择优 拟 录取。 6、材料上报，等待录取结果 中南大学将候选人 名单上报国家留学基金委，最终录取结果由国家留学基金委确定。 未被中国政府奖学金项目录取的学生， 学校将视情况 推荐为其他项目候选人 ，最终经费类别以录取通知书为准！ 因中国政府奖学金有申请时限，请持续关注申请系统和邮箱，如有消息请及时回复。所有申请动态都会在国际学生在线服务系统中显示，请及时登录申请系统收件箱或个人邮箱查看相关信息。 六、录取及通知 1 、 由学校推荐至国家留学基金委的学生， 须经再次评审后择优录取 ， 最终 录取 结果 以录取通知书为准。 2 、中国政府奖学金生不得同时享受中国各级政府和录取院校设立的其他奖学金（不含各类一次性奖励金）的资助，一经发现，其中国政府奖学金资格将予以取消，并须退还已领取的中国政府奖学金。对于刻意隐瞒资助情况的，除取消资格外，三年内不允许申请中国政府奖学金。 3 、入学时间为每年 8月底或 9月初， 具体时间以《录取通知书》为准。被录取的学生须严格按照入学通知书规定的时间到中南大学国际教育学院办理注册手续。未按规定时间办理入学注册手续者，将取消其入学资格。 4 、奖学金获得者不得变更录取院校、学习专业及学习期限。 5 、无论录取与否， 申请 费用均不退还。 6 、请不要同时申请我校多个奖学金项目！ 七、年度评审 奖学金生入学后须按规定接受年度评审，评审通过后继续享有奖学金。否则，将中止或取消奖学金。 八、联系方式 中华人民共和国湖南省长沙市中南大学国际教育学院 电话：+86-731-88836410（非医学类咨询），89667206（医学类咨询） 传真：+86-731-88836737 电子邮件：csc@csu.edu.cn 学院网址： https://intl.csu.edu.cn/zwb.htm 中国政府奖学金 北京市外国留学生奖学金 学校奖学金 中国政府奖学金 您现在的位置： 首页 - 奖学金 - 中国政府奖学金 2027年中国农业大学中国政府奖学金“高水平研究生项目”招生简章 发布日期： 2026- 10- 28 访问次数: 信息来源： 国际合作与交流处 一、 申请条件 1. 持有效普通护照的非中国籍公民 ， 身心健康 ； 2. 无 违法 违纪行为，无治安处罚记录和犯罪行为；对中国友好，举止得体；遵守中国法律和学校规章制度，尊重中国文化； 3. 申请硕士学位者， 应当具有学士学位或同等学历 ，年龄 一般 不超过 35周岁；申请攻读博士学位者， 应当具有硕士学位或同等学历， 年龄 一般 不超过 40周岁； 4. 申请以英文为专业教学语言的硕士、博士学位者，应满足以下任意一条： (1) 英语为母语； (2) 托福不低于 90分 ； (3) 雅思不低于 6. 5 分 ； (4) 上一学位为英文授课 。 5. 申请以中文为专业教学语言的硕士、博士学位者，中文水平须达到汉语水平考试（ HSK）五级； 6. 学术能力及其他相关标准等方面符合学校录取要求。 二、 申请专业 请点击下载： 2027年度来华留学生研究生招生专业信息（Admission Major for Graduate students of 2027）1101.xlsx 三、 申请材料 1. 护照 首页复印件（护照有效期应晚于 202 7 年 12 月 ） ； 2. 经公证的最高学历证明； * 如申请人为在校学生，须提交本人就读学校出具的预计毕业证明。被本校录取后，须在报到时提交最高学位证原件，否则将取消录取。 3. 学习 成绩单 （ 自本科阶段起 ）。 成绩单应由就读学校教务处、研究生院或有关学生管理部门开具并盖章。要求 GPA3.0以上； 4. 两位副教授及以上职称学者的推荐信。推荐信没有指定格式，所有推荐信必须由推荐人签名； 5. 预录取通知书（由中国农业大学出具，通过在线面试后可申请） 6. 学习或研究计划 （ 不少于 1000字 ） ； 7. 语言水平证明 。 申请中文授课项目的申请人须提交 在 有效 期内 的 HSK成绩报告。申请英文授课项目的申请人应根据大学要求提供雅思、托福或 学校出具的英文授课证明 ； 8. 《外国人体格检查记录表》 （ 查阅网址： http://www.csc.edu.cn/uploads/forms/foreinphy.pdf ） ； 申请人应严格按照表中要求的项目进行检查。缺项、未贴有本人照片或照片上未盖骑缝章、无医师和医院签字盖章的《外国人体格检查表》无效。检查结果有效期为 6个月。 9. 无犯罪记录证明。申请人须提交由所在地公安机关出具的有效期内的无犯罪记录证明，通常应为提交申请之日前 6个月以内的证明文件。 10. 已发表的学术论文、专利或其他学术成果 （ 原件或复印件 ） *所有文件须用中文或英文书写 ， 如为其他语种，需另提供英文翻译件并公证 。 四、 申请时间 2026年11月1日—2027年2月28日 五、 申请步骤 1. 登录中国农业大学申请系统 ： http://apply.cau.edu.cn/，填写个人信息，选择专业，提交所需材料。 缴纳 报名费 400元人民币 （ 不予退还 ） ； 2. 在国家留学基金管理委员会（ CSC）留学生信息管理系统完成在线申请流程 ； 登录 CSC申请系统（CSC系统 ）： http://www.campuschina.org ，注册并点击 “在线申请”登录，选择B类，受理机构代码：10019。下载《中国政府奖学金申请表》并签名后，将扫描件提交至中国农业大学申请系统： http://apply.cau.edu.cn 。 六、 考核流程和方式 1. 申请材料 审核 2. 学院复试（考试或面试） 。 申请者将在考试或面试前一至两周收到通知； 3. 发放《预录取通知书》，学生在规定时间内将《预录取通知书》上传 CSC系统。 4. 中国政府奖学金管理委员会（ CSC）审核。 5. 发放《录取通知书》和《 外国留学人员来华确认表 》（ JW201表）。 七、 查询录取 信息 申请人可 登录 中国农业大学申请系统： http://apply.cau.edu.cn 查询 进度和 录取情况。 八、 注意事项 1. 被录取的学生必须按照中国农业大学的要求按时注册。无故未按时注册者，将被取消奖学金资格及中国农业大学的入学资格； 2. 体检不合格、有犯罪记录或无法提供学位证书原件者，将被取消奖学金资格及中国农业大学的入学资格； 3. 奖学金获得者不得变更就读院校、专业、研究领域或学习期限 ； 4. 奖学金生将由就读院校组织年度评审。通过评审者可获得下一年度的奖学金。 九、 奖学金覆盖内容 学费、校内住宿费（双人间）、生活津贴、保险费 注：国际旅费自理 十、 申请类别与奖学金期限 · 硕士研究生： 2/3学年 · 博士研究生：
