Applications are now open to master and Ph.D. students from all over the world. Please read the notice carefully and submit your application on time. 项目介绍 Program Introduction 中国政府奖学金 “高水平研究生”项目按照“个人申请、院校推荐、专家评审、择优录取”的原则，选拔录取具有优秀学科背景、突出专业能力及未来发展潜力的国际学生。项目相关内容简介如下： “Chinese Government Scholarship Program-High Level Postgraduate Program” is based on the principles of “individual application, institutional recommendation, expert assessment and selection on the basis of merit”, and selects international students with excellent academic background, professional ability and future development potential. A brief description of the program is as follows: 招生类别 Admission Category 全日制在校研究生（硕士研究生、博士研究生） Full-time Postgraduates: Master students and Ph.D. candidates 招生对象 Targeted Students 202 7 年 9 月入学新生 The prospective students for September intake, 202 7 申请条件 Eligibility 1. 非中国籍公民，身心健康； Non-Chinese citizens and be in good health both mentally and physically; 2. 申请攻读硕士学位者，年龄不超过 35 周岁 , 须具有学士学位； Be a bachelor’s degree holder under the age of 35 when applying for master’s programs; 3. 申请攻读博士学位者，年龄不超过 40 周岁，须具有硕士学位； Be a master’s degree holder under the age of 40 when applying for Ph.D. programs; 4. 申请以中文为教学语言的攻读硕士、博士学位者，中文水平须达到汉语水平考试（ HSK ）四级； Have acquired the Chinese proficiency of HSK Level 4 when applying for Chinese-taught master’s or Ph.D. programs; 5. 申请我校英语授课专业学习，应提供相应英语语言能力的证明，或提供不少于两年英语授课学习经历的证明。 Applicants for English-taught programs shall submit relevant proof of English proficiency, or documentation verifying at least two years of prior study in an English medium teaching environment. 6. 未获得中国各级政府和录取院校设立的其他奖学金资助。 Have not be awarded other scholarships offered by different levels of Chinese government, nor other universities or colleges. 申请材料 Application Requirements (1) 入学申请表 Application Form (2) 学历证书 Diploma or Graduation Certificate (3) 成绩单 Academic Transcript (4) 来华学习（研究）计划 Study/Research Plan in China (5) 推荐信 2 份 Two Recommendation Letters (6) 申请者护照复印件 Copy of Passport (7) 外国人体格检查记录 Physical Examination Record for Foreigners (8) 语言能力证书 Language Proficiency Certificate (9) 无犯罪记录证明 Non-criminal Record Certificate (10) 经济担保人担保函及银行存款证明 Financial Guarantee Letter and Bank Statement (11)2 寸白色背景彩色照片电子版，入学报到后须提交同版 10 张纸质版照片。 One electronic copy of a 2-inch color photo with white background; after registration, 10 printed copies of the same photo must be submitted. 奖学金内容 Scholarship Coverage 具体的奖学金内容以留学中国网公布的信息为准 : http://www.campuschina.org The specific details of scholarship are subject to the information on CSC website: http://www.campuschina.org 申请步骤 Application Process Ⅰ . 网上申请 Application Online 1. 申请人须在 “留学中国”网站 http://www.campuschina.org 提交申请（初始申请不需要提交预录取通知书或导师接收函）。 Submit applications at “CSC Study in China” website: http://www.campuschina.org (There is no need to submit the Pre-admission Notice or Acceptance Letter in the initial step of application). 2. 在 “留学中国”网站填写信息时，留学项目种类选择“ B 类 ”，中国矿业大学（北京）机构编号为 11413 。 When applying in “CSC Study in China” website, please select Program Category “Type B”. The Agency Number of CUMTB is 11413. 3. 录入个人信息并上传材料至 “补充材料”，直至点击【提交】完成申请。 Input personal information and upload documents to “ Supporting Documents ” as requested, then click Submit ” to complete the application. Ⅱ . 面试安排 Interview 申请人资料审核通过后，学校会通过邮件通知申请人进行面试。 After your application information is reviewed, CUMTB will notify you by email about the interview. 注：请确保邮箱地址正确，并定期检查邮箱，以免错过考试面试的通知。 Note: Please make sure your email address is correct and check your email regularly in order not to miss the notice of interview arrangement. Ⅲ . 录取与入学 Admission 中国矿业大学（北京）将组织专家进行初步评审，选拔具有优秀学科背景、专业能力和未来发展潜力的申请者推荐至国家留学基金委，最终录取结果以国家留学基金委学科专家评审结果为准。申请人可在 “中国政府奖学金留学管理信息系统”查询录取结果。被录取后，学生须严格按照学校规定的时间报到注册。报到时将核验最高学历证书及成绩单原件、《外国人体格检查表》、无犯罪证明、语言水平证明原件等申请材料。 China University of Mining and Technology-Beijing will organize experts to conduct preliminary evaluation, select applicants with excellent discipline background, professional ability and future development potential, and recommend them to Chinese Government Scholarship Committee. The final result shall be subject to the evaluation organized by Chinese Government Scholarship Committee. Applicants can check the admission results in the “Chinese Government Scholarship Study Abroad Management Information System”. If you are admitted, you shall register at CUMTB within stipulated time. The original highest academic certificate and transcripts, the Foreigner’s Physical Examination Form, Non-criminal Record and the original language proficiency certificate will be verified at the time of registration. 注：境外学生入校报到事宜将根据中国入境政策另行通知。 Note: Requirements concerning your registration at CUMTB will be notified in due time in accordance with China’s immigration policy. 申请截止日期 Application Deadline 2027 年 2 月 28 日 February 28th ， 2027 联系信息 Contact Information 地址：中华人民共和国北京市海淀区学院路，丁 11 号中国矿业大学（北京）综合楼 624 室，留学生办公室 Address: International Student Office (Room 624, Zonghe Building) China University of Mining and Technology-Beijing D11, Xueyuan Road, Haidian District, Beijing, People’s Republic of China Code: 100083 Tel: 86-10-62331239 Fax: 86-10-62339839 联系人：崔老师 (Claire) Contact Person: Ms. Cui (Claire) E-Mail: international@cumtb.edu.cn Website: http://international.cumtb.edu.cn/ 上一条： 2027年中国矿业大学（北京）来华留学生招生简章（中文授课） 下一条： International Master of Science in Advanced Mineral Resources Development 版权所有：中国矿业大学(北京) 国际合作与交流处 通讯地址：北京市海淀区学院路丁11号 邮编：100083

The enrollment is directly managed by a part of Chinese higher institutions. MOE entrusts China Scholarship Council (hereinafter referred to as CSC) to keep the enrollment record and carry out the routine management. Categories of Applicants and Duration of Scholarship Categories of Applicants Duration of Scholarship Master's Degree Students 2-3 academic years Doctor's Degree Students 3-4 academic years Note: 1. In principle, the courses will be taught in Chinese. Scholarship students are required to take one-year remedial Chinese language course and pass the examinations prior to the major study if their Chinese language level is not qualified. If students take one-year Chinese language course, the duration of the scholarship will be extended for one year. 2. Some courses can be taught in English. 3. Duration for scholarship specified at the time of admission can NOT be extended in principle. Application The applicants shall apply to Chinese higher institutions undertaking this program within the set period. The application period is from January to April. Applicants may refer to relevant Chinese higher institutions websites or CSC website (http:// www.csc.edu.cn/Lianhua/ ) for details. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 2. Applicants are not studying in Chinese universities. 3. Education background and age limit: - Applicants for master degree studies must have bachelor's degree and be under the age of 35. - Applicants for Doctoral degree studies must have master's degree and be under the age of 40. Details of the Scholarship 1. Full scholarship: - Exempt from registration fee, tuition fee, fee for laboratory experiment, fee for internship, fee for basic learning materials and accommodation on campus; - Living allowance; - One-off settlement subsidy after registration; - Fee for outpatient medical service, Comprehensive Medical Insurance and Benefit Plan for International Students in China. Note: 1) Costs of the laboratory experiment or internship that beyond the university's arrangements should be afforded by the student himself. 2) Fee for basic learning materials covers the necessary learning materials prescribed by the host institution, and other materials shall be self afforded. 3) Monthly living allowance is paid to the students by the host institution at the following rates (CNY Yuan per month): - Master degree students: CNY 1,700 Yuan - Doctoral degree students: CNY 2,000 Yuan Scholarship students shall get their monthly living allowance from the date of registration. New students who register before 15th (15th included) of the registration month will get the full amount of the living allowance of that month, and those who register after 15th will get half amount. The graduates will be given a living allowance for another 15 days after the graduation time set by the university. The allowance will be terminated from the next month after students suspend their studies, drop school or complete schooling from the university. Monthly living allowance covers school holidays. Scholarship students who do not get the monthly living allowance during holidays can get that upon return on campus. The allowance will be suspended for one month if students do not register on time without permission from the university in advance, leave for non-health reasons or are absent from the university over a month. Students who have to suspend their studies because of serious diseases should go back to the home country and pay for the international trip by themselves. With the university's approval, the scholarship status can be reserved for at most one year, and their living allowances will be suspended at the same time. The scholarship will be terminated for those who suspend their studies for other reasons. 4) New students will get one-off settlement subsidy upon arrival in China. - CNY 1,000 Yuan for new students who will study in China up to six months - CNY 1,500 Yuan for new students who will study in China for one academic year or more 5) Fee for outpatient medical service refers to the outpatient expense in the institution's hospital or the hospitals appointed by the institution. The students should pay for a certain percentage of expense in accordance with the institution's relevant regulations. 6) Comprehensive Medical Insurance and Benefit Plan for International Students in China is provided by MOE for the scholarship students in China against hospitalizing for serious diseases and accidental injuries. The institutions or the appointed medical assistance agency provide advancement service for insurance expenses, and claim for compensation with relevant payment receipts from the insurance company according to the stipulated insurance articles. The claim of individual student will not be accepted by the insurance company. 7) International travel expenses: self-afforded. Application Materials The applicants must fill in and provide the following materials truly and correctly (in duplicate). 1. Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (printed by CSC), filled in Chinese or in English. It can be downloaded from CSC website ( www.csc.edu.cn ). 2. Highest diploma (notarized photocopy). If applicants are university students or already employed, they shall also provide studying certificates or employment documents. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English. 3. Transcripts (notarized photocopy). Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English. 4. A study or research plan in Chinese or in English (no less than 800 words). 5. Two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English by professors or associate professors. 6. Applicants for music are requested to submit one CD recording of the applicants' own work. Applicants for fine arts must submit one CD recording of the applicants' own work (including two sketches, two color paintings and two other works). 7. Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form (printed by Chinese quarantine authority and only for those whose period of studies in China lasts up to six months) filled in English. The medical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form . Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. The medical examination results are valid for 6 months. All applicants are kindly requested to take this factor into consideration while determining the time to take the medical examination. The above materials should directly reach Chinese higher institutions undertaking this program by March 31th 2009. Individual applications will not be accepted by CSC. Approval and Notification 1. Chinese higher institutions will review the application materials and decide on the list of accepted students. 2. Chinese higher institutions are supposed to send photocopies of the application materials including Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship, highest diploma, and Foreigner Physical Examination Form and List of Accepted Students, Admission Notice and Visa Application Form for Study In China (JW201) to CSC by May 31, 2009. 3. CSC will review and file the enrollment results and issue Visa Application Form for Study In China (JW201) . 4. CSC will send the Final List of Accepted Students, Admission Notice and Visa Application Form for Study In China (JW201) to Chinese higher institutions by July 31, 2009, who will forward the documents to the students. 5. Scholarship students' affairs shall be managed according to relevant regulations of Chinese Government Scholarship. Students are not allowed to change their institutions. In principle, students are not permitted to change their academic programs, or the duration of study specified in the Admission Notice . contact China Scholarship Council Tel: 0086-10-66093917 66093918 E-mail: jwang@csc.edu.cn lchen@csc.edu.cn Fax: 0086-10-66093915 Web: http:// www.csc.edu.cn/Lianhua/ Address: Level 13, Building A3, No.9 Chegongzhuang Avenue, Beijing 100044, P. The university has 2 2 departments, a graduate department and a direct teaching department. It is the first batch of universit ies in China to have the right to grant bachelor's and master's degrees, and the first batch of universit ies in the provincial institutions to obtain doctoral degree awarding authority . JLAU has a teaching staff of 1,783 and 27,011 full-time students. JLAU has implemented the strategy of opening-up and unceasingly broadened educational dimensions, and set up bilateral exchange and cooperation relationship s with 100 universities and research institutes abroad in 31 countries, such as the U.S., Italy, Zambia, etc . Moreover, i t is a member university of the Chinese side of the "China-Africa Universities 100 Cooperation Plan ," and it is also a director member of the Belt and Road South-South Cooperation Agricultural Education, Science and Technology Innovation League (BRSSCAL), a vice chairman member of the China -Africa Research Center for the Development of Green Agriculture , and is the first provincial universit y in Jilin Province to carry out state-level foreign aid training and the first overseas human resources training unit in the country to "go out ." JLAU partners with the Confucius Institute in Agricultural Science and Technology at the National University of Lesotho in Lesotho . On behalf of the Chinese Government, JLAU constructed one of the first China Aid Program Agricultural Technology Demonstration Center s in Zambia, which has been known as the ‘South-South Cooperation Model’. I. Application Dates and Institution Codes Now to February 10, 2027 Receiving Institution No. (Agency No.): 10193 (Jilin Agricultural U niversity) Program type: B II. Planned Admission For the 2027-2028 academic year, Jilin Agricultural University is eligible to recommend five applicants to the China Scholarship Council. The specific number of admission s is subject to approval from the China Scholarship Council. Ⅲ. Program Information 1. Applicant category: Master/ Ph.D. programs 2. Language of instruction: Chinese/English 3. Duration of the program: Master's program (3 years) and Ph.D. program (4 years) 4. The catalog of admitted majors is shown in Annex I (the final name of the majors is subject to the final approval of the Ministry of Education and the admission letter) 5. Funding Benefits ① Tuition fees and application fees are waived. ② Accommodation fees are waived. ③ Living expenses are provided. ④ Comprehensive medical insurance fees are provided. (International travel expenses shall be borne by the grantee themselves.) For more information, please visit the CSC official website: https://www.campuschina.org/ Ⅳ. Eligibility Criteria 1.Non-Chinese citizens in good physical and mental health are eligible to apply. 2. The applicant must be an academically excellent holder of a Bachelor’s degree under the age of 35 when applying for a Master’s program;The applicant must be an academically excellent holder of a Master’s degree under the age of 40 when applying for a doctoral program. 3. Language Requirements Applicants selecting Chinese-taught programs must reach Level 4 of the Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi (HSK Level 4) in terms of Chinese proficiency. Those who have obtained a degree from a Chinese university with Chinese as the medium of instruction are not required to provide the Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi (HSK) certificate. Applicants selecting English-taught program must meet at least one of the following conditions: native English; official English; major English; TOEFL 8 5 or above or IELTS 6.0 . 4.Meet the admission requirements of Jilin Agricultural University in terms of academic ability, language ability and other relevant conditions. Ⅴ. Application documents and application process (I) Please refer to Annex I for application document requirements. (II) Application Procedure 1. Application in the CSC system: Login to the Management Information System of Chinese Government Scholarships for Studying in China https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn, select TypeB, and enter the accepting organization No. 10193 (Jilin Agricultural University ), fill in the information and submit it online, and then download the Application Form of the Chinese Government Scholarship. After submitting the registration information, applicants are required to send the Chinese Government Scholarship Application Form to the official email address of the International Student Admissions Office of Jilin Agricultural University , shown below: aboard@jlau.edu.cn Note: Please see Annex Ⅲ for the system application instructions . 2. University system application (very important): After completing the application on the CSC website, you must also submit the application in the University application system (http://jlau.liuguanbao.com ), and the relevant documents must be exactly the same as those in the CSC system (Note: If you do not apply on the website of Jilin Agricultural University , we will not be able to accept your application). 3. Preliminary review: Adhering to the principle of “individual application, school recommendation, expert review, and selective admission , ” this program is aimed at selecting international students with excellent academic backgrounds , professional capabilities, and future development potential . The application will be reviewed in accordance with the enrollment requirements, and then the academic schools will review the application. 4. Academic review: A round March 15, 202 7 , each academic school will organize expert s review to comprehensively evaluate the applicant's academic ability, language proficiency, educational background, and development potential through interviews or written tests. 5. Issuance of pre-admission notice: The University will issue pre-admission notices to applicants who have passed the academic review of the University on the basis of merit. Applicants who have got the pre-admission qualification must log in the Management Information System of Chinese Government Scholarships for Studying in China (https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn) again before March 2 8 , 202 7 to submit the pre-admission notice and other required materials. VI. Other Notes 1. Jilin Agricultural University will send the pre-admission notice via email by March 28 , 202 7 . Failure to receive the pre-admission notice will be considered as failure to receive the recommendation from the University. The final result of the program will be announced in July or August 202 7 . Please be patient. 2. Applicants must ensure the authenticity of the application documents and will be disqualified if the materials are found to be inaccurate. 3. Chinese Government Scholarship students are not allowed to receive other scholarship s (excluding all kinds of one-time awards) established by local governments and domestic universities at the same time. Once discovered, the qualification of Chinese government scholarship will be canceled, and the awarded Chinese government scholarship must be returned. Those who intentionally conceal their financial support will not be allowed to apply for Chinese Government Scholarships for three years, including the disqualification of their applications. 4. Each academic school interviews applicants by phone or online, so please make sure that the phone number and e-mail address in the application form are correct. 5. All applications must be submitted online. E-mail applications or paper applications will not be accepted. 6. Please be sure to provide a correct e-mail address and mailing address. We will confirm each item of important information via e-mail, so be sure to check it daily. 7. Jilin Agricultural University has not authorized any individuals or intermediaries to conduct the enrollment of Chinese Government Scholarship students. Please contact our university directly for inquiries regarding scholarship applications, and all applicants must submit relevant information on the official website of the China Scholarship Council (CSC) ( https://www.campuschina.org/ ). VII. “高水平研究生”项目招生简章 发布时间：2026/11/03 10:36 浏览次数： 吉林大学始建于 1946 年，是教育部直属全国重点综合性大学，国家首批 “985 工程 ”“211 工程 ” 重点建设高校。 2017 年首批入选 “ 双一流 ” 建设 A 类高校。 2022 年第二轮 “ 双一流 ” 建设高校及建设学科名单中，学校 6 个学科入选。 学校学科门类齐全，涵盖哲学、经济学、法学、教育学、文学、历史学、理学、工学、农学、医学、管理学、艺术学、交叉学科等 13 大学科门类，拥有学士 — 硕士 — 博士完整的高水平人才培养体系，在校学生人数 7 万余人。学校聚焦 “ 双一流 ” 建设目标，全球合作网络不断优化，与 45 个国家和地区的 320 所高校和科研机构建立合作伙伴关系。 中国政府奖学金 “ 高水平研究生 ” 项目，旨在选拔具有优秀学科背景、 突出 专业能力及未来发展潜力的国际学生。吉林大学将充分发挥学科优势特色，努力培养高水平国际人才。 一、 招生类别及专业 全日制在校研究生（硕士生、博士生） 中、英文授课硕士生、博士生招生专业目录详见附件 1 。 硕士生基础学制分为 2 年或 3 年，相应最长学习年限为 3 年或 4 年； 博士生基础学制为 4 年，最长学习年限为 6 年。 二、 申请条件 1. 非中国籍公民，身心健康。 2. 年龄、学历、语言要求： (1) 申请攻读硕士学位者，须具有学士学位，学习成绩优秀，年龄不超过 35 周岁； (2) 申请攻读博士学位者，须具有硕士学位，学习成绩优秀，年龄不超过 40 周岁； (3) 以中文为专业教学语言的申请人，中文水平须达到汉语水平考试（ HSK ）四级； (4) 申请人应同时符合所申请专业的学术能力、语言能力及其他相关方面的入学要求。 三、 奖学金内容 申请人在华学习期间的学费，综合医疗保险 ， 生活费和住宿费补助 （ 住宿费补助标准：本科生 / 硕士研究生： 700 元 / 人 / 月，博士研究生： 1000 元 / 人 / 月 ） 。 四、 申请及审核录取流程 第一步：申请人在吉林大学国际学生报名系统提交申请 申请截止时间为 2027 年 3 月 1 日。 2027 年 1 月 1 日前提交申请将优先进行第一批集中审核推荐。 申请人应当在吉林大学国际学生报名系统提交申请。提交材料（具体要求详见附件 2 ）包括： 护照首页、经公证的最高学历证明、学习成绩单、语言能力证明、来华学习计划、推荐信、《外国人体格检查表》、无犯罪记录证明、研究成果等 。 申请人应在吉林大学国际学生报名系统（ http://apply.jlu.edu.cn ）注册账户，准确填报个人资料信息，点击 “ 提交 ” 完成线上申请。 本年度招生采取网上申报，申请人应确保网上所提交材料与原件一致。申请材料齐全方可进入下一轮审核环节。 第二步：吉林大学国际教育学院初审 202 7 年 3 月 2 日，国际教育学院依据招生要求，对申请人资格进行逐项审核，重点审核学历背景、语言水平、身份资格、健康状况等，初审合格后商请教学培养单位复审。 第三步：吉林大学教学培养单位复审、远程面试或笔试 202 7 年 3 月 7 日前，教学培养单位组织专家复审，重点审查申请人学习成绩、科研能力、语言水平、学术背景、综合素质及发展潜力，择优进行远程面试或笔试，并将结果反馈给国际教育学院。 第四步：在中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统提交申请 202 7 年 3 月 10 日前，学校通过邮箱或国际学生报名系统通知申请人预录取结果并提供预录取通知，申请人在中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统中进行申请。 第五步：向国家留学基金委推荐人选 202 7 年 3 月 15 日，学校向国家留学基金委报送推荐名单。 第六步：国家留学基金委组织专家评审 国家留学基金委组织相关学科专家对申请人的学业成绩、综合素质、发展潜力等方面进行评审，并择优录取。 未被录取的奖学金申请人，如有意愿申报我校自费项目，优先录取。 第七步：通知学生录取结果 吉林大学国际教育学院通知学生录取结果。 备注： 1. 录取学生须严格按学校规定时间完成注册报到手续，未按要求如期报到者，奖学金资格不予保留。 2. 未按时取得相应毕、结业证书或体检不合格者，将被取消奖学金录取资格。 3. 申请时常见问题请浏览吉林大学国际教育学院网站 。 https://cie.jlu.edu.cn/info/1060/3133.htm 五、 申请截止时间 202 7 年 3 月 1 日 六、 入学时间 202 7 年 9 月 七、 校内公寓住宿费参考标准 公寓名称 收费标准 友谊会馆 3 0-60 元 / 天 · 床 大学城留学生公寓 25-50 元 / 天 · 床 和谐家园留学生公寓 1200 元 / 月 · 套 八、 注意事项 1. 中国政府奖学金生不得同时享受中国各级政府和录取院校设立的其他奖学金（不含各类一次性奖励金）的资助，一经发现，其中国政府奖学金资格将予以取消，并须退还已领取的中国政府奖学金。对于刻意隐瞒资助情况的，除取消资格外，三年内不允许申请中国政府奖学金。 2. 已在中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统申报其他高校的申请人，请勿重复申请吉林大学。 3. 奖学金获得者一经录取，不得变更学习专业、学习期限和授课语言。 4. 奖学金生入校后须参加年度评审，以评审结果确认下一学年是否资助、中止或取消奖学金资格。 九、 联系方式 吉林大学国际教育学院国际学生招生办公室 电话： +86-431-85166885 地址：中国吉林省长春市修正路 1505 号吉林大学友谊会馆 216 室 邮编： 130012 邮箱： admissions@jlu.edu.cn 网址： https://www.jlu.edu.cn/ Program Categories, Study Duration and Language of Instruction 1.This scholarship supports postgraduate programs; 2.The study duration is 2-3 years for master’s programs, and 4 years for doctoral programs; 3. Most postgraduate programs are taught in Chinese, and some master’s programs can be taught in English. For the catalog of English-taught Master’s programs, refer to Annex 1 at the bottom. Ⅱ . Application Time From now on to January 31, 2027. Ⅲ . Eligibility To be eligible, the applicant must: l be a citizen of a country other than the People’s Republic of China, and be in good health; l be a bachelor’s degree holder under the age of 35 generally when applying for a master’s program; l be a master’s degree holder under the age of 40 generally when applying for a doctoral program. Ⅳ . Scholarship Coverage l Tuition waiver; l Free accommodation on campus or accommodation subsidy; l Stipend: Master's students: CNY 3,000 per month; Doctoral students: CNY 3,500 per month; l Comprehensive Medical Insurance: CNY 800/person/year. For more details, please refer to Link 1 . Ⅴ . Application Procedure 1. Applicants should submit the application via the CSC Online Application System for Study in China ( Link 2 ), and download the Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship. The agency number for Minzu University of China is 10052. The s cholarship for Chinese University Program is Type B in the CSC application system . For the initial submission, applicants may submit a blank page in the “Pre-admission Materials” section. Those who have passed the review procedure shall submit the pre-admission notice issued by MUC after receiving it from us. 2. Please log in to the MUC Online Application System For International Students ( Link 3 ), complete the online application and pay the application fee of CNY600 which is non-refundable no matter admitted or not. VI. Application Documents 1. Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship （in Chinese or English）. 2. Personal Information Page of Passport. If the validity of the applicant’s current passport does not meet the requirement, which means the expiry date of the passport should be after March 1, 2028, please apply for a new passport before submitting the application. Passport information cannot be changed before registration of enrollment. 3. Notarized Highest Diploma : Prospective diploma winners must submit official proof of student status by their current school. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. 4. Academic Transcripts : Copies of academic records from first to last semester during the undergraduate, graduate (if any), and doctoral programs (if any) shall be provided. These transcripts shall be issued and sealed by the attending university’s academic affairs office, graduate school, or student management department. They can be in Chinese or English, but must be attached with notarized English translations if they are in foreign languages other than English. 5. P ersonal Statement: Doctoral program applicants are requir ed to write at least 1500 words, and master’s program applicants are requir ed to write at least 1000 words, in Chinese or English. The content includes, but is not limited to, academic background, work experience and achievements, application reasons, research plan, career goals after graduation, etc. The template is available in Annex 2. 6. Two Letters of Recommendation : Two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors. The letter shall describe , but is not limited to, the applicant’s objectives of learning in China, research capabilities, work achievements, evaluation of future growth, as well as the professor’s signature and contact information. The recommendation date should not be earlier than September 1, 2026. 7. Language P roficiency Certificates : Chinese-taught program applicants must provide an HSK c ertificate of level 4 or above. English-taught program applicants must provide an official transcript such as a TOEFL score of ≥80, an IELTS overall band score≥6.0, or a proof of equivalent English proficiency recognized by MUC (excluding native English speakers). 8. Foreigner Physical Examination Form : The physical examinations must cover all of the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form, filled in Chinese or English. Incomplete forms or forms without the signature of the attending physician, or the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicant are considered invalid. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only 6 months. The template is available in Annex 3 . 9. Non-Criminal Record Report: The applicant shall submit a valid certificate of Non-Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months prior to the submission date of the application. 10. Individual Works : The applicants for the arts or design program shall provide their own works (such as videos and paintings) via the online application system. 11. Supervisor Acceptance Letter (if any) : The Doctoral program applicants are expected to submit a Supervisor Acceptance Letter, including the information of a prospective supervisor from Minzu University of China, the descriptions of the applicant’s studies or research in China etc. The template is available in Annex 4. VII. .C ontact Information University Address: Student Affairs Office 202, College of International Education, Minzu University of China, 27 Zhongguancun South Avenue, Haidian District, Beijing 100081, P.R.China Tel: (86-10) 68933263 E-mail: schlr@muc.edu.cn Website: https://cie.muc.edu.cn Annex 1： English-taught Program Introduction.pdf Annex 2：PERSONAL STATEMENT.docx Annex 3： PHYSICAL EXAMINATION FORM.pdf Annex 4：SUPERVISOR ACCEPTANCE LETTER.docx 关闭 打印 返回上一级 校园信息门户 中央民族大学 联系我们 学校地址: 中国北京海淀区中关村南大街27号 学院办公室：010-68933306 国际学生管理办公室：010-68933263 师生风采

学院通知 -> 正文 关于申请南昌大学2027—2028学年中国政府奖学金“高水平研究生”项目的通知 来源: 日期：2026-11-05 点击量： 南昌大学2027-2028学年中国政府奖学金“高水平研究生”项目招生工作现已正式启动。该奖学金面向有意来我校攻读硕士或博士学位的来华留学生，欢迎符合条件的学生积极申报，我校将组织专家对申请者进行面试考核，通过考核者将被推荐至国家留学基金管理委员会进行奖学金资格最终评审。 1. 申请条件 (1)非中国籍公民，身心健康。 (2)年龄、学历、语言要求： ① 申请攻读硕士学位者，应当具有学士学位或同等学历，学习成绩优秀，年龄不超过 35 周岁； ② 申请攻读博士学位者，应当具有硕士学位或同等学历，学习成绩优秀，年龄一般不超过 40 周岁； ③ 中文授课项目申请者，中文水平须达到汉语水平考试（HSK）四级；曾使用中文为教学语言获得中国高校相应学位的，可不提供汉语水平考试（HSK）证明； ④ 符合南昌大学对来华留学生在语言能力、学术能力及其它相关方面的入学要求。 2.申请材料 (1) 护照首页 如现持有护照有效期不符合要求（护照有效期应晚于2027年9月），请及时申请新护照。 (2) 经公证的最高学历证明 如申请人为在校学生，须提交本人就读学校出具的预计毕业证明或在学证明。 (3) 学习成绩单 成绩单扫描件应包括本科、硕士（如有）、博士（如有）学习阶段（如为在校生，成绩应覆盖上一学期）。成绩单应由就读学校教务处、研究生院或有关管理部门开具并盖章。可提供中/英文版本，如为英语以外语种，需另提供中文或英文翻译件及公证件。 (4) 语言能力证明 申请以中文为授课语言的申请人须提供有效期内且与相应中文水平要求相符的HSK成绩报告。 (5) 来华学习计划 应提交中/英文学习计划（1000 字以上），博士研究生的学习计划须由中方导师签字。 (6) 推荐信 提交所申请专业领域两名专家（具有副教授以上职称）具的推荐信，内容应包含对申请人来华学习动机、学生综合能力，未来发展预期等，推荐信要求中文或英文书写。 (7) 个人作品 艺术、设计类专业申请者，可通过“作品/其他支撑材料”上传个人作品集等材料（如影像、绘画作品等）。 (8) 《外国人体格检查表》 此表格由中国卫生检疫部门统一印制。申请人应严格按照《外国人体格检查表》中要求的项目进行检查。缺项、未贴有本人照片或照片上未盖骑缝章、无医师和医院签字盖章的《外国人体格检查表》无效，检查结果有效期为 6 个月。 (9) 无犯罪记录证明 申请人须提交由所在地公安机关出具的无犯罪记录证明，出具日期应为提交申请之日前6个月以内。 *注意：上述所有材料须清晰、真实、有效。建议申请人使用专业设备扫描有关文件，因材料不清晰或无法识别造成的后果由申请人自行承担。 3.申请流程 (1)申请者登录南昌大学来华留学生在线申请平台： https://apply.ncu.edu.cn/ 按要求如实填写信息并上传材料。 (2)申请截止日期为2027年3月1日，我校将对申请者进行资格审查，统一组织符合条件的申请者参与面试考核，并依据考核成绩确定奖学金候选人推荐名单。 (3)候选人登录国家留学基金管理委员会留学生在线申请系统 www.csc.edu.cn/laihua， 填写《中国政府奖学金申请表》并上传所有申请材料。在线填写申请时，申请类型为B类，请确保机构代码填写正确（南昌大学代码：10403）。 4.招生专业 我校所有专业均可申请，专业列表可扫码查看附件。 5.联系方式 南昌大学国际教育学院留学生招生办公室 电话：86-791-83968702 邮箱： study@ncu.edu.cn 下一篇: 2026年南昌大学“丝绸之路”中国政府奖学金项目申请指南 地址：江西省南昌市红谷滩区学府大道999号 邮编：330031 联系方式：+86-791-83969196 招生邮箱： study@ncu.edu.cn uni-northeast-normal-university.text: ﻿ Admission Guidelines for the Chinese Government Scholarship High-level Graduates Program (Type B), Northeast Normal University, 2027-2028-留学东师 中文 | English Home About NENU About NENU Schools & Departments About Changchun Contact Us Admission Bachelor's Program Master's Program Doctoral Program Language Learning Program Pre-University Program Exchange Student Program Highlighted Program English-taught Program Short-term Program Scholarship Chinese Government Scholarship International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship Mofcom Scholarship Presidential Scholarship for Outstanding International Students NENU Scholarships for Outstanding Self-Financed International Students Faculty Profiles Faculty of Education School of Psychology School of Politics and Law Business School School of Literature School of History and Culture School of International Studies School of Music and Dance School of Fine Arts Faculty of Marxism School of Mathematics and Statistics School of Information Science and Technology School of Physics School of Chemistry School of Life Sciences School of Geographical Sciences School of Environment School of Physical Education School of Media Science School of International Chinese Education Center for Ideological and Political Education Campus Life Regulations Accommodation Insurance Visa Email Student Identity Account Campus Map Student Activity Upcoming Activities Activity Recap Video NENU Promotion Student Activities Vlog Download Notice Notice Home >> 正文 Admission Guidelines for the Chinese Government Scholarship High-level Graduates Program (Type B), Northeast Normal University, 2027-2028 发布日期：2026-10-26 作者： 来源： 点击： I. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens. 2. Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, have strong academic records and good conduct, and comply with Chinese laws and regulations and NENU rules. 3. Applicants must not concurrently receive other scholarships funded by Chinese governments or universities. The exception for one-time awards and the consequences of concurrent funding are set out in Section VIII. 4. Applicants for master's programs must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent, have an excellent academic record, and be aged 35 or younger. Applicants for doctoral programs must hold a master's degree or equivalent, have an excellent academic record, and be aged 40 or younger. 5. For Chinese-taught programs, applicants must have HSK Level 5 with a score of at least 180. Applicants who obtained a degree from a Chinese university through Chinese-medium instruction are exempt from the HSK requirement. For English-taught programs, applicants must meet at least one of the following conditions: TOEFL 80 or above or IELTS 6.0 or above; English is their native or official language; or they obtained a degree through English-medium instruction. II. Programs Please consult NENU Master's and Doctoral Programs for International Students 2027 and select a program by subject, degree level and language of instruction. III. Scholarship Coverage 1. Tuition and on-campus accommodation fees are waived. 2. A living allowance during study in China: RMB 3,500 per month for doctoral students and RMB 3,000 per month for master's students. 3. Comprehensive medical insurance for international students in China. IV. Application Period Applications will be accepted from the publication date of this notice until February 28, 2027 (Beijing time). V. Application Procedure Step 1: Apply through the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System. Visit https://www.campuschina.org , enter the scholarship application system and register an account. Select Type B and enter Agency Number 10200 (Northeast Normal University). Complete and submit the online application, then download the Chinese Government Scholarship Application Form. Please refer to the CSC Application Guide for details. Step 2: Apply through the NENU International Student Service System at https://studyatnenu.nenu.edu.cn or https://nenu.17gz.org . Complete and submit the online application. Please refer to the NENU Application Guide for details. Applicants cannot edit their information after submission. Step 3: Review and interview. NENU reviews applicants' academic backgrounds, language proficiency and professional competence, and selects candidates for online interviews. Interview invitations are sent by email. Step 4: Preliminary review and nomination. NENU will complete its preliminary review by mid-March 2027, select nominated candidates and send pre-admission notices by email. Step 5: Upload the pre-admission notice. Nominated candidates must return to the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System and upload the required documents within the period specified in NENU's email. Failure to do so will result in disqualification. Step 6: Final evaluation and admission. Following individual application, institutional nomination, expert review and selection on merit, the China Scholarship Council evaluates candidates' academic achievements, overall abilities and development potential and makes the final selection. VI. Application Documents 1. Chinese Government Scholarship Application Form, completed online in Chinese or English. 2. Passport information page and all Chinese visa pages, if any. The passport must remain valid beyond September 2027. 3. Notarized degree certificates, starting from the undergraduate level. Current students must submit an expected graduation certificate issued by their university and obtain the degree required for their intended program before September 2027. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must include notarized Chinese or English translations. 4. Scanned copies of academic transcripts, starting from the undergraduate level, covering all bachelor's, master's (if any) and doctoral (if any) study through the latest semester. Transcripts must be issued and stamped by the academic affairs office, graduate school or relevant student administration office. Documents in other languages must include notarized Chinese or English translations. 5. Language proficiency evidence. For Chinese-taught programs, submit a valid HSK Level 5 result of at least 180 or evidence of a Chinese-medium degree obtained at a Chinese university. For English-taught programs, submit TOEFL 80 or above, IELTS 6.0 or above, or evidence of an English-medium degree. 6. Research Proposal, written in Chinese or English: at least 1,000 Chinese characters for a proposal written in Chinese, or at least 1,000 words for one written in English. Doctoral applicants must have their research proposal signed by their prospective NENU supervisor. Templates: https://iso.nenu.edu.cn/Download.htm . 7. Two recommendation letters in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors. Each letter must be signed and state the recommender's position and contact information. Letters should discuss the applicant's objectives for studying in China, overall abilities and future potential, as well as cooperation between Chinese and overseas supervisors or exchanges between their institutions. 8. Portfolio, where applicable. Applicants for arts, design and related programs must submit examples of their work, such as videos or artwork. 9. Foreigner Physical Examination Form, available in the Download section. Complete it in English and undergo all listed examinations. Incomplete forms, forms without the applicant's photograph bearing a hospital seal across its edge, or forms without the physician's signature or hospital stamp are invalid. Results are valid for six months; plan the examination accordingly. 10. A valid non-criminal record certificate issued by the local public security authority, normally within the six months preceding submission of the application. 11. Academic achievements, if any, such as published papers or patents. 12. Conditional acceptance letter from a supervisor, if any. Applicants may contact a supervisor directly; the letter is optional. Templates are in the Download section and supervisor information is available at https://iso.nenu.edu.cn/Faculty_Profiles.htm . Doctoral applicants must still obtain the supervisor signature on the research proposal required in item 6. 13. Other supporting documents requested by the International Students Office. All uploaded documents must be legible, authentic and valid. Professional scanning equipment is recommended. Applicants are responsible for the consequences of illegible documents. VII. Admission and Registration 1. NENU will notify applicants of the final admission results by email before July 2027 and send the Admission Notice and the Confirmation Form for Study in China (JW201). 2. Scholarship recipients must register in late August or early September 2027, on the date specified in the Admission Notice. Those unable to arrive on time must obtain NENU's approval in advance. Failure to register on time without approval will be treated as withdrawal, and the scholarship will not be retained. VIII. Important Information 1. Applicants must apply directly to NENU. Applications submitted through agencies will result in disqualification from the scholarship. 2. Where necessary, NENU will contact applicants from admission@nenu.edu.cn for supplementary documents or admission results. Provide an accurate email address and check it regularly. 3. Recipients may not concurrently receive a Chinese Government Scholarship and other scholarships funded by Chinese governments or universities, except one-time awards. Violations will result in cancellation of the scholarship and repayment of funds already received. Deliberate concealment also results in a three-year ban on applying for Chinese Government Scholarships. 4. Scholarship eligibility will not be retained for those who fail to register by the required date. Applicants unable to arrive on time must obtain prior approval under Section VII. Bringing family members to China without NENU's approval is not permitted. 5. All original application documents must be presented at registration. Applicants are responsible for the authenticity of their information and documents. False or misleading application information or documents will result in cancellation of admission or, for enrolled students, cancellation of student status. 6. Recipients must participate in the annual scholarship review. Recipients who fail the annual review will have their scholarships suspended or canceled. 7. In principle, recipients may not change their major or duration of study. IX. uni-northwest-a-f-university.text: 英文 Contact Us CN Search Navigation Colleges & Departments Application Guide Scholarships Short-term Programs Fees & Bank Account Info Notification & Admission Results Promo Materials FAQs Home ｜ Scholarships Scholarships Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B) Release time：2026-10-20 Clicks： Author： Classification：Scholarships Northwest A&F University Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B) Northwest A&F University (NWAFU) welcomes outstanding international postgraduate students to apply for the Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B) for every year. Founded in 1934, Northwest A&F University (NWAFU) is a university directly under China’s Ministry of Education of China. As a key university supported by the Ministry’s "Project 985" and "Project 211", it is also one of the select universities designated for the National "World-Class University and First-class Discipline" Project. Today, NWAFU is recognized as one of China's leading agricultural universities, offering the most comprehensive range of agricultural, forestry and water-related disciplines in China. This fully funded scholarship provides talented students from around the world with the opportunity to study in a dynamic academic community, access cutting-edge research, and experience the rich cultural heritage of Xi’an—the historic heart of Chinese civilization. Programs & Duration Doctoral Degrees (Most disciplines): 4 years Master's Degrees (Selected disciplines): 3 years Scholarship Benefits : ✔ 100% tuition coverage ✔ Free on-campus accommodation ✔ Comprehensive medical insurance ✔ Monthly stipend Eligibility Non-Chinese citizens in good physical & mental health Age: under 35 (Master’s) / under 40 (Ph.D) Academic background: Bachelor’s degree (Master’s applicants) / Master’s degree (PhD applicants) Language: IELTS 5.5+ / TOEFL 79+ / HSK 4+ Application Deadline High-Level Program: Early November to the end of February of the following year Silk Road Program: Early November to the end of April of the following year Application Procedure Apply via the CSC portal: studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login Type B, Agency Code: 10712 Contacts Admissions Office, Northwest A&F University 3 Taicheng Road, Yangling, Shaanxi, China ☎ +86 29 87080182 | ✉ admission@nwafu.edu.cn Northwest A&F University Detailed Application Guidance for CSC Scholarship (Type B) I. Application Deadline Deadline: February 28, every year Note: Mainly for doctoral students; a small number of Master’s programs are eligible. I I. Eligibility Requirements Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good physical and mental health. Academic background & age limits: Master’s: Bachelor’s degree, under 35 Doctoral: Master’s degree, under 40 Must hold a valid passport (minimum 9 months validity). Applicants have not been receiving funding from any other scholarships;. Language requirements: English-medium programs: IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL 79+ or institutional proof of English Proficiency. Chinese-medium programs: HSK 4+ III. Scholarship Benefits Covers: Tuition, on-campus accommodation, monthly stipend, medical insurance Excludes: International travel, off-campus internships, or non-university labs I V. Required Application Materials All documents must be in English or Chinese. If not, notarized translations are required. Submit to both CSC and NWAFU application systems. 1.CSC Scholarship Application Form (Type B, Agency Code: 10712). 2. Acceptance Letter from a Potential Supervisor (mandatory). 3.Notarized Degree certificate (or provisional/hope certificate). 4. Academic transcripts (notarized). 5. Two recommendation letters. 6. Study Plan / Research Proposal 7. Passport copy (valid for at least 9 months). 8. Police Clearance Certificate (valid 6 months). 9. Medical Examination Record ( mandatory) (download: https://is.nwsuaf.edu.cn/docs/20161019153231791636.pdf ). 10. Supporting documents (CV, publications, awards, etc.). Note: If degree not issued yet → provide provisional or hope certificate If transcript not complete → provide semester results I ELTS is encouraged but not compulsory (except HSK 4 is mandatory for Chinese-medium programs) V. Application Procedure Step 1: Get an Acceptance Letter from a potential professor. → Visit the NWAFU portal for the supervisor list of international student programs ( https://en.nwsuaf.edu.cn/collegesandinstitutes/index.htm .) Step 2: CSC online application via: https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login Step 3: Complete NWAFU’s online application via: https://nwsuaf.17gz.org/ → Choose Chinese Government Scholarship → Choose Master or Doctor →Upload required documents Step 4: Pay the non-refundable application fee of CNY 400 or USD 75 after qualification review (No refund) Note: Payment Option. In-person payment: Finance Office, South Campus (card only). Bank transfer: Account Name: Northwest A&F University Account No.: 102810820826 Bank: Bank of China, Yangling Sub-branch Swift Code: BKCHCNBJ620 Address: Weihui Road, Yangling, Shaanxi, China VI. Available Programs 1. High-Level Postgraduate Scholarship: Open to all PhD/Master's programs. 2. Silk Road Program: Applicable to selected PhD/Master's programs, with country-specific restrictions. Programs planned for this year: Animal Genetics, Breeding and Reproduction; Plant Pathology; Soil Science; Crop Genetics and Breeding; Soil and Water Conservation and Desertification Control. Nationality scope: Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Vietnam, Cambodia, Mongolia, Egypt, Ethiopia The final information is subject to the notice published in March each year. VII. uni-shandong-university.text: ﻿ Government Scholarship-山东大学留学山大 中文 한국어 Русский 日本語 Website Apply Now About SDU Programs Degree Programs Non-Degree Programs Apply Now Application Information Visa Affairs Download Accommodation Apply for On-Campus Accommodation Orientation Tips for living in Jinan Contact us Tel：+86-(0)531-88364854 Email: admission@email.sdu.edu.cn Government Scholarship Home The Chinese Government Scholarship Program (Type B) is a full scholarship program for international students established by the Chinese Ministry of Education. Entrusted by the Ministry of Education of China, Shandong University recruits outstanding international students from around the world to pursue bachelor’s, master’s, and doctoral degrees. I. Categories of Applicants Undergraduates (Chinese-taught Programs only) Postgraduates (Chinese or English-taught Programs) Doctoral candidates (Chinese or English-taught Programs) II. Scholarship Coverage 1. Duration: In principle, it is consistent with the study period specified in the admission letter. 2. Coverage: (1) Tuition fees; (2) Free accommodation or housing allowance provided; (3) Living allowance; (4) Comprehensive medical insurance. For more details, please click: https://www.campuschina.org/zh/content/details1003_122933.html III. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be physically and mentally healthy, and be non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport; 2. Academic qualifications and age requirements: (1) Applicants for a bachelor’s degree program should have a high school diploma or equivalent qualification, excellent academic performance, and generally be under 25 years old. (2) Applicants for a master’s degree program should have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification, excellent academic performance, and generally be under 35 years old. (3) Applicants for a doctoral degree program should have a master’s degree or equivalent qualification, excellent academic performance, and generally be under 40 years old. 3. Language Requirement: (1) Chinese-taught Programs Applicants for a bachelor's degree program must pass the HSK Level 4 examination (score of 210 or above); Applicants for a master's degree program must pass the HSK Level 5 examination (score of 180 or above); Applicants for a doctoral degree program must pass the HSK Level 6 examination (score of 180 or above). Applicants with the highest degree in Chinese as the language of instruction are exempt from the HSK certificate, but must provide proof of the language of instruction. (2) English-taught Programs Applicants whose native language is English are exempt from providing English language proficiency certificates. Applicants whose native language is not English must provide proof of English language proficiency with an IELTS score of 6.0 or above, TOEFL score of 80 or above (DI code: C296), TOEFL iBT score of 80 or above, Essentials test score of 8 or above, or equivalent English language proficiency certificates. Applicants whose native language is not English but have received their highest level of education taught in English are exempt from providing IELTS/TOEFL certificates and other proof of English proficiency, but must submit proof of the language of instruction. (3) In addition to the English proficiency requirement, applicants for the Master's degree in Clinical Medicine taught in English must pass the HSK Level 4 examination (score of 180 or above). The certificate is typically valid for 2 years. 4. Applicants must also meet other requirements stated in 2024 Application Instructions for International Students (Bachelor Programs) , 2024 Application Instructions for International Students (Master Programs) , and 2024 Application Instructions for International Students (Ph.D. Programs) . IV. Application Timeline: from now until February 16, 2024 V. Programs For the catalog of programs of the Chinese Government Scholarship Program (Type B), please click: https://www.istudy.sdu.edu.cn/English/Programs/Degree_Programs/Bachelor_Programs.htm VI. Application Procedure 1. Apply online through the Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS) Application System ( https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login ), select the program type (Type B) and enter the agency number (10422). After completing the application, download the “Chinese Government Scholarship Application Form” 2. Log in to SDU Online Application System for International Students ( http://www.apply.sdu.edu.cn ) to fill in personal information, upload the required documents and complete the online application. Paper application documents sent by post are not required. Note: Applicants must apply through both of the above systems, or your application will not be accepted by Shandong University. 3. Pay the application fee of 400 RMB (The application is invalid for those who have not paid the application fee. Once the application fee is paid, it will be non-refundable.). VII. Application Instructions 1. All uploaded documents must be in Chinese or English. If the documents are in other languages, the original document and a certified translation in English or Chinese must be uploaded together. Please use a scanner to scan the relevant documents in color, as pictures of documents taken with mobile phones or cameras, as well as photocopies, will not be accepted. Except for the “Foreigner Physical Examination Form” and personal signatures, handwritten documents will not be accepted. 2. Shandong University reserves the right to request applicants to provide the original paper version/notarized documents of the application materials or authentication documents issued by designated certification agencies for further verification. 3. Due to differences in educational systems between certain countries and China, the academic requirements for applicants from these countries may vary. For more information regarding the required qualifications and degrees, please refer to the attached document . 4. Applicants should ensure the authenticity and accuracy of the provided application information and materials. Once the admissions unit or the certification department verifies that the information is untrue, the applicant's application, admission, or enrollment qualification will be canceled. 5. Chinese Government Scholarship recipients are not allowed to simultaneously receive financial support from other scholarships established by various levels of the Chinese government or admitting institutions. If such a violation is discovered, the Chinese Government Scholarship qualification will be revoked, and the received scholarship funds must be returned. Those who deliberately conceal their sponsorship situation, in addition to disqualification, will be prohibited from applying for the Chinese Government Scholarship within three years. VIII. Review and Recommendation Shandong University is responsible for reviewing the application materials and approving the list of recommended candidates for the scholarship. The recommended candidates will be selected based on the evaluation of experts from the China Scholarship Council. IX. Contact Address: Mingde Building C304, Shandong University (Center Campus), No. 27 South Shanda Road, Jinan, Shandong Province, China Postal Code: 250100 Phone: +86(0)531-88364854 Fax: +86(0)531-88565051 Email: admission@email.sdu.edu.cn Website: http://www.istudy.sdu.edu.cn Links： SDU College of International Education Shandong University Department of International Affairs,SDU China Scholarship Council(CSC) Ministry of Education Ministry of Commerce China Development Bank Apply Now Address: 27 Shanda Nanlu, Jinan, P.R. Subject Category 2026-2027 Soochow University Application Notice for Graduate Students Program homepage Doctoral Program 2026-2027 Soochow University Application Notice for Graduate Students Program Annex.1 2026-2027 Soochow University International Student Master Program Major List.xlsx Annex.2 2026-2027 Soochow University International Student Doctoral Program Major List.xlsx Soochow University P rofile l China's first Western-style educational university - Founded in 1900 by American missionaries, it is one of the earliest universities in China. l A key comprehensive university in China - Ranked among the top 30 universities in China, the university was among the first batch to be selected as one of the '2011 Plan' and 'Double First-class' universities by Ministry of Education. l A key research university in China - Ranked among the top 20 of National Natural Science Research Foundation, the top 30 of National Social Science Research Foundation. l A university that deeply promotes its internationalization strategy - Developing cooperation and exchanges with over 200 universities in more than 30 countries. For more information: http://apply.international.suda.edu.cn/apply_en/6f/f6/c27862a487414/page.psp Chinese Government " High-Level Graduate Students " Scholarship Program The full scholarship of the " High-Level Graduate Students " Program is established by the Chinese Government Scholarship, which supports Chinese universities to recruit outstanding international students for graduate studies in China. This scholarship program is part of CSC-Type B. l Applicant: Outstanding international students applying for master or doctoral degree program of Soochow University l Scholarship coverage: tuition, accommodation, living stipend and comprehensive medical insurance. Scholarship criteria: https://www.campuschina.org/content/details3_74776.html l Universities with Chinese Government Scholarship qualification can recommend suitable candidates, the results are subject to expert review l Scholarship students must attend and pass the annual review of the following year in order to be awarded a scholarship for the next year. Application Way: Applicants should login Soochow University International Student Service System and fill in the required information (financial resource choose " Chinese Government Scholarship " ), upload the application documents requested. Soochow University International Student Service System: https://suda.17gz.org or https://iaa.suda.edu.cn Applicants who are admitted and nominated for the Chinese Government Scholarship-Chinese University Program need to log into the system of China Scholarship Council within the specified time to submit the scholarship application (The Agency Number for Soochow University is 10285; Choose Program Category Type B). CSC system : http://www.csc.edu.cn/laihua/ Soochow University International Students Scholarship P rogram ● Applicant: Outstanding international students applying for master or doctoral degree program of Soochow Universit y. ● Scholarship coverage: tuition, accommodation, living stipend and comprehensive medical insurance. The standard of living stipend in China is the same as that of Chinese G overnment S cholarship. ● The final admission result is subject to the expert review. International students who are eligible for the Chinese Government Scholarship High-level Graduate Program (Type B) recommendation but not ultimately approved for this scholarship will automatically be eligible for the Soochow University International Student Scholarship . ● Scholarship students must attend and pass the annual review in May of the following year in order to be awarded a scholarship for the next year. I. Application requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens who are in good health and holding valid ordinary foreign passports. 2. Be an academically excellent holder of a bachelor's degree or its equivalent when applying for a master's program. Preferably under the age of 35. 3. Be an academically excellent holder of a master's degree or its equivalent when applying for a doctoral program. Preferably under the age of 40 4. N ot the current recipient of other scholarships established by various levels of the Chinese Government or the university of enrollment. (Excludes any one-time awards.) Ⅱ. Major Annex.1《202 6 -202 7 Soochow University International Student Master Program Major List》 Annex.2 《 202 6 -202 7 Soochow University International Student Doctor Program Major List 》 Note: Some majors and doctoral supervisors may be adjusted . Ⅲ . Application Materials ( 1 ) Information page of valid passport (meaning the passport will be valid after March 1, 202 7 ). Applicants who have already studied in China are required to submit a passport visa page. ( 2 ) Notarized highest diploma. Prospective diploma applicant must submit official proof of student status or pre-graduation certificate by their current school. For languages other than English, an English translation and a notarized copy in English or Chinese are required. ; ( 3 ) Academic transcripts (from the undergraduate program onwards). Copies of academic records from the first to last semester during the undergraduate, graduate (if any), and doctoral programs (if any) shall be provided. These transcripts shall be issued and sealed by the student management department. Transcripts can be provided in Chinese or English. If they are in languages other than English, an English translation and a notarized copy in Chinese or English should be provided ; ( 4 ) Language Proficiency Certificate: - To apply for majors taught in Chinese, applicants should hold the valid certificate of HSK 5 scoring 180 or above. (Valid on and after June 15, 202 6 ) Note: Applicants whose mother tongue is Chinese or whose senior high school is taught in Chinese will be exempted from providing HSK scores upon verification by our school. - To apply for majors taught in English, applicants must meet at least one of the English proficiency requirements: TOEFL score ≥80 / IELTS ≥6.0 / Native English speaker / English as the medium of instruction for master program / other valid evidence of equivalent English proficiency recognized by Soochow University. (Valid on and after June 15, 202 6 ) ( 5 ) Recommendation letters. Two letters of recommendation (dated after Dec ember 1, 20 25 .) from professors or associate professors shall be submitted, including the title and e-mail address of professors or associate professors. These letters shall describe the applicant's objectives of learning in China, comprehensive abilities, and evaluation of future growth; written only in Chinese or English. ( 6 ) A study plan proposal. A study plan written in Chinese or English shall contain more than 1,000 characters or words; the proposal of a doctoral student shall be signed by the applicant's Chinese supervisor; ( 7 ) Acceptance letter . Applicant who applies for the Doctoral Program must provide it. Applicants who apply for the Master Program are suggested to provide it. The acceptance letter must be signed by the supervisor and sealed by the authorities of the corresponding school. ( 8 ) Health certificate within 6 months. Download the 《Foreigner Physical Examination Form》(Certificates issued on or after October 1, 202 5 shall be deemed valid ) and go to a regular local hospital to complete the examination. The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. The records must be completed in English or Chinese; incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicant are invalid. ( 9 ) Non-criminal record report. The applicant shall submit a valid certificate of Non-Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months prior to the submission date of the application. Note: Recent graduates studying in Chinese universities may submit proof of good performance issued by the official department of their current university. ( 10 ) Letter of financial guarantee . T he proof of income of the guarantor, and the proof of savings (at least 5000 USD) of the guarantor. ( 11 ) Other supporting documents. (CSC application form with signature, award certificate, academic paper publication, participation certificate in international conference or volunteer activity, etc.) Reminder: Uploaded supporting documents must be clear, authentic and valid. Applicants are recommended to use a professional device to scan the relevant documents. Applicants shall bear the consequences caused by unclear or unidentifiable uploaded materials. Newcomers will have additional security checks to their documents upon enrollment. The security checks will last for three months . Any form of forgery in the documents found during the security check will result in the expulsion of the student . Any paid expenses will not be reimbursed. uni-tianjin-foreign-studies-university.text: ﻿ Admission Guide for 2027—2028 TFSU Chinese Government Scholarship -High Level Postgraduate Program（Type B）-天津外国语大学留学生招生办公室 首页Home 关于我们About us 新闻公告News 招生信息Program 奖学金Scholarship 在线申请Application 联系我们Contact us 当前位置： 首页Home >> 新闻公告News >> 通知公告 >> 正文 Admission Guide for 2027—2028 TFSU Chinese Government Scholarship -High Level Postgraduate Program（Type B） 2026-10-19 Chinese Government Scholarship-High Level Postgraduate Program is a full scholarship established by Ministry of Education, P.R.C to support designated Chinese universities to enroll outstanding international students for graduate studies in China.Tianjin Foreign Studies University (TFSU) is an institution of higher learning, with the discipline of Foreign Language & Literature taking the lead and Humanities, Economics, Administration & Management, Law, Education, Art, and Engineering balancing the overall disciplinary structure, and isone of China's eight prestigious institutions for higher education in foreign languages. I.Categories, Majors,and DurationofScholarship Masterand Ph.D.Students. Details of majors and duration are given inAttachment 1. II.Eligibility 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. For applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, the conditions set by the Document No. 12〔2020〕of Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China should be met; 2.Requirements for age, degree, and language: Applicants applying for a Master degree should hold a Bachelor diploma and be under the age of 35 ; Applicants applying for a PhD degree should hold a Master diploma and be under the age of 40. Applicants shall be of good moral character, physically and mentally healthy, and willing to comply with Chinese laws and the regulations of TFSU. Applicants for programs taught in Chinese must have a Chinese proficiency level of at least HSK Level 5 with a score of 180 or above for master's programs, and HSK Level 6 with a score of 180 or above for PhD programs. Applicants who have obtained a degree from a Chinese university using Chinese as the medium of instruction are exempt from submitting HSK certificates (but must provide proof of Chinese-taught program completion from the graduating institution). Applicants for programs taught in English must have an English proficiency level of at least IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 80, or an equivalent. 3.Applicants must not be recipients of other scholarship funding simultaneously. If discovered, the CSCqualification will be revoked, and the scholarship funds received must be repaid. Deliberate concealment of funding status will result in disqualification and ineligibility to apply for ChineseGovernment Scholarship for three years. 4.Applicants must also meet TFSU's admission requirements regarding academic ability, language proficiency, and other relevant aspects. III.Scholarship Coverage 1.Tuition waiver andaccommodation on campus(international students are required to live on campus); 2.Monthly Living Allowance: 3,000 RMB/month for Master students; 3,500 RMB/month for Ph.D. students; 3. Comprehensive Medical Insurance. IV.Application Materials 1.Photocopy of passport(Ordinary passport expires after October31, 2028). 2.Scanned copy of notarized highest academic qualification certificate (If the applicant is a current student, please submit a pre-graduation certificate or student enrollment certificate. After admission, the scanned copy of the original highest academic qualification certificate shall be submitted for supplementary verification). 3.Scan copy of complete transcripts for the highest degree (Applicants who will not graduate before the application deadline must provide their current academic transcript. In this case, the completed academic transcripts must be submittedupon enrollment). 4.LanguageProficiencyCertificate (HSKcertificatewithin 2 years for Chinese-taught programs; TOEFL 80, IELTS 6.0, Duolingo 110, or a certificate of English proficiency recognized by the relevant school for English-taught programs). 5.Study Plan for Studying in China (written in Chinese or English, minimum 1,000 words; forPh.D.applicants, must be signed by the prospective Chinese supervisor. Please use the TFSU template provided in Attachment 2). 6.Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors (focusing on the applicant's purpose for studying in China, any cooperation between the recommender's institution/TFSU supervisor and the applicant's current institution/supervisor, and an evaluation of the applicant's comprehensive ability and future potential.Recommender's signature and contact informationmust be included). 7.Scancopy of the original Foreigner Physical Examination Form (uniformly printed by Chinese health quarantine authorities, completed in English). Applicants must strictly follow the required items. Incomplete forms, forms without a photo/photo without a stamped seam, or without doctor/hospital signature and seal are invalid. The physical examination result is valid for 6 months (see Attachment 3). 8.Non-criminal record certificate issued by the local public security authority within 6 months prior to the ChineseGovernment Scholarship application date. 9.Publications: Refers to academic papers published in public journals, academic publications, or newspapers (excluding graduation theses); proof of participation in academic conferences, research projects, and other relevant academic activities. 10.Other supporting materials (including certificates for volunteer activities, internships, competitions, continuing education, etc.). 11.Applicantsin Chinawho will not graduate before the application deadlinemustsubmit scan of Photocopy of Visaand proof of student performance from the current institution. Notes on Materials： 1.All uploaded certificates and documents shall be scanned copies of original documents in Chinese or English. For documents issued in other languages, applicants must upload both the scanned copy of the original document and the notarized scanned translation in Chinese or English. 2.Materials uploaded through the system must be clear, authentic, and valid. All files must be in PDF format. 3.TFSU does not accept application materials sent via postal mail. 4.If awarded the scholarship, the original versions of all above documents must be presented during registration for verification. 5.TFSU has not authorized any individual or agency for Chinese Government Scholarship student recruitment. Please contact the International Admission Office directly for application inquiries. V.Application and Admission Procedures (Please refer to the actual situation if there are any changes in the time.) Step 1: Applicants should register an account, fill in the application information online, upload the application documents to the Online Application System（https://tfsu.at0086.cn/StuApplication/Login.aspx）beforeFebruary 21, 2027. Step 2: After passing the application review, eligible applicants will be notified to take written tests and/or interviews arranged by the relevant schools/departments. Step 3: Applicants who pass the tests/interviews will receive a Pre-admission Notice, then log into the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System（http://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn#/login）, complete the online application (TFSU Institution Code: 10068, Program Category: Type B), and upload all required documents (see Attachment 4 for detailed instructions). Step 4: TFSU submits the recommended candidates list to CSC. Step 5: CSC organizes expert review (Candidates not finally selected by CSC will be prioritized for other TFSU scholarship or self-funded programs if they wish to apply). Step 6: Admission results are announced. Admitted students can check and receive the Admission Notice and JW201 Form via the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System. VI.Contact InternationalAdmission Office,Tianjin Foreign Studies University Address: 117 MachangRoad, Hexi District, Tianjin, China Postcode: 300204 Tel: +86-22-23286974 Email: foreignstudents@tjfsu.edu.cn University Website: http://isa.tjfsu.edu.cn/ Online Application: http://tfsu.at0086.cn/StuApplication/Index.aspx 附件【 附件1：天津外国语大学专业配置清单.xls 】 已下载 次 附件【 附件2：天津外国语大学来华留学学习计划.docx 】 已下载 次 附件【 附件3：《外国人体格检查记录》.doc 】 已下载 次 附件【 附件4：中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统操作流程.pdf 】 已下载 次 【 关闭窗口 】 Copyright © 版权所有：天津外国语大学 津ICP备05003121号 地址：天津市河西区马场道117号 电话：+86-22-23286974 传真：+86-22-23286974

2027年中国政府奖学金“高水平研究生”项目报名通知 发布时间：2026年10月28日 编辑： 一、奖学金项目介绍 1. 中国政府奖学金 “ 高水平研究生 ” 项目按照个人申请、院校推荐、专家评审、择优录取的原则，选拔具有优秀学科背景、突出专业能力及未来发展潜力的国际学生。 2. 中国政府奖学金学生不得同时享有中国各级政府和学校设立的其他奖学金（不含各类一次性奖励金）。 3. 中国政府奖学金申请不得委托任何个人或中介机构代为受理，请申请人直接向学校咨询并提交申请。 二、 奖学金内容及期限 学费、校内住宿、生活费、综合医疗保险 硕士： 2 年或 3 年 博士： 4 年 中文补习： 1 年（使用中文学习，如果只有 HSK4 级，需增加一年中文学习。） 三、 申请时间 2026 年 11 月 1 日至 2027 年 3 月 10 日 注： 完成报名后，即进入审核程序并确定审核结果，名额招满为止，请尽早报名！ 四、 申请专业 所有硕士、博士专业，均可以申请。 五、 申请资格 1. 申请人须为非中国籍公民，身体健康； 2. 申请人的学历和年龄要求： 1 ）来华攻读硕士学位者，须具有学士学位，学习成绩优秀，年龄不超过 35 周岁； 2 ）来华攻读博士学位者，须具有硕士学位，学习成绩优秀，年龄不超过 40 周岁； 3. 申请人 须具备 一定语言基础 （必须） 。 1 ）申请中文学习，至少通过 HSK4 级 考试； 2 ）申请英文学习（英语非官方语言），需提交 IELTS 6 .0 或 TOEFL 80 成绩单，或其他官方英语水平证明。 六、 申请审核方式 1. 申请人在中国政府奖学金系统提交申请（ https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn ） ，选择 Type B ，学校代码 10008 （ 初始申请不需要提交 “ 预录取通知书 ” ）； 2. 申请人在北京科技大学报名系统提交申请（ onlineapply.ustb.edu.cn ），并交纳报名费（无论是否录取，报名费不退还）； 3. 学校将审核申请材料，并向通过审核的申请人发放 “ 预录取通知书 ” ； 4. 申请人将 “ 预录取通知书 ” 上传至中国政府奖学金系统； 5. 学校将审核结果推荐至中国国家留学基金管理委员会。 七、 申请材料 请将以下电子版材料上传至北京科技大学报名系统（ onlineapply.ustb.edu.cn ） 1. 《中国政府奖学金申请表》（项目种类 Type B ，机构代码 10008 ）。 2. 护照首页。护照有效期应晚于 2027 年 9 月，否则须及时换发新的护照。 3. 经公证的本科、硕士学位证书。如申请人为在校生，须提交本人就读学校出具的预计毕业证明或者在学证明。 4. 学习成绩单。 a. 成绩单应包括本科、硕士（如有）、博士（如有）学习阶段，直至最近一学期的成绩。 b. 成绩单应由就读学校教务处、研究生院或有关学生管理部门开具并盖章。 c. 成绩单需包含所有课程、加权平均分或平均分。 d. 可提供中 / 英文成绩单，如为外语以外语种，需另提供英文翻译件并公证。 5. 语言能力证明。 a ）申请中文授课项目：须提供有效期内 HSK5 成绩报告（如提供 HSK4 ，需增加一年汉语补习）； b ）申请英文授课项目：须提供 IELTS 6 .0、 TOEFL 80 ，或其他官方英语水平证明（国家官方语言为英语的学生免交）。 6. 学习计划，用中文或者英文书写， 1000 字以上。 申请博士研究生，学习计划需由接收导师签字。 7. 两封推荐信，由相关学科教授或副教授提供。内容应重点包含对申请人来华学习目标要求，以及对学生综合能力、未来发展的评价，只可用中文或者英文书写。 8. 《外国人体格检查表》，须在有效期（ 6 个月）内。 9. 无犯罪记录证明。申请人须提交由所在地公安机关出具的有效期内的无犯罪记录证明，通常应为提交申请之日前 3 个月以内的证明文件。 10. 导师接收函。 （申请 “ 高水平项目 ” ，申请人 需 提前联系接收导师） 11. 已发表的学术文章目录及摘要，其他原创性工作成果。 （如有） 12. 个人作品。申请攻读艺术、设计类等专业者，须提交个人作品（如影像、绘画作品等）。 （如有） 注：初始申请阶段无需提交 “ 预录取通知书 ” 。通过审核后，北京科技大学将提供电子版预录取通知书。申请人收到后，需在中国政府奖学金系统里补充提交，完成奖学金项目的申请。 八、 联系方式 电话： +86-10-62332 037 电子邮件： admission@ustb.edu.cn 北京科技大学国际学生中心 北京市海淀区学院路30号 邮编100083 GoTop 2027年中国政府奖学金“高水平研究生”项目报名通知
