Type B: Chinese Government Scholarship. Type C: USTC Scholarship. Each scholarship has its own eligibility criteria and application requirements. Applicants should review the relevant provisions carefully before applying. Applicants may apply for one or more scholarship categories. USTC will conduct a comprehensive evaluation of each applicant and determine whether to recommend the applicant to the relevant scholarship authority for an award. Each applicant may be awarded no more than one category of scholarship. Type A I. Scholarship Coverage The CAS-ANSO Scholarship covers: tuition waiver； comprehensive medical insurance； monthly living stipends； Applicants for the Type A Scholarship must create an account in the USTC Online Application System and select the Type A Scholarship. Applicants may also apply for other scholarship categories. USTC will conduct a comprehensive evaluation of each applicant to determine whether to recommend the applicant to the relevant scholarship authority for an award. Each applicant may be awarded no more than one category of scholarship. II. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be under the age of 35 on September 1, 2027. 2. Applicants must not be enrolled in a doctoral degree program at any institution of higher education in China at the time of application. 3. For all other eligibility requirements, please refer to the 2027 USTC Admission for International Doctoral Programs . Please note: Applicants for USTC Fellowship Type A for doctoral programs CAN NOT apply for CAS-ANSO Scholarship at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS). Scholarship recipients cannot take up other assignments during the period of his/her scholarship. Application Time : To be announced CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Program) 2027 Call for Applications: To be announced III. Application Guideline 1. Create an account in the USTC Online Application System and select the appropriate doctoral program and Type A scholarship. 2. Fill in all the information and upload the documents as required. * After submission of your application, please keep checking your email box used for login in the application system for important notices, including requests for supplementary application materials, notifications regarding online interviews. * There is no need for finding a host supervisor while applying online. Type B I. Scholarship Coverage The Chinese Government Scholarship covers: tuition waiver； comprehensive medical insurance； monthly living stipends； on-campus dormitory (or off-campus housing subsidy). Applicants for the Type B Scholarship must submit a scholarship application through the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System . They must also create an account in the USTC Online Application System and select the Type B Scholarship. Applicants may also apply for other scholarship categories. USTC will conduct a comprehensive evaluation of each applicant to determine whether to recommend the applicant to the relevant scholarship authority for an award. Each applicant may be awarded no more than one category of scholarship. II. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be under the age of 40 on September 1, 2027. 2. For all other eligibility requirements, please refer to the 2027 USTC Admission for International Doctoral Programs . Please note: Scholarship recipients cannot take up other assignments during the period of his/her scholarship. Application Time : October 25, 2026 — January 20, 2027 III. Application Guideline 1. Visit “CSC Study in China” Website and click “ Scholarship Application for Students ”, register an account, complete the required information, and submit your application as instructed. After submission, click “Print the Application Form”, download the form and upload the form into the USTC portal . 2. Create an account in the USTC Online Application System and select the appropriate doctoral program and Type B scholarship. 3. Fill in all the information and upload the documents as required. * After submission of your application, please keep checking your email box used for login in the application system for important notices, including requests for supplementary application materials, notifications regarding online interviews. * There is no need for finding a host supervisor while applying online. Type C I. Scholarship Coverage The USTC scholarship has two levels: Level A: tuition waiver, comprehensive medical insurance, monthly living stipends, on-campus dormitory (or off-campus housing subsidy); Level B: tuition waiver. Applicants for the Type C Scholarship must create an account in the USTC Online Application System and select the Type C Scholarship. Applicants may also apply for other scholarship categories. USTC will conduct a comprehensive evaluation of each applicant to determine whether to recommend the applicant to the relevant scholarship authority for an award. Each applicant may be awarded no more than one category of scholarship. II. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be under the age of 40 on September 1, 2027. 2. For all other eligibility requirements, please refer to the 2027 USTC Admission for International Doctoral Programs . Please note: Scholarship recipients cannot take up other assignments during the period of his/her scholarship. Application Time : To be announced III. Application Guideline 1. Create an account in the USTC Online Application System and select the appropriate doctoral program and Type C scholarship. 2. Scholarship Xiamen Tan Kah Kee Scholarships Xiamen University Scholarships XMU Sustainable Coastal Development Scholarship Download Help FAQs Campus Maps Program Coordinators Contact us Sitemap Home > Admissions > Master's Students Admissions Undergraduate Students Master's Students Doctoral students Learn Chinese Costs Download Online Application 2027 Admission Guide of Xiamen University for Master's Programs Bahasa Indonesia ║ Ti ế ng Vi ệ t ║ 한국어 ║ 日本語 ║ ภาษาไทย ║ اللغة العربية ║ Español ║ Русский язык Xiamen University (XMU), founded in 1921 by renowned patriotic overseas Chinese leader Mr. Tan Kah Kee, was the first Chinese university established by an overseas Chinese person. XMU has long been listed among China’s leading universities on the national 211 Project, 985 Project and Double First-Class Initiative, which have been launched by the Chinese government to support selected universities in achieving world-class standing. Nestled snugly between green hills and the blue sea, XMU is renowned as one of the most beautiful universities around the world for its excellent education facilities and beautiful environment. Xiamen University currently comprises Siming Campus, Zhangzhou Campus, Xiang’an Campus and XMU Malaysia. XMU consists of a graduate school, six academic divisions, 36 schools and 18 research institutes. In 2022, six XMU disciplines –Chemistry, Marine Science, Biology, Ecology, Statistics and Pedagogy – w ere included in the nation’s list of disciplines for achieving world-class status. XMU ranks among ESI’s global top 1% in 19 disciplines, with chemistry, materials science and engineering in ESI’s global top 1‰. XMU currently has a faculty of nearly 3,000, of whom 73% are full or associate professors. Among them, 14 are the members of the Chinese Academy of Sciences or of the Chinese Academy of Engineering. XMU currently has an enrollment of more than 48,000 students, including over 21,700 students in bachelor’s degree programs, 20,000 in master’s degree programs, and 6,800 in doctoral degree programs. XMU implements a comprehensive global outreach strategy. The University has signed cooperation agreements with 283 overseas universities. Actively involved in international Chinese education, XMU has built 14 Confucius Institutes, one Chinese Language and Culture Research Center, 34 Confucius Classrooms in 12 countries on five continents, the highest numbers with the most extensive geographic coverage among Chinese universities on the List of “Double First-Class” Universities. The establishment of XMU Malaysia was approved in September 2013, which makes XMU the first Chinese university to open an international campus. I. Eligibility 1. General Requirements 1) Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens generally under the age of 45 (as of September 1, 2027), be mentally and physically healthy, and possess a valid regular passport. 2) Applicants should be a graduating student of an undergraduate’s program or hold a Bachelor Degree or above. 3) Scholarship applicants should also meet the age limit requirements of respective scholarships. 2. Requirements about Nationalities Foreign citizens of Chinese origin, including former Chinese citizens who have obtained foreign citizenship, as well as the non-Chinese descendants of present or former Chinese citizens, will have to follow the system instructions to fill in the basic information and upload the supporting documents based on the different citizenship status, and will be subject to a preliminary review of citizenship status by XMU during the admission stage and to verification of citizenship by the entry and exit administration department of China’s public security authorities. Applicants who fail to pass the preliminary review or verification of citizenship will be deemed to have forfeited their eligibility for admission, as well as the subsequent academic registration that they may obtain. 3. Language Proficiency Requirement 1) Chinese proficiency requirements for Chinese-medium programs Ø Programs in Humanities, Economics, Management, Law, Arts : HSK 5 with a score of 210 or better Ø Programs in Sciences, Engineering, Medicine and Physical Education : HSK 4 with a score of 210 or better Ø OR Chinese-as-medium-of-instruction Certificate from previous university where Chinese is the primary language of instruction. 2) English proficiency requirements for English-medium programs Ø TOEFL iBT Certificate: an overall minimum score of 80 (XMU's DI Code for TOEFL is C310) Ø OR an IELTS Academic Certificate: an overall minimum score of 6.0 Ø OR English-as-medium-of-instruction Certificate from previous university where English is the primary language of instruction. Ø OR other equivalent English proficiency certificates recognized by XMU Ø Applicants from countries where English is the official language are exempt from this requirement. II. Application Timeline Start Time Deadline Scholarship Category Dec. 1, 2026 Feb 20, 2027 Chinese Government Scholarships Apr. 30, 2027 Fujian Provincial Government Scholarship Sustainable Coastal Development Scholarship of Xiamen University Xiamen University Scholarship for New Students May 31, 2027 Self-funded Notes: 1. Applicable to XMU Online Application System, Beijing Time (GMT +08:00), late applications will not be considered. 2. NOT applicable to Type A CSC scholarships and International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship. Please refer to the official notice of the MOE’s Center for Language Education and Cooperation, China Scholarship Council (Chinese Embassy or other handling authorities) for more details. III. Application Procedures Applicants should apply through XMU Online Application System for international students and pay the application fee: http://application.xmu.edu.cn IV. Application Documents 1. A scanned copy of the first page of the passport (regular passport, valid at least through October 31, 2027) 2. Birth Certificate 3. Parents’ Identity Documents 4. Degree Certificate and the Academic Transcripts 1) Bachelor Degree Certificate or above and the complete academic transcripts. 2) Certificate of Expected Graduation for graduating students. 3) Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland should be notarized by the local notary public office. 4) The originals of the diplomas and certification documents should be made available upon registration for review. 5. Language Proficiency Certificate: marked under the “Application Requirements” section. 6. Two Letters of Recommendation from associate professors or professors with information of the recommender’s names, employer, work position and contact information, signed by the recommender or with the stamp of the recommending organization. 7. Personal Statement (minimum 1,000 words), which should include a self-introduction, educational experience, motivations, study plan and career aspirations. It needs to be written in Chinese for Chinese-medium programs, in English for English-medium programs. Note: Applicants for School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute for Studies in Economics, please refer to 【 Writing Guidance 】 . 8. Curriculum Vitae (CV) 9. Pre-Acceptance Letter (optional). Priority of admission will be given to applicants have acquired the pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the college. Link: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1141/1969.htm 10. Physical Examination Record for Inbound Travelers including chest X-ray image, electrocardiogram, laboratory exam results and data sheets of some required items, with the lower part of the applicant’s photo stamped by the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months. Link: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1141/1745.htm 11. Financial Support Guarantee Statement and its supporting documents. Applicants for scholarships are not exempt from this requirement. Link: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1141/1744.htm 12. No Criminal Record Report. The applicants shall submit a valid No Criminal Record Report issued within 6 months before the date of submission of the application. 13. Personal portfolios such as videos and artworks, are REQUIRED for art applicants. Other supporting documents, such as publications, competition awards, merit certificates, scientific research activities, academic conference attendance or special skills certificates, could be submitted in the “Other Supporting Materials” section in the application system as well. Notes: 1. After the application is submitted, the applicant will not be able to modify the application information or application materials. Therefore, before submitting your application, please check carefully to ensure that the information and materials submitted are comprehensive, true and complete. Applications with inaccuracies or omissions will not be accepted by the University. Action for misconduct will be taken according to “Monitoring, complaints and action for misconduct”. 2. Any documents in a language other than Chinese or English should be accompanied by a notarized translation in Chinese or English. 3. In general, there is no need to mail original hard-copy materials through courier service. However, under extraordinary circumstances, the University reserves the rights to require applicants to mail original hard-copy documents for further review and identification or to carry out authentication as specified. Application materials will not be returned under any circumstances. V. Academic Programs 1. Chinese-medium Master’s Programs: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/Programs/Chinese_Medium_Master_s.htm 2. English-medium Master’s Programs: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/Programs/English_Medium_Master_s.htm Notes: Generally the minimum number of students in a single program should be no less than 5. VI. Admission and Selection 1. Verification of qualification There will be a holistic review of the applicant’s foreign citizenship, highest degree diploma, academic performance, language proficiency, research plan, recommendations, physical and mental health, etc. 2. Academic assessment For applicants who pass the verification of qualifications, the relevant colleges or schools will conduct academic assessment, including evaluation of the application documents as well as a remote interview or written examination of the applicant. The academic assessment focuses on the applicant’s academic capabilities, communicative competence, overall merit, etc. 3. The admission decision will be made based on the verification of the applicant’s qualifications and academic assessment results, as well as their program choices. Applicants should log into XMU Online Application System regularly for notifications and the progress of application status, and keep their phones open and check their email accounts regularly. The outcome of application will be published on the application system in June or July. VII. Length of Program, Duration of Study and Conferral of Degree 1. Length of Chinese-medium Master’s Programs: 3 years Notes: 2 years for International Chinese Language Education (045300); The Chines-Foreign Cooperatively-Run Master's Degree Program in Drama Film and Television (135400) by Xiamen University and New York Film Academy adopts a 1+1 dual-degree and dual-campus, full-time training model, with a duration of 2 years. All students will study at Xiamen University in the first academic year and at the New York Film Academy (Los Angeles campus) in the second academic year. 2. Length of English-medium Master’s program: 2 years Notes: The master's degree program in Design (135700) at the Institute of Creativity and Innovation (ICI), a Sino-foreign cooperative education program jointly offered by Xiamen University (XMU) and the University for the Creative Arts (UCA), UK, adopts a “2+0” training model. Students who fulfill the graduation requirements within the maximum period of study and meet the conditions for degree conferral may obtain a Master's Program Graduation Certificate and a Master's Degree Certificate awarded by XMU, as well as a Master of Arts in Design conferred by UCA. 3. Maximum duration of study (including suspension and retainment of student status): 5 years 4. Time of enrolment: Autumn, usually in September. Students will be awarded a graduation certificate by XMU after they complete all the courses prescribed in the academic scheme obtaining required credits, pass the defense of graduation thesis or practical achievements and satisfy the graduation requirements within the duration of study prescribed by XMU. Those who have also satisfied the requirements for degree conferral will be conferred a Master’s Degree by XMU. VIII. Study Cost Application Fee RMB 400 (payable upon signing up online; non-refundable) Tuition Fee Program Category Medium of Instruction Length of Program (year) Discipline Category (RMB/year) Liberal Arts Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Economics, Management, Law, PE Regular Master’s Programs Chinese 3 26000 30000 English 2 39000 45000 Master of International Chinese Language Education(045300) Chinese 2 30000 Drama Film and Television (Chinese-Foreign Cooperation) Chinese 2 172000 Design (Chinese-Foreign Cooperation) English 2 120000 Notes: Tuition fees are payable in RMB by academic year and do not include textbook fees. Tuition fees are subject to change without prior notice upon approval by price regulators. Other Expenses 1. Accommodation (1) Due to the limited availability of on-campus accommodation, priority will be given to students who are recipients of scholarships that include subsidies for on-campus accommodation. Surplus accommodation will be allotted to students who are recipients of scholarships with no subsidies for accommodation and self-funded students. Students with on-campus accommodation can live in on-campus housing until July 31 of the academic year. (2) Siming campus: twin-rooms, accommodation fees (electricity and water not included, the same below) range from RMB 35 to 65 per person per day; Xiang’an campus: quadruple-rooms or twin-rooms, accommodation fees range from RMB 1200 to 4000 per person per academic year; Zhangzhou campus: quadruple-rooms, accommodation fees range from RMB 1100 to 1200 per person per academic year. Each room is usually equipped with beds, desks and chairs, wardrobes, an air conditioner, a water heater, a bathroom (suites have a different bathroom arrangement), and Internet access (paid by students). Communal self-service washers and other equipment are also available. Details shall be subject to the dormitory arrangement at the time of new student check-in. (3) Students who cannot obtain on-campus accommodation are expected to arrange for their own off-campus accommodation before their arrival. The monthly rental fee for an apartment near Siming campus is around RMB 2,500/month, and RMB500-1000/month near Xiang’an Campus. (4) Recipients of Chinese Government Scholarships or International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarships that cover on-campus accommodation expenses can apply for an accommodation subsidy if they give up free on-campus accommodation and choose to live off campus. Please refer to the updates. 2. Food: approximately RMB 1,000 to 1,500/month 3. Medical Insurance: For the safety of international students in China, according to the regulations of the Chinese Ministry of Education and Xiamen University, international students are required to purchase medical insurance for an annual fee of RMB 800. Please refer to the enrolment instructions for detailed information of medical insurance. Note: 1. For more information about accommodation, insurance or scholarship Stipend, please contact Overseas Students Affairs Office (OSAO, Tel:+ 86 (0)592 2183606, Email: osao@xmu.edu.cn ). 2. Xiamen University follows tuition policies of the Chinese government strictly. Fee charging shall be carried on in accordance with regulations stipulated in the admission guidance. Do not trust any school fee payment notice other than the admission guidance and the enrollment instructions. IX. Scholarship Programs (I) Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC Type A) 1. Chinese Government Scholarships – Bilateral Programs Applicants who are eligible for the “Chinese Government Scholarship – Country-Specific Bilateral Program” can submit the applications to their home country’s international student dispatching department or the education office of the Chinese embassy (consulate) in their home country. In general, the application period is from January to early April every year. However, application deadlines may vary from country to country. Please follow the updates of the local Chinese embassy (consulate). https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1038/1882.htm 2. MOFCOM Scholarship MOFCOM Scholarship supports English medium graduate programs. Applicants can apply to the Economic and Commercial Counselor's Office (ECCO) of the local Chinese Embassy before May each year. https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1038/1851.htm 3. ASEAN-China Young Leaders Scholarship (ACYLS) This scholarship provides financial support for young professionals with work experience who are from ASEAN member countries and who are studying for a master’s or doctoral degree, receiving short-term advanced training, or participating in short-term group training programs. Applicants can apply to the ACYLS national focal points from early January to early April. https://www.campuschina.org/content/details3_380333.html 4. Youth of Excellence Scheme of China Program ("YES China") Xiamen University enrolls master students in English-medium programs of Marine Affairs, Chemical Engineering or Urban and Regional Planning under YES China. In the first year, the students mainly complete the course study, research and preparation of the dissertation, and in the second year, the students return to their home countries to complete and defend their thesis, and those who are qualified will be allowed to graduate and obtain the degree. Applicants belonging to one of the following four categories of personnel can apply by mid-April in CSC system: ① Civil servants at the rank of section chief or above (or equivalent) in a government department of their home country; ② Senior managerial personnel at institutions or enterprises; ③ Administrative personnel at universities or research institutes; ④ Personnel with work or internship experience with an international organization Urban and Regional Planning: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1038/3730.htm Marine Affairs: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1038/2409.htm ( II ) Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC Type B) Eligible applicants should submit their applications for admission and scholarships through XMU Online Application System for international students ( application.xmu.edu.cn ) within the application period specified in the prospectus; they should also register on the “Chinese Government Scholarship Information System” ( studyinchina.csc.edu.cn ). Agency No. XMU: 10384. 1. Chinese Government Scholarship University Programs Xiamen University, as an enrolling institution under the Chinese Government Scholarship Programs, admits students from around the world who are recipients of such scholarships. XMU will submits information on such students to the China Scholarship Council for approval. https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1038/1863.htm 2. Chinese Government Marine Scholarship This scholarship is open to international students from countries around the South China Sea and the Indian Ocean and on the Pacific Rim and islands, as well as from developing countries in Africa and the Americas, who wish to come to China to pursue a master’s or doctoral degree in a marine-related field. Preference will be given to those working in the marine industry or other related industries. https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/info/1038/1865.htm (III) International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship The MOE’s Center for Language Education and Cooperation have launched this scholarship program with a view to encouraging students and Chinese language teachers from all over the world to study or conduct research on the Chinese language and culture. The scholarship is opened to applicants for 2-year Master’s Program of International Chinese Language Education (Major Code 045300). Applicants should contact Confucius Institutes, independently operated Confucius Classrooms, certain HSK test centers, Chinese language (education) departments of foreign universities, or Chinese embassies (consulates) in their home countries for recommendation. Eligible applicants should submit their applications on the “International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship Application System” ( cis.chinese.cn ) within the application period. https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/Scholarships/International_Chinese_Language_Teachers_Scholars.htm (IV) Fujian Provincial Government Scholarship for International Students The Scholarship is open to international students who wish to study in degree programs in Fujian Province. It is available only for one academic year and amounts to RMB 30,000 for undergraduates, RMB 40,000 for master’s students and RMB 50,000 for doctoral students. The University will select the best candidates from the pool of students who have passed the annual review. The shortlisted students will be recommended for the renewal of the scholarship in the subsequent year. Applicants should submit their applications for admission and the scholarship through XMU Online Application System for international students ( application.xmu.edu.cn ) within the application period specified in the admission prospectus. https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/Scholarships/Fujian_Provincial_Govt__Scholarship.htm (V) Xiamen University Scholarship for New International Students XMU offers the university scholarships of first, second and third prizes. Each year, a number of undergraduate, master’s and doctoral students are selected from applicants. Recipients will be awarded full or partial tuition exemption. For some outstanding students, a monthly stipend can be provided in accordance with the standards of the Chinese Government Scholarship. Students shall submit their admission application and scholarship application via the university’s application system within the specified application period. ( application.xmu.edu.cn ). https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/Scholarships/Xiamen_University_Scholarships.htm Notes: 1. This admission guide may be adjusted according to the latest notice of scholarship authorities and so please refer to the latest version under “Scholarships” section on https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn/ . 2. According to the XMU’s Guidelines on Selecting Candidates for International Students Scholarships, the University will follow the principle of formality, equality and impartiality and select the best candidates from the pool of qualified and admitted students. The shortlisted candidates will be submitted to the university and the relevant scholarship authorities for final approval. The scholarship recipients will be assessed on an annual basis in accordance with the relevant scholarship regulations and only those meeting the required standards will have their scholarship renewed for the subsequent year. Those who fail in the review will no longer be eligible for the scholarship. X. Monitoring, Complaints and Action for Misconduct 1. Required by the competent department, the information related to application and admission will be published on XMU Admissions Web ( https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn ) or websites of relevant schools. Beware of any fake news from other sources. 2. Under the guidance of the XMU Admissions Committee, XMU’s international student recruitment is jointly conducted by its Admissions Office and the relevant schools/colleges and is subject to the monitoring of the University’s Supervision Division (Tel: +86 (0)592 2186219). 3. Applicants are responsible for the truthfulness and accuracy of the information and documents they have submitted. Failure to meet the admission regulations for international students or any falsification or misrepresentation, whenever it is confirmed, will result in disqualification of application, enrollment, student status, graduation and degrees awarded in accordance with the regulations of the educational authorities and the University. XI. Contact Information Office of Admissions and Examination, Xiamen University (Dealing with the Degree Programs’ applications) Tel: +86 (0) 592 2184792 Fax: +86 (0) 592 2180256 Email: admissions@xmu.edu.cn Website: https://admissions.xmu.edu.cn Chinese International Education College/Overseas Education College (Dealing with the Non-degree Chinese Language Programs’ applications) Tel: +86 (0) 592 2186211 Fax: +86 (0) 592 2093346 Email: oec@xmu.edu.cn Website: https://oec.xmu.edu.cn XMU Overseas Students Affairs Office (Dealing with the international students management) Tel: +86 (0) 592 2183606 Fax: +86 (0) 592 2186589 Email: osao@xmu.edu.cn Website: https://xsc.xmu.edu.cn HSK Test – Xiamen University Test Center Tel: +86 (0) 592 2187478 Fax: +86 (0) 592 2093346 Website: https://www.chinesetest.cn XII . The prospectus shall be interpreted by the Admissions and Examinations Office of Xiamen University, and may be adjusted accordingly in light of relevant requirements of higher authorities and the actual work of the University. “中国政府专项奖学金-高校研究生项目”系中国教育部设立的，旨在支持建设国际高水平大学，打造中国高等教育品牌而提供的全额奖学金项目。由中国部分高等学校自主招生。中国教育部委托国家留学基金管理委员会（以下简称“留学基金委”）负责该项目来华留学生的招生审批及日常事务的管理工作。 一、招生类别及奖学金期限 硕士研究生：奖学金期限2-3年； 博士研究生：奖学金期限3-4年 1、奖学金获得者来华所学专业可使用汉语授课，亦可安排用英语直接授课。凡汉语授课的奖学金生如汉语水平未达到进入专业学习要求，来华后须先进行1年的汉语补习，考试合格方可入专业学习。 2、奖学金期限为录取时确定的学习年限，学生来华后原则上不予延长。 3、奖学金名额不得跨年度使用。 二、申请途径和申请时间 申请人应在规定时间内向承担此奖学金项目招生的中国普通高等学校提出申请，具体申请时间请径与有关中国高等学校查询。 三、申请人资格 1、申请人须为非中国籍公民，身体健康； 2、申请人须为非在华学习的学生（留华毕业生毕业年限须超过一学年）； 3、申请人的学历和年龄要求： 来华攻读硕士学位者，须具有学士学位，年龄不超过35周岁； 来华攻读博士学位者，须具有硕士学位，年龄不超过40周岁。 四、奖学金内容 学费、住宿费、生活费、综合医疗保险 注: ◎奖学金生活费自奖学金生入学之日起由学校逐月定期发放。新生当月十五日（含十五日）之前注册的，发给全月奖学金生活费；十五日以后注册的，发给半个月奖学金生活费。毕业生的奖学金生活费发至学校确定的毕业之日以后的半个月。对休学、退学或结业回国者，奖学金生活费自下个月起停发。学校规定的假期内奖学金生活费照发；奖学金生假期内因离校休假而未能按时领取奖学金生活费，返校后可以补发。奖学金生未请假而不按时到校注册、非健康原因离校或者旷课，时间超过一个月者，停发当月的奖学金生活费。 ◎奖学金生因怀孕或患严重疾病需休学者，应回国生产或休养，回国旅费自理；经学校批准休学者，享受奖学金资格最长可保留一年，但休学期间停发奖学金生活费。奖学金生因其他原因休学者，其享受奖学金的资格不予保留。 五、申请流程 1、申请人可直接向承担自主招生项目有关中国高校提交申请，提交申请前可提前与中国高校联系，取得预录取通知书。 2、申请人须登录“国家留学基金委来华留学网上报名系统”，网上填写申请信息，在线提交并打印《中国政府奖学金申请表》 3、申请人须按以基金委要求准备相应材料，关在规定时间内提交至申请高校。 注：国家留学基金委仅受理承担自主招生项目的高校推荐人选的申请，不受理学生个人的直接申请。西安电子科技大学受理机构代码为10701 六、申请材料(一式两份) 1.《中国政府奖学金申请表》（用中文或英文填写） 2、经过公证的最高学历证明。如申请人为在校学生或已就业，需另外提交本人就读学校出具的在学证明。中英文以外文本需附经公证的中文或英文的译文； 3、学习成绩单。中英文以外文本需附经公证的中文或英文的译文； 4、来华学习和研究计划（不少于800字），用中文或英文书写； 5、两名教授或副教授的推荐信，用中文或英文书写； 6、《外国人体格检查表》复印件（原件自行保存。此表格由中国卫生检疫部门统一印制，可在留学基金委网站下载）。用英文填写。申请人应严格按照《外国人体格检查表》中要求的项目进行检查。缺项、未贴有本人照片或照片上未盖骑缝章、无医师和医院签字盖章的《外国人体格检查表》无效。鉴于检查结果有效期为6个月，请申请人据此确定本人进行体检的时间。 7、有效护照复印件（有效期一年以上） 七、录取及通知 1、中国高等学校对申请人的申请材料进行审核，并决定录取人选。 2、被高校录取的申请人，经国家留学基金委审核合格，即可获得中国政府奖学金资助来华学习； 3、每名奖学金获得者只能获得一个中国政府奖学金项目的资助；对于同时被多所高校录取的奖学金申请人，国家留学基金委仅为其保留一所学校的奖学金资格； 4、国家留学基金委将于6月底前将《录取通知书》和《外国留学人员来华签证申请表》（JW201表）寄回录取院校，由其将上述文件转交学生本人； 5、奖学金获得者来华后不得变更录取院校；原则上不得变更学习专业及学习期限； 6、不能按录取期限来华学习者，奖学金资格不予保留。 八、2018年申请截止日期：2018年3月31日 陕西省西安市西沣路兴隆段266号西安电子科技大学 +86-29-81891038 2027年国际学生（本科）招生简章 浙江师范大学成立于1956年，是中国百强高校之一。根据2026-2027年度U.S.News全球最佳大学排名，我校全国排名第55名，世界排名第384名。 学校有数学、化学、工程学、材料学、环境 / 生态学、计算机科学、动植物学、一般社会科学、精神病学 / 心理学学科、物理学 10 个学科进入 ESI 全球前 1% ， 15 个学科列入浙江省一流学科。 根据2025软科中国最好学科排名，我校区域国别学位列中国顶尖学科第2名。 学校有 26 个学院， 68 个本科专业， 30 个一级学科硕士点， 15 个一级学科博士点， 11 个博士后流动站，国家级课程 50 门，国家级实验教学示范中心 4 个， 2 个国家 “111 计划 ” 学科创新引智基地。 学校有5万余名学生，包括来自100多个国家的3000余名国际学生。学校拥有设备齐全的图书馆、实验室、体育馆、医院、超市等, 校园绿化优美，是生活、学习的理想场所。学校国际交流合作不断推进，与60余个国家和地区的280余所高等院校或教育机构建立了合作和交流关系, 成立了全国首个聚焦教育的中外合作办学机构。 国际学生毕业生在世界各国的政治、经济、文化、教育等领域发挥重要作用。 一、申请条件 1. 持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民，符合教育部教外函〔2020〕12号的文件规定； 2. 年龄原则上18-25周岁（2009年9月1日之前出生）， 未满 18周岁的申请人需提供监护人证明材料； 3. 身心健康，对华友好，无吸毒史，无犯罪记录； 4 . 高中毕业或具有同等学历，成绩良好； 5. 语言能力达到专业要求（具体要求见招生专业目 录） ； 6. 持有来华留学本科入学学业水平测试成绩单（考试科目要求见招生专业目录）。 （来华留学本科入学学业水平测试（CSCA）介绍：https://csca.cn/about/examintro ） 二、申请时间 2027 年2月1日- 6 月 30 日 （奖学金项目另有规定的，从其规定） 三、招生专业 我校面向国际学生开设 30 个中文授课本科专业， 7 个英文授课本科专业。 （ 具体招生专业详见专业目录： https://iso.zjnu.edu.cn/xmjs/list.htm ） 四、申请材料 申请人必须如实填写和上传以下申请材料： 1. 证件照（近期 2 寸免冠照片）； 2. 普通护照个人信息页（有效期需晚于2028年2月28日）； 3. 有效签证或居留许可页（已在华学生需提供） ； 4. 高中毕业证书，应届毕业生需提交就读学校出具的预计毕业的证明； 5. 高中阶段完整课程成绩单、高中统考成绩单或UEC、A Level、AP、IB、SAT、ACT等国际通行标准化考试成绩单； 6. 中国教育部“来华留学本科入学学业水平测试”（CSCA测试）成绩单 ; 7．有效期内的语言水平证明： （1）中文授课项目申请者需提供汉语水平考试（HSK）成绩单（马来西亚独立中学毕业学生申请中文授课专业无须提供汉语水平证明）； （2）英文授课项目申请者如母语非英语，需提交雅思、托福、多邻国等英语测试成绩单； 8. 外国人体格检查表：体检内容必须包括表中所列的所有项目。用中文或者英文填写。体检报告有效期为六个月（模板： FOREIGNER PHYSICAL EXAMINATION FORM.pdf ）； 9. 无犯罪记录证明（有效期为六个月）； 10. 无吸毒史声明（模板： No Drug Addiction Statement.docx ）； 11. 国际学生心理健康调查表（https://forms.gle/TNodp45yUs6gh9yv6）； 12. 存款证明：提供3万元人民币以上的存款证明； 13. 学习计划书：不少于800字，按申请项目授课语言书写； 14. 已在华学习学生须提供原学校在校表现证明； 15. 其他支撑材料（发表论文、荣誉证书、设计作品等），可一并上传申请系统。 ★注意事项： （1）申请材料中涉及的各类表格、文书、证明等如为中英文以外文本，除原件外，还须附经公证的中文或英文翻译件。建议前往中华人民共和国驻所在国使（领）馆对上述材料及其翻译件进行公证。两页以上的表格、文本、证明等应当加盖骑缝章或者在每页上都加盖公章； （2）申请者必须对所提交材料的真实性和完整性负责。申请材料不实、缺漏者，我校概不予受理； （3）我校全面实行网上申请制度，不接收邮寄纸质材料。 五、申请流程 1. 网上申请 申请人登录浙江师范大学国际学生在线申请系统(https://admission.zjnu.edu.cn)，在线填报个人信息并上传申请材料。根据学校通知及时缴纳报名费，报名费一经缴纳，不予退还。申请人须准确填报邮箱、联系电话、微信号等有效联系方式，及时关注申请系统及邮 件通知，学校将据此通知考核相关事宜。 2. 学校审核 我校国际学生录取采用与国际通行模式接轨的申请-审核制。学校收到申请后，首先开展申请资格初审；对符合资格者，由学 院从 语言水平、高中阶段学业基础、学习能力、专业适配性及综合素质等方面综合评审，择优确定录取人选。 3. 录取结果 申请人登录申请系统查询申请状态。申请状态更新为 “已录取” 后，申请人可在系统内自行下载电子版录取通知书，并依据邮件通知下载《外国留学人员来华确认表》 （JW201/JW202 表） ， 用于办理学习签证。 六、费用 1. 报名费：400元人民币。 2. 学费：18000元人民币/学年。 3. 教材费：800元人民币/学年。实行预缴，按实际使用情况多退少补。 4. 住宿费： （1）双人间：450-600元人民币/人/月；四人间：300元人民币/人/月； （2）新生第一年原则上须住校内，第二年可申请到学校指定的校外片区住宿； （3）中国政府奖学金生、国际中文教师奖学金生、商务部奖学金生（资助范围涵盖住宿费者）原则上不同意申请校外住宿。 5. 保险费：1000元人民币/年。根据教育部相关规定，国际学生在华期间必须购买来华留学生综合医疗保险。 七、奖学金项目 1. 中国政府奖学金（A类） 申请者请直接通过中国驻当地大使馆或总领馆申请，并在浙江师范大学在线申请系统提交申请。申请时间一般为当年11月至次年2月初。建议申请者在确认获得我校预录取资格后，再向中国驻外使领馆提出申请，申请截止日期等相关信息以中国驻外使领馆发布为准。该奖学金覆盖我校所有中文授课本科专业，需通过年度综合评审，方可获得下一学年奖学金续评资格。 2. 中国政府奖学金（B类） 申请者须同时在中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统以及浙江师范大学在线申请系统提交申请。申请类别B类，浙江师范大学招生机构代码为10345。申请时间一般为当年5月份。该奖学金支持我校国际经济与贸易、电子商务中文授课本科专业，获奖者需通过年度综合评审，方可获得下一学年奖学金续评资格。 3. 国际中文教师奖学金 申请人须同时在国际中文教师奖学金申请系统以及浙江师范大学在线申请系统提交申请。国际中文教师奖学金支持汉语国际教育本科专业，获奖者需通过年度综合评审，方可获得下一学年奖学金续评资格。 4. 浙江省政府来华留学生奖学金/浙江师范大学国际学生奖学金 浙江师范大学成立于1956年，是中国百强高校之一。根据2026-2027年度U.S.News全球最佳大学排名，我校全国排名第55名，世界排名第384名。 学校有数学、化学、工程学、材料学、环境 / 生态学、计算机科学、动植物学、一般社会科学、精神病学 / 心理学学科、物理学 10 个学科进入 ESI 全球前 1% ， 15 个学科列入浙江省一流学科。 根据2025软科中国最好学科排名，我校区域国别学位列中国顶尖学科第2名。 学校有 26 个学院， 68 个本科专业， 30 个一级学科硕士点， 15 个一级学科博士点， 11 个博士后流动站，国家级课程 50 门，国家级实验教学示范中心 4 个， 2 个国家 “111 计划 ” 学科创新引智基地。 学校有5万余名学生，包括来自100多个国家的3000余名国际学生。学校拥有设备齐全的图书馆、实验室、体育馆、医院、超市等, 校园绿化优美，是生活、学习的理想场所。学校国际交流合作不断推进，与60余个国家和地区的280余所高等院校或教育机构建立了合作和交流关系, 成立了全国首个聚焦教育的中外合作办学机构。 国际学生毕业生在世界各国的政治、经济、文化、教育等领域发挥重要作用。 一、申请条件 1. 持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民，符合教育部教外函〔2020〕12号的文件规定； 2. 年龄原则上18-25周岁（2009年9月1日之前出生）， 未满 18周岁的申请人需提供监护人证明材料； 3. 身心健康，对华友好，无吸毒史，无犯罪记录； 4 . 高中毕业或具有同等学历，成绩良好； 5. 语言能力达到专业要求（具体要求见招生专业目 录） ； 6. 持有来华留学本科入学学业水平测试成绩单（考试科目要求见招生专业目录）。 （来华留学本科入学学业水平测试（CSCA）介绍：https://csca.cn/about/examintro ） 二、申请时间 2027 年2月1日- 6 月 30 日 （奖学金项目另有规定的，从其规定） 三、招生专业 我校面向国际学生开设 30 个中文授课本科专业， 7 个英文授课本科专业。 （ 具体招生专业详见专业目录： https://iso.zjnu.edu.cn/xmjs/list.htm ） 四、申请材料 申请人必须如实填写和上传以下申请材料： 1. 证件照（近期 2 寸免冠照片）； 2. 普通护照个人信息页（有效期需晚于2028年2月28日）； 3. 有效签证或居留许可页（已在华学生需提供） ； 4. 高中毕业证书，应届毕业生需提交就读学校出具的预计毕业的证明； 5. 高中阶段完整课程成绩单、高中统考成绩单或UEC、A Level、AP、IB、SAT、ACT等国际通行标准化考试成绩单； 6. 中国教育部“来华留学本科入学学业水平测试”（CSCA测试）成绩单 ; 7．有效期内的语言水平证明： （1）中文授课项目申请者需提供汉语水平考试（HSK）成绩单（马来西亚独立中学毕业学生申请中文授课专业无须提供汉语水平证明）； （2）英文授课项目申请者如母语非英语，需提交雅思、托福、多邻国等英语测试成绩单； 8. 外国人体格检查表：体检内容必须包括表中所列的所有项目。用中文或者英文填写。体检报告有效期为六个月（模板： FOREIGNER PHYSICAL EXAMINATION FORM.pdf ）； 9. 无犯罪记录证明（有效期为六个月）； 10. 无吸毒史声明（模板： No Drug Addiction Statement.docx ）； 11. 国际学生心理健康调查表（https://forms.gle/TNodp45yUs6gh9yv6）； 12. 存款证明：提供3万元人民币以上的存款证明； 13. 学习计划书：不少于800字，按申请项目授课语言书写； 14. 已在华学习学生须提供原学校在校表现证明； 15. 其他支撑材料（发表论文、荣誉证书、设计作品等），可一并上传申请系统。 ★注意事项：
